questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: TRIPS不是全球专利证书
questions.stem: What does the TRIPS Agreement generally establish?
options: A single patent automatically valid in every WTO member whenever one state grants it.
Minimum standards of intellectual-property protection and enforcement that WTO members must implement, with treaty flexibilities.
A rule abolishing every national intellectual-property law.
An unrestricted right to copy any work for commercial sale.
questions.translation: TRIPS提供统一的全球专利，还是成员应达到的保护标准？
questions.rule: TRIPS规定知识产权保护与执行的最低标准，并保留具体flexibilities；不是授予一张在所有成员自动有效的专利。
explanations: 成员的专利保护仍有领土与程序要求。
正确。最低标准不等于所有制度必须完全一样。
不是废除国内法，而涉及国内落实义务。
TRIPS不创设这种无限商业复制权。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: GATT Article XX两层分析
questions.stem: A member invokes a GATT Article XX general exception for a measure otherwise inconsistent with GATT. Which approach is correct?
options: A stated environmental goal automatically ends the analysis.
Only the measure's title matters.
The measure must satisfy an applicable paragraph and also the chapeau, including its limits on arbitrary or unjustifiable discrimination and disguised trade restrictions.
Once a paragraph applies, discriminatory application can never matter.
questions.translation: Article XX一般例外只要说“环保”就够了吗？
questions.rule: 通常先判断能否落入XX具体分项，再看chapeau限制；各分项的necessary或relating to等措辞不同，不能混用为统一条件。
explanations: 正当目标本身不替代具体条件。
看实际措施与适用，不只看标题。
正确。这是分项与chapeau两个层面。
适用方式仍可能违反chapeau。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: 谁能直接提起WTO争端？
questions.stem: A private exporting company believes another WTO member's measure breaches a WTO agreement. Who can directly bring a dispute as a complainant under the WTO dispute-settlement system?
options: Any private company merely because it lost sales.
Any individual consumer who pays the filing fee.
A national court acting as a private commercial claimant.
A WTO member; private companies do not have direct party access to that system.
questions.translation: 受贸易措施影响的私人公司，能否自己作为申诉方直接提起WTO争端？
questions.rule: WTO争端解决的直接当事方是WTO members；企业可向本成员有关部门反映，但不因经济损失自动取得直接申诉方资格。
explanations: 公司受损不自动成为WTO程序当事方。
不存在仅付费即可作为私人申诉方的规则。
国内法院不是以该身份直接充当私人贸易申诉方。
正确。不要把WTO party access与国内法院standing混成同一规则。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: 未来禁令需要未来风险
questions.stem: A person proves a past unlawful police chokehold but alleges no real and immediate threat of another encounter. Which additional showing is needed for standing to seek a prospective injunction?
options: Only the fact of past injury.
A belief that police misconduct is important.
Citizenship alone.
A sufficiently concrete threat of future injury.
questions.translation: 过去受过伤是否就能请求未来禁令？
questions.rule: Standing要对应所请求的relief；past injury与future injury分开判断。
explanations: 过去损害可能支持赔偿，但不自动支持未来禁令。
公共议题重要不替代个人损害。
公民身份本身不足。
正确。所请求的未来禁令须能防止其本人现实的未来风险。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Third-party standing的hindrance
questions.stem: A physician has personal economic injury from a challenged law and a close relationship with affected patients. Under the ordinary third-party-standing framework, what further consideration matters?
options: Whether patients face a hindrance to protecting their own interests.
Whether every citizen agrees with the physician.
Whether the claim is certain to win on the merits.
Whether the physician pays federal taxes.
questions.translation: 医生自身受损且与患者关系紧密，通常还需要考虑什么？
questions.rule: 第三人standing通常考察原告自身standing、close relationship与hindrance；具体例外另看。
explanations: 正确。一般框架还看权利人自行维权是否受阻。
不要求全民同意。
Standing不等于实体必胜。
纳税不是替他人主张权利的充分理由。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: 组织请求individual damages
questions.stem: An association seeks individualized damages requiring each member to prove a different injury and amount. Which associational-standing requirement is most directly problematic?
options: The defendant must consent to federal jurisdiction.
Neither the claim nor relief should require individual member participation.
The organization must be incorporated in every state.
Every member must have the same income.
questions.translation: 组织为成员请求各不相同的损害赔偿，哪一条件最困难？
questions.rule: Hunt第三项关注claim或relief是否要求individual participation，统一禁令与个别赔偿有区别。
explanations: 被告同意不能替代Article III要件。
正确。个别损失的证明通常需要成员分别参与。
Hunt并无该条件。
成员收入相同不是条件。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Tax credit与taxpayer standing
questions.stem: State taxpayers challenge a tax credit encouraging private donations to religious schools, relying solely on taxpayer status. Which precedent most directly limits that theory?
options: All state taxpayers may challenge any credit.
A tax credit necessarily spends the plaintiff’s own tax payment.
Winn distinguishes tax credits from governmental expenditures for this taxpayer-standing theory.
Every religious dispute automatically creates standing.
questions.translation: 仅凭州纳税人身份挑战私人捐赠税收抵免，Winn如何处理？
questions.rule: Taxpayer standing例外很窄；Winn中的税收抵免与直接征税支出路径区别对待。
explanations: 纳税人没有普遍监督权。
不能直接作这种财产权推定。
正确。Winn拒绝将此税收抵免自动等同Flast型支出。

questions.title: Executive discretionary spending
questions.stem: Federal taxpayers object to executive conferences funded from general administrative appropriations. No specific congressional religious expenditure is challenged. Which is best under Hein?
options: General appropriations always satisfy Flast.
The executive can never violate the Establishment Clause.
Every taxpayer has a personal property interest in each conference.
Taxpayer status alone does not bring this within the narrow Flast exception.

不存在这种普遍个人财产利益。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Voluntary cessation的负担
questions.stem: After suit is filed, a company voluntarily stops the challenged conduct but remains able to resume it. To establish mootness on this basis, what must it ordinarily show?
options: It is absolutely clear the wrongful behavior cannot reasonably be expected to recur.
A promise alone always ends jurisdiction.
The plaintiff must prove certainty of recurrence.
Stopping conduct is always an admission of liability.
questions.translation: 被告自愿停止后，谁要说明何以不会合理地再次发生？
questions.rule: Voluntary cessation不自动moot；关键是合理预期会否再发生，而非仅看当前停止。
explanations: 正确。自愿停止一方承担很重的证明负担。
口头承诺并非当然足够。
不能把被告的负担倒置给原告。
停止行为不自动等于承认实体责任。

questions.title: Past damages仍有争议
questions.stem: A student returns to school, so an injunction to readmit her is no longer useful. She still has a viable, unpaid damages claim for a past unlawful suspension. Which is best?
options: The court must award damages merely because the case remains live.
The damages claim may keep a live controversy despite loss of the injunction issue.
All claims automatically become moot upon readmission.
A damages request always cures lack of original standing.
questions.translation: 复学后，仍有效的过去损失赔偿请求是否一并失效？

explanations: 可审理不等于实体必胜。
正确。不同relief分别看是否仍可给有效救济。
禁令失去意义不必消灭可成立的过去损害请求。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: 最高州法院不必叫Supreme Court
questions.stem: A state intermediate appellate court renders the final judgment because the state’s highest court denies discretionary review. A preserved federal issue remains and no adequate independent state ground controls. Which is best?
options: A federal district court must rehear every fact first.
The losing party has an automatic right to Supreme Court merits review.
Section 1257 may permit Supreme Court certiorari from the highest state court in which a decision could be had.
Only a court literally named State Supreme Court can supply a reviewable judgment.
questions.translation: 州最高法院拒绝复审后，中级法院最终判决是否可能被调卷？
questions.rule: 28 USC1257要求适当最终性与联邦问题，不机械要求法院名称。
explanations: 不是先向联邦地区法院普通上诉。
Certiorari一般仍属裁量。
正确。看州内可取得最终裁判的最高层级。
名称不是唯一判断。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Denial of certiorari
questions.stem: The Supreme Court denies a petition for certiorari. What is the sound inference?
options: Every Justice agrees that the lower court was correct.
The lower opinion becomes a Supreme Court holding.
The dispute must have been a political question.
Denial does not itself express approval of the lower court’s merits reasoning.
questions.translation: 拒绝certiorari能否说明最高院认可下级理由？
questions.rule: Denial of certiorari不是实体认可，也不等于设立新的最高院precedent。
explanations: 不能从拒绝推断所有大法官的实体立场。
下级意见不会因此变成最高院holding。
拒绝调卷不说明必然是political question。
正确。不受理可能有多种原因。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Original jurisdiction不能随意扩张
questions.stem: Congress attempts to add a category to the Supreme Court’s original jurisdiction beyond Article III’s allocation. Which constitutional objection is strongest?
options: Congress cannot enlarge the Court’s constitutionally assigned original jurisdiction by ordinary statute.
Congress can amend Article III with a simple statute.
Original jurisdiction means every appeal.
Every federal dispute must begin in the Supreme Court.
questions.translation: 普通法律可否扩大最高院宪法规定的original jurisdiction？
questions.rule: Article III的原审权限分配不能由普通法律任意扩张。
explanations: 正确。Marbury体现这一权限边界。
宪法修改须走宪法程序。
Original与appellate不同。
多数案件并非在最高院开始。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Homegrown wheat与需求替代
questions.stem: A national wheat-production scheme includes wheat grown for home use. The farmer’s output is tiny but replaces market purchases. Under Wickard, which consideration supports regulation?
options: The federal government has unlimited local police power.
The aggregate effect of similarly situated producers on the interstate wheat market.
Only wheat personally crossing a state line may ever be regulated.
Home production is never economic activity.
questions.translation: 自用小麦怎样连接到州际市场？
questions.rule: 同类自用生产替代市场需求，individual impact很小不当然排除aggregate regulation。
explanations: Wickard并未授予无限police power。
正确。商品生产可按同类活动整体市场影响分析。
州内活动也可能有实质市场影响。
自用不自动排除经济性质。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Lopez所管行为
questions.stem: For the 1990 school-zone gun statute examined in Lopez, which feature weakened the Commerce Clause justification?
options: It regulated interstate highways.
It was limited to guns being shipped across state borders.
It regulated local noncommercial possession without a jurisdictional element tying individual cases to interstate commerce.
It taxed every interstate firearms sale.
questions.translation: Lopez旧版法条的权限问题是什么？
questions.rule: 先辨被管行为；枪是商品不等于校园持枪本身就是经济活动。
explanations: 不是channels管制。
该旧版没有这种限定。
正确。该旧版规定的行为及缺少商业联系要求很关键。
题干不是这种税。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Morrison的经济后果链
questions.stem: Congress creates a civil remedy for gender-motivated private violence based solely on aggregated downstream economic losses. Under Morrison, which is best?
options: Congress may regulate every act that costs money.
Private violence becomes interstate commerce whenever a victim misses work.
Morrison invalidated every federal violence law.
Those economic consequences do not by themselves turn the noneconomic violence into Commerce Clause-regulable activity.
questions.translation: 非经济暴力的累计经济损失能否自动建立commercial权限？
questions.rule: Morrison限制以非经济暴力的聚合间接后果扩张商业权；不是整部VAWA无效。
explanations: 这种概括会消除列举权边界。
误把后果当行为性质。
判决针对特定民事救济规定。
正确。不能仅靠过长的经济后果链补足权限。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Raich与整体经济监管
questions.stem: A federal law comprehensively regulates a national market in a fungible commodity, including local cultivation for personal medical use permitted by state law. Which best reflects Raich?
options: Congress may include the local production within the comprehensive federal market regulation.
State permission automatically defeats federal regulation.
No local cultivation can affect a national market.
Only profitable sales count as commodity production.
questions.translation: 州允许的本地自用种植，是否当然不受联邦市场监管？
questions.rule: Raich把本地商品生产放入全国综合监管体系分析；不等于所有非经济行为均可管。
explanations: 正确。看全国商品监管体系和本地生产的关系。
州许可不自动排除有效联邦法。
结论过宽。
自用生产仍可能属于经济活动类别。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Compelling market entry
questions.stem: Congress relies solely on the Commerce Clause to require people who are not buying a product to enter that market. Which concern did NFIB identify?
options: Calling the mandate commerce settles its validity.
Regulating existing commerce differs from compelling individuals to become active in commerce.
Congress cannot regulate any insurance transaction.
All inactivity is immune from every constitutional power.
questions.translation: Commerce Clause可否仅因不购买会影响经济就强令人入市？
questions.rule: NFIB的commerce结论与taxing-power论证须分别判断。
explanations: 名称不能替代权限分析。
正确。NFIB区分监管活动与命令入市。
商业活动并非全免管制。
别的宪法权限须另查。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Commandeering州立法机关
questions.stem: Congress orders each state legislature to enact a particular waste-disposal law. Assume no constitutional amendment separately authorizes this command. Which objection applies?
options: Congress may always compel state legislation if the policy is useful.
The state must show a taxpayer injury first.
Anti-commandeering limits federal commands to state legislatures.
States are immune from all federal law.
questions.translation: 国会能否直接命令各州制定某法？
questions.rule: New York反commandeering原则区分直接命令与合宪鼓励／联邦自行管制。
explanations: 政策有用不能替代权限。
此实体权限问题不是纳税人standing要件。
正确。联邦不能把州立法机关作为其立法执行工具。
有效联邦法可直接管制适当对象。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Commandeering州执法人员
questions.stem: A federal statute requires state sheriffs to administer a federal background-check program. Which principle from Printz is most relevant?
options: Every background-check policy is substantively invalid.
States may nullify every federal criminal law.
A federal statute always overrides structural federalism limits.
Congress generally may not compel state executive officers to administer a federal regulatory program.
questions.translation: 联邦要求州警长执行其监管计划，Printz关注什么？
questions.rule: Anti-commandeering也涉及州executive officers，并非只涉及州议会。
explanations: 政策内容与执行分工分开。
没有一般nullification权。
Supremacy以有效联邦法为前提。
正确。此处关键在强令州官员执行联邦项目。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Express preemption
questions.stem: A valid federal statute expressly preempts state labeling requirements that differ from its specified label. A state imposes a different label on the same covered goods. What is the first issue?
options: Whether the state rule falls within the federal preemption clause’s scope.
Whether state law is automatically supreme because labels are local.
Whether every state regulation everywhere disappears.
Whether federal officials personally approve each label.
questions.translation: 有效联邦法有明确preemption条款，先分析哪一步？
questions.rule: Express preemption看条款文本和适用范围；不能只凭联邦有法就推全领域排除。
explanations: 正确。先解释排除条款范围和覆盖对象。
地方性不自动优先。
Preemption有具体范围。
题干没有要求逐件个人批准。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Impossibility conflict
questions.stem: Assume a valid federal law requires a manufacturer to use label X, while state law forbids label X for the same product, and no alternative complies with both. Which is strongest?
options: Federal law needs the governor’s consent.
Compliance with both is impossible, supporting conflict preemption.
Both rules must remain enforceable against the manufacturer simultaneously.
State law wins solely because it is newer.
questions.translation: 同一产品必须贴X、又不得贴X，如何分析？
questions.rule: 实际无法同时合规是conflict preemption的重要路径。
explanations: 州长同意不是一般条件。
正确。题干明确无法同时遵守两套要求。
相互矛盾义务不能这样并行强制。
州新法不因此压倒有效联邦法。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Federal floor不必是ceiling
questions.stem: A valid federal safety law expressly preserves stricter state standards. A compatible state rule requires more protection. Which is best?
options: State safety rules can never coexist with federal rules.
The state must repeal its rule because Congress legislated once.
The federal minimum does not, by itself, preempt that preserved stricter standard.
Every federal minimum is necessarily a maximum.
questions.translation: 联邦最低标准明确保留更严州标准，能否仅因联邦有法认定排除？
questions.rule: Preemption须看联邦法设计；最低保护标准不当然成为最高上限。
explanations: 两层监管可能并存。
联邦立法不自动占满所有空间。
正确。题干明确保留兼容的更严保护。
Floor与ceiling要区分。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Market participant
questions.stem: A state sells cement from its own plant and prefers local buyers in that sale, without regulating later resale or private competitors. Which doctrine is most relevant?
options: A universal exemption from every constitutional provision.
The state’s power to impose any downstream restriction.
Automatic application of the Foreign Emoluments Clause.
The market-participant exception to dormant Commerce Clause scrutiny.
questions.translation: 州自己卖水泥优先本地买家，和监管所有私人卖家有何区别？
questions.rule: Market participation例外有范围，不是州商业行为的全面宪法豁免。
explanations: 其他宪法限制仍可能适用。
下游限制不能无限延伸。
与该条款无关。
正确。州作为市场参与者的自身交易与市场监管有区别。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: 本地产业保护税
questions.stem: A state taxes only boats manufactured outside the state, expressly to protect its local boat industry. No applicable exception or congressional authorization exists. Which challenge is strongest?
options: Discrimination against interstate commerce.
The rule is valid merely because local jobs are at stake.
Corporations have Article IV citizen status.
Any revenue measure is immune from constitutional review.
questions.translation: 只向外州制造船只征税保护本地产业，最直接的问题？
questions.rule: Dormant Commerce Clause对歧视州际商业的保护主义措施施以严格限制。
explanations: 正确。按外地来源差别征税体现保护主义。
保护本地产业不能自动正当化歧视。
Article IV P&I通常保护自然人州公民。
税收同样受宪法限制。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: 州税的fair apportionment
questions.stem: A business operates in several states. Under Complete Auto, which feature supports a valid state tax on interstate business?
options: Complete absence of a connection with the taxing state.
Fair apportionment so the state taxes an appropriate share.
Taxing all worldwide receipts solely to benefit local firms.
Discrimination favoring identical local businesses.
questions.translation: 多州企业州税为何需要fair apportionment？
questions.rule: Complete Auto框架包括substantial nexus、fair apportionment、non-discrimination及与州提供服务的fair relation。
explanations: Substantial nexus同样重要。

不能仅凭本地好处无限征收。
非歧视也是条件。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Corporation与Article IV
questions.stem: An out-of-state corporation invokes Article IV’s Privileges and Immunities Clause solely as a citizen of another state. Which is best?
options: Every corporation counts as a natural person for this clause.
The clause protects only federal officers.
Corporations are not citizens protected by that particular clause, though other constitutional protections may apply.
Corporations lack every constitutional right.
questions.translation: 公司可否仅凭外州公民身份适用Article IV P&I？
questions.rule: 不同条款的person/citizen不可互换；Article IV P&I与Equal Protection、DCC分别分析。
explanations: 该条款的citizen不这样扩大。
与联邦官员身份无关。
正确。须区分特定条款主体范围。
公司仍可能有其他宪法权利。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Nonresident livelihood
questions.stem: A city reserves most private construction jobs on city-funded projects for local residents. An individual out-of-state worker challenges the livelihood restriction. Which framework is most relevant?
options: No constitutional scrutiny because the city pays for the project.
An automatic right to every government job.
A rule that all residency distinctions require strict scrutiny.
Article IV Privileges and Immunities, including substantial justification and fit.
questions.translation: 市资助项目的私人就业排斥外州个人，如何找保护依据？
questions.rule: 共同职业／谋生可涉及Article IV P&I；限制须有相应实质理由及关系。
explanations: DCC例外不等于所有条款例外。
权利并非无限。
要按具体受保护活动及条款分析。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: 传统专属公共职能
questions.stem: A private operator runs the entire municipal election under delegated state authority. Which fact most strongly supports state action?
options: Administration of a function traditionally and exclusively reserved to government.
Merely selling ordinary groceries.
Receiving a standard business license alone.
The owner’s personal political views.
questions.translation: 私人承担传统专属政府职能时，是否仍可出现state action？
questions.rule: State action看职能、归责等具体联系，不只看名义是否私人。
explanations: 正确。传统专属公共职能是state-action路径之一。
普通商业非当然国家行为。

私人观点不等于政府归责。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Funding alone
questions.stem: A private institution receives public funding and extensive regulation, but its challenged dismissal decision is neither compelled nor significantly encouraged by the state, and no other attribution basis exists. Which is best?
options: Public funding automatically removes every private right.
Funding and regulation alone do not necessarily make that particular decision state action.
Every funded private entity becomes the government for all purposes.
All private decisions are constitutional violations.
questions.translation: 有政府资助和监管，是否每个私人决定都算state action？
questions.rule: Blum要求分析具体决定的政府归责；资助、监管本身通常不足。
explanations: 不存在这种普遍后果。
正确。须连接被挑战行为与政府。
不能把资助机械扩大成所有行为归责。
宪法通常约束国家行为。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Private violence与affirmative duty
questions.stem: Officials know a child may face private abuse, but the state has not taken the child into custody and has not created the danger. Under DeShaney’s general rule, which is best?
options: Every failed rescue is automatically a Fourteenth Amendment violation.
Only taxpayers may sue about abuse.
Knowledge alone does not create a general substantive-due-process duty to protect against private violence.
Government guarantees protection from all private harms.
questions.translation: 政府知道私人危险但没有拘押或制造危险，是否当然负宪法救助义务？
questions.rule: DeShaney的一般规则须与custody等特定情形区别；州法救济另看。
explanations: 侵权责任与宪法责任不同。
与纳税人身份无关。
正确。一般规则不把政府变成所有私人暴力的保证人。
没有这种普遍宪法保证。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Property entitlement与期待
questions.stem: A public employee’s fixed-term contract expires. No statute, promise, rule, or practice creates any entitlement to renewal. For a procedural-due-process property claim concerning renewal, what is missing?
options: Proof that the employee wanted renewal.
Proof that the job was useful.
An automatic property right in every future public job.
A legitimate claim of entitlement rather than a unilateral expectation.
questions.translation: 没有法律或承诺续约权，仅希望续聘是否是property interest？
questions.rule: Roth区分legitimate entitlement与unilateral expectation；另有报复言论等请求须分别看。
explanations: 主观愿望不等于entitlement。
工作有用不产生续约权。
并无这类自动权利。
正确。Property interest需有相应法律／承诺基础。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Mathews balancing
questions.stem: A court determines what procedures are due before a government benefit deprivation. Which set best states the Mathews factors?
options: Private interest; risk of erroneous deprivation and value of safeguards; government interests and burdens.
Only the cost of hiring a lawyer.
Only whether the official acted politely.
A full criminal jury trial for every administrative decision.
questions.translation: 决定应给什么程序时，Mathews看哪些因素？
questions.rule: Procedural due process不机械要求所有案件同一程序；按具体利益与风险平衡。
explanations: 正确。三组利益与错误风险共同衡量。
费用不是唯一因素。
礼貌不能替代程序分析。
行政程序不自动等于刑事陪审程序。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Permanent public access easement
questions.stem: The government permanently requires a landowner to allow the general public to walk across a strip of private land. Assume no background public-access right applies. Which is the strongest starting point?
options: The owner must show the entire parcel is valueless before any taking exists.
A physical taking of an access easement normally requires just compensation.
Only a tax issue can arise.
Every public purpose eliminates compensation.
questions.translation: 政府强制永久公众通行，一定要证明土地全无价值才构成taking吗？
questions.rule: Physical taking与regulatory taking路径不同；背景产权限制等须另查。
explanations: 物理征收不必全部财产无价值。
正确。强制公众通行可占用排除他人的财产权。
不只涉及税。
Public use与just compensation是不同要求。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Total economic deprivation
questions.stem: A regulation eliminates all economically beneficial use of land. The prohibited use was not already barred by background property or nuisance principles. Which doctrine is most directly relevant?
options: All regulation is exempt if called environmental.
Only formal transfer of title can ever be a taking.
The Lucas categorical regulatory-taking rule.
Every reduction in value automatically receives identical treatment.
questions.translation: 所有经济有益用途均被取消且无背景法例外，考虑什么？
questions.rule: Lucas的total-taking规则有严格条件，不应扩成任何价值下降都征收。
explanations: 政策名称不决定一切。
Taking不只限正式过户。
正确。题干给出total deprivation并排除背景法限制。
部分减值通常另作分析。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Public use不等于公众亲自使用
questions.stem: A taking is part of a genuine comprehensive economic-development plan serving a public purpose, not a mere pretext for a private favor. Under the federal Kelo rule, which is best?
options: Every parcel must be physically open to everyone.
Any private recipient automatically defeats public use.
No compensation is required if development creates jobs.
Public use can include a public purpose; compensation and state-law limits remain separate.
questions.translation: 真正公共发展计划中，public use是否限公众亲自使用？
questions.rule: Kelo解释联邦Public Use Clause；州法可施加更严限制。
explanations: Public use并不只限亲自通行使用。
私人最终接收本身不自动决定。
公共目的不取消补偿义务。
正确。联邦底线与各州更严限制分开。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Prospective contract regulation
questions.stem: A state changes the rules governing only contracts formed after the law takes effect. Which is best under the Contract Clause?
options: The clause’s concern with impairing existing contractual obligations is not triggered merely by prospective regulation.
The clause prohibits every future contract rule.
Any economic regulation requires strict scrutiny.
Only federal contracts may ever be regulated.
questions.translation: 只影响今后新订合同的州法，是否仅此就违反Contract Clause？
questions.rule: Contract Clause针对州法对既有合同义务的impairment；其他宪法问题另查。
explanations: 正确。先看是否影响existing obligations。
州可以制定未来合同规则。
一般经济立法不一律strict scrutiny。
题干不是这种主体限制。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Ex post facto criminalization
questions.stem: A state makes conduct criminal in 2016 and prosecutes a person solely for that conduct committed in 2015, when it was lawful. Which provision is most direct?
options: The Guarantee Clause.
The Ex Post Facto Clause.
The Commerce Clause solely because books were involved.
The Appointments Clause.
questions.translation: 州能否用后来刑法处罚过去合法行为？
questions.rule: Ex post facto限制追溯性刑事立法；不是所有民事追溯措施都直接适用此条。
explanations: 不是共和政体保证。
正确。法律将过去合法行为追溯入罪。
商品背景不抓住追溯刑罚问题。
不是官员任命。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Bill of attainder
questions.stem: A legislature names specific individuals and imposes punitive deprivation on them without a judicial trial. Which constitutional concern is most direct?
options: A lawful pardon.
The need for a jury in a civil contract dispute.
A bill of attainder.
Every named statute is automatically an advisory opinion.
questions.translation: 立法点名并不经司法审理实施惩罚，涉及什么？
questions.rule: Bill of attainder通常考察特定对象、惩罚及缺乏司法审判。
explanations: 这不是宽免刑罚。
不是合同陪审问题。
正确。立法代替司法对特定对象实施惩罚是关键。
须看惩罚等要素，不是仅姓名。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Express racial classification
questions.stem: A state law expressly separates otherwise eligible applicants by race. No special context alters the usual standard. Which scrutiny generally applies?
options: Rational basis merely because the legislature calls the policy helpful.
No scrutiny whenever every race is mentioned.
Automatic validity if a majority voted for it.
Strict scrutiny, requiring the government to justify the racial classification under that standard.
questions.translation: 州明文按race分类，通常用什么审查？
questions.rule: Race classification通常strict scrutiny；分类受审不等于题干省略目的和tailoring也能机械决定最终胜负。
explanations: 政策名称不改变层级。
对多种族分类仍可能严格审查。
多数支持不能替代宪法审查。
正确。种族分类一般触发strict scrutiny。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Sex classification
questions.stem: A state uses an express sex classification. Which formulation generally governs intermediate scrutiny?
options: An important governmental objective and means substantially related to that objective.
Any imaginable preference automatically suffices.
Every sex classification is exempt from review.
Only a legitimate objective, without examining the relation.
questions.translation: Sex classification的intermediate scrutiny如何表述？
questions.rule: Important objectives与substantial relationship；不能只靠过度概括的性别刻板印象。
explanations: 正确。须有exceedingly persuasive justification的相应论证。
任意偏好不足。
并非豁免。
这把审查降低成一般rational basis。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Age classification
questions.stem: A generally applicable age-based public-employment retirement rule is challenged solely as age discrimination. No separate fundamental right is burdened. Which standard ordinarily applies?
options: No constitutional analysis is ever possible for federal employment.
Rational-basis review.
Strict scrutiny solely because all ages are protected classes.
Intermediate scrutiny automatically for every employment rule.
questions.translation: 仅因年龄设退休规定，通常是什么层级？
questions.rule: Age一般rational basis；法定年龄歧视保护与宪法审查层级不同。
explanations: 联邦平等保障另通过Fifth Amendment分析。
正确。年龄本身通常非suspect classification。
不能把所有分类都当suspect。
就业并非自动触发intermediate。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Facially neutral purposeful discrimination
questions.stem: A state adopts a facially neutral degree requirement specifically to exclude a racial minority, and it has that discriminatory effect. Which is best?
options: Disparate impact alone always proves unconstitutional intent.
Employment benefits are outside equal protection.
Discriminatory purpose plus effect can trigger heightened racial-classification scrutiny despite neutral wording.
Neutral words always guarantee rational-basis review.
questions.translation: 中性学历条件有排斥种族的目的且产生效果，如何审查？
questions.rule: Washington v. Davis区分impact与discriminatory purpose；给定目的与效果时不能只看facial neutrality。
explanations: 只有impact不自动证明purpose。
政府就业可受平等保障约束。
正确。不能只看表面文字。
有意歧视不能靠中性措辞免审。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Federal equal protection route
questions.stem: A federal agency intentionally discriminates by race. Which constitutional provision supplies the federal equal-protection route?
options: The Fourteenth Amendment applies directly to all federal conduct by its text.
Only Article IV Privileges and Immunities.
No constitutional equality principle can bind federal agencies.
The Fifth Amendment Due Process Clause’s equal-protection component.
questions.translation: 联邦机关的种族歧视，通过哪条宪法路径审查？
questions.rule: 州的Equal Protection与联邦Fifth Amendment路径应区分。
explanations: Fourteenth Amendment文字针对州。
该条不是此问题最直接来源。
联邦同样受相应平等限制。
正确。Bolling说明联邦路径。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Viewpoint discrimination
questions.stem: A public university opens a student-publication fund to diverse viewpoints but excludes a publication solely because its otherwise eligible viewpoint is religious. What is the central speech issue?
options: Viewpoint discrimination in administering the forum or program.
A rule that religious speakers have no speech rights.
Automatic proof that every subsidy is required.
An unrestricted right to all government funds for every purpose.
questions.translation: 大学开放刊物资助后仅排除宗教观点，涉及什么？
questions.rule: Rosenberger要求区分项目界限与viewpoint discrimination。
explanations: 正确。看既有项目对观点的差别。
宗教观点仍有言论保护。
不是建立普遍补贴义务。
公共项目可有合法边界。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Content-based restriction
questions.stem: A city bans public-park signs criticizing its mayor but allows equally sized signs praising the mayor. Which feature is constitutionally most troubling?
options: The rule is content neutral because sign size is equal.
It selects speech for restriction because of its viewpoint.
All signs are automatically unprotected conduct.
The city owns the park, so all viewpoint choices are valid.
questions.translation: 只禁批评市长、允许赞扬市长的标语，是中性规制吗？
questions.rule: 比较被允许与被禁止的表达内容，不能只看物理尺寸。
explanations: 尺寸相同不改变内容／观点区别。
正确。赞扬与批评的差别直指viewpoint。
标语可受保护。
所有权不消灭论坛规则。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Time place manner tailoring
questions.stem: In a traditional public forum, a content-neutral sound rule serves a significant noise-control interest and leaves ample alternatives. Which statement is accurate?
options: Every neutral rule must satisfy the same test as a viewpoint ban.
An alternative channel may be completely unavailable.
Narrow tailoring is required, but the rule need not be the least restrictive conceivable means.
No tailoring is ever required for neutral rules.
questions.translation: 中性的时间地点方式限制，是否必须是想象得到的最小限制手段？
questions.rule: Traditional public forum中通常看内容中立、significant interest、narrow tailoring与ample alternatives。
explanations: 不能混用审查框架。
Ample alternatives是重要条件。
正确。Ward的narrow tailoring不等于绝对least restrictive means。
仍须审查适当范围。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Unbridled licensing discretion
questions.stem: A park-speech permit ordinance lets the mayor approve any speaker she finds "appropriate," without objective criteria or safeguards. What is the strongest concern?
options: Every permit system is necessarily invalid.
Every park is outside speech protection.
A mayor’s sincerity automatically cures the missing standards.
Unbridled discretion permitting censorship in a prior-restraint scheme.
questions.translation: 公园发言许可由市长任意决定，有什么问题？
questions.rule: Prior restraint中的licensing须注意标准、裁量与程序，不是说所有许可证均无效。
explanations: 适当客观许可制度可能有效。
公园常是传统公共论坛。
主观诚意不能替代制度限制。
正确。缺少客观标准可能让许可成为审查工具。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Vagueness
questions.stem: An ordinance punishes "any inappropriate public expression" without definitions or enforceable standards. Which objection focuses on fair notice and arbitrary enforcement?
options: Vagueness.
A rule requiring proof of commercial trademark use.
The pardon power.
A guarantee of free government advertising.
questions.translation: 言论规范边界不明、可任意执行，对应哪项异议？
questions.rule: Vagueness着眼fair notice和执法标准；overbreadth另看覆盖过多受保护表达。
explanations: 正确。标准不清使公众无法知道边界，并增加任意执法风险。
这不是商标使用问题。
与总统赦免无关。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Substantial overbreadth
questions.stem: A speech law reaches a substantial amount of protected expression relative to its legitimate sweep. Which doctrine may permit a facial challenge even by a person whose own conduct could be regulated?
options: A guarantee that the challenger wins damages without injury.
First Amendment overbreadth, subject to its demanding limits.
Automatic standing for all constitutional claims.
A rule that every broad statute is void.
questions.translation: 自己行为可管，何时仍可能攻击言论法整体过宽？
questions.rule: Overbreadth允许特定第三人表达利益的facial挑战，但不能当成普遍standing豁免。
explanations: 资格规则不自动建立赔偿责任。
正确。是有严格限制的First Amendment特殊路径。
不能扩大到所有宪法诉讼。
须是相对于合法范围的substantial overbreadth等。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Misleading commercial speech
questions.stem: A deceptive advertisement is restricted because it misleads consumers. Which is best under the ordinary commercial-speech framework?
options: A commercial label removes protection from all truthful speech too.
Only criminal prosecutions can regulate misleading ads.
False or misleading commercial speech does not receive the protection afforded truthful lawful advertising.
Every advertisement receives absolute protection.
questions.translation: 误导性广告与真实合法广告的保护是否一样？
questions.rule: Central Hudson框架不能省略真实、非误导与合法活动的入口判断。

民事监管也可能存在。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Miller的整体价值
questions.stem: Under Miller, a work taken as a whole has serious literary value. Assume no separate child-sexual-abuse-material issue. Which is best?
options: Any sexual content automatically makes it obscene.
Only one isolated page must be considered.
Community dislike alone satisfies every element.
It does not meet the full constitutional obscenity test.
questions.translation: 作品整体具有serious literary value，是否仍当然属于Miller obscenity？
questions.rule: Miller各项条件须共同满足；儿童性虐待材料另有规则。
explanations: 性内容并非自动obscenity。
须按整体而非只截孤立部分。
公众厌恶不能替代全要素。
正确。Serious literary/artistic/political/scientific value是完整测试的重要一项。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Incitement
questions.stem: A speaker abstractly praises revolution in the distant future but neither intends nor is likely to cause imminent lawless action. Which is best under Brandenburg?
options: Abstract advocacy alone does not satisfy the incitement standard.
All advocacy of change is unprotected.
Any listener’s offense proves imminent violence.
Police may suppress any political belief without further analysis.
questions.translation: 抽象鼓吹遥远革命，没有迫近违法的意图与可能性，是否满足incitement？
questions.rule: Brandenburg把抽象主张与意图且可能引发迫近违法的煽动区分。
explanations: 正确。重点是directed to和likely to produce imminent lawless action。
表达变革并非一律失保护。
冒犯与迫近违法不同。
不能只因政治观点而压制。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Employee official-duty speech
questions.stem: A public employee writes a memo pursuant to official job duties and claims First Amendment protection against employment discipline for that memo. Which rule is most relevant?
options: The employee must prove a patent infringement.
Under Garcetti, official-duty speech is generally not citizen speech protected by this employment-retaliation framework.
Every statement by a public worker is unprotected.
Every job-related statement receives absolute protection.
questions.translation: 公务员依职务撰写备忘录，Garcetti关注什么？
questions.rule: 看说话是否依official duties，不能把所有公务员表达一概而论。
explanations: 与专利无关。
正确。题干明确pursuant to official duties。
工作外公民言论可能另分析。
职务表达非自动绝对保护。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Selective religious targeting
questions.stem: A city bans only religious animal sacrifice while allowing comparable secular killings that undermine its asserted health interest. Which concern is most direct?
options: Religious conduct is never protected.
Every animal regulation is unconstitutional.
The law may fail neutrality and general applicability, requiring more demanding review.
Calling a law public health automatically ends review.
questions.translation: 禁止宗教杀牲但放行可比世俗行为，如何分析？
questions.rule: Lukumi要求检查neutrality与general applicability，不只看表面目的。
explanations: 宗教实践可能受保护。
中立一般适用监管可能有效。
正确。对可比世俗行为的例外可显示针对宗教。
政策标签不能替代分析。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Establishment分析框架更新
questions.stem: A modern Establishment Clause question asks which framework Kennedy identified in place of the abandoned Lemon approach. Which is most accurate?
options: Mechanical use of Lemon as the exclusive current test.
An automatic ban on all religious expression by public employees.
Automatic validity whenever an official says the act is traditional.
An analysis informed by historical practices and understandings, with the particular facts still important.
questions.translation: 现代Establishment题能否仍机械只套Lemon？
questions.rule: Kennedy明确转向历史实践与理解；具体政府参与、强制等事实仍须分析。
explanations: Lemon不应当成现行唯一测试。
私人宗教表达不能一律禁止。
仅说传统不能直接免除审查。
正确。History/tradition不是不审事实的口号。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Dobbs与旧Roe实体规则
questions.stem: A study note states that Roe’s federal constitutional abortion-right holding remains controlling after Dobbs. Which correction is accurate?
options: Dobbs overruled Roe and Casey’s abortion-right holdings; other legal claims and state protections must be assessed separately.
Dobbs overruled every constitutional privacy decision.
Dobbs abolished all state-law abortion protection.
A past procedural mootness discussion automatically revives Roe’s merits holding.
questions.translation: 旧讲义仍称Roe实体规则有效，如何校订？
questions.rule: Dobbs改变联邦宪法堕胎权实体规则；Roe历史程序讨论不能替代现行实体法。
explanations: 正确。不能把旧实体结论继续当现行联邦规则。
判决不等于所有隐私判例均被推翻。
州法可能另有保护。
程序规则与实体规则分开。

questions.subject: 宪法
questions.title: Pardon的宪法来源
questions.stem: Congress dislikes a presidential pardon for a completed federal offense and enacts a statute eliminating the President’s pardon power for that offense. Which is best?
options: A pardon reverses an impeachment conviction automatically.
Congress cannot remove the Article II pardon power by ordinary statute.
Congress may erase any express presidential power by a majority vote.
The President may pardon only state offenses.
questions.translation: 国会能否因不满某次联邦赦免而以普通法取消该项总统权力？
questions.rule: Article II赋予对联邦犯罪的赦免权，但有impeachment等宪法边界。
explanations: 宪法明确排除impeachment情形。
正确。普通立法不能消灭宪法直接授予的权力。
Override总统否决也不等于修改宪法。
总统赦免限offenses against the United States。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Import quota
questions.stem: A WTO member limits imports of a product to 1,000 units annually through licenses. No exception applies. Which GATT rule is most directly implicated?
options: An automatic right of private firms to sue at the WTO.
A guarantee that every license is lawful.
Article XI’s general prohibition of quantitative restrictions.
A rule requiring all tariffs to be zero.
questions.translation: 用许可证设置年度进口数量上限，首先看什么？
questions.rule: GATT XI原则上限制非关税数量限制；例外须另论。
explanations: WTO当事方一般为members。
许可制度如实施数量限制也可能受XI约束。
正确。数量上限是典型quantitative restriction。
GATT并不要求一切关税清零。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Export restrictions
questions.stem: A member prohibits all exports of a mineral solely to give domestic processors cheaper inputs. No exception or special rule is established. Which is best?
options: GATT never addresses exports.
A domestic price advantage automatically creates an exception.
Only a formal tariff can raise a GATT issue.
Article XI generally covers export prohibitions as well as import restrictions.
questions.translation: GATT数量限制规则是否也管出口禁令？
questions.rule: 出口措施须看具体规则和例外，不能仅因出口而排除GATT。
explanations: 不能把GATT缩成只管进口。
保护本地投入品价格不自动免责。
非关税措施也受约束。
正确。XI包括出口禁止／限制。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Border duty与internal tax
questions.stem: A charge is imposed solely because goods cross the border, not as an internal tax also borne by domestic goods. Which is the best starting classification?
options: An import duty or border charge, whose legal basis differs from internal taxation.
Necessarily an internal tax simply because payment is collected by a bank.
Automatically national treatment-compliant because the state wants revenue.
A private contractual price.
questions.translation: 因进口过境而征的费用与境内同类产品税怎样区分？
questions.rule: GATT II与III各有对象；在边境征收不自动说明税的实体性质。
explanations: 正确。看征收原因和结构，不能只看收款地点。
付款方式不是分类标准。
收入目的不消除条约约束。
政府征收非私人约价。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: MFN tariff preference
questions.stem: A member charges 2% on a product from member A and 8% on the like product from member B. No free-trade-area, preference, waiver, or other exception applies. Which concern is most direct?
options: No WTO concern because both products are imported.
Most-favoured-nation discrimination between foreign origins.
National treatment solely comparing imported and domestic taxes.
A mandatory right to impose any rate below 20%.
questions.translation: 对不同WTO成员的同类进口品设不同关税且无例外，涉及什么？
questions.rule: MFN一般要求相关优势对其他成员同类产品立即无条件给予，具体例外另查。
explanations: 进口来源之间正是MFN的重要比较。
正确。题干排除了可能例外。
本题比较的是两个外国来源。
不存在这种普遍安全税率。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: FTA并非毫无条件的例外
questions.stem: Two members claim their discriminatory tariff preference is justified by a free-trade area. Which is best?
options: WTO rules prohibit every regional trade agreement without exception.
An FTA removes all obligations toward nonmembers.
They must satisfy the relevant WTO requirements; calling an arrangement an FTA is not conclusive.
Every bilateral preference is automatically valid.
questions.translation: 自称自由贸易区，是否就当然可以差别优惠？
questions.rule: 区域协定例外须符合适用条款，不能仅凭标签。
explanations: 条约容许符合条件的安排。
对外义务不因此全部消失。
正确。GATT XXIV等有具体条件。
名字不替代实质要求。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Internal tax discrimination
questions.stem: A member applies a 12% internal sales tax to imported wine and 5% to like domestic wine. No relevant exception is shown. Which rule is most directly implicated?
options: A ban on every internal tax at any rate.
The rule that only foreign exporters pay domestic tax.
A guarantee of preferential treatment for domestic goods.
GATT Article III national treatment on internal taxation.
questions.translation: 进口与国内同类酒品承担不同内部销售税，适用什么原则？
questions.rule: Article III税收规则与普通边境关税区别；likeness等条件仍须满足。
explanations: 国内税并非一律禁止。
产品来源歧视才是本题重点。
条约不提供这种普遍保护本地权。
正确。此处比较进口与国内同类产品的内部税负。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Less favourable internal regulation
questions.stem: Like imported products face extra domestic distribution restrictions that worsen their competitive opportunities compared with like domestic products. Which GATT inquiry is most relevant?
options: Less favourable treatment under internal-regulation national treatment rules.
Whether the statute uses the word tax.
Whether the importer is popular.
Whether all customs tariffs are zero.
questions.translation: 境内销售规制使同类进口品竞争条件更差，如何分析？
questions.rule: GATT III:4涉及内部销售、运输、分销、使用等规制中的不利待遇。
explanations: 正确。看对竞争条件的不利待遇，不只看文字。
内部规制不必叫税。
公众喜好不是法律标准。
关税为零不能消除内部歧视问题。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Like products的分析
questions.stem: A dispute requires deciding whether two products are "like." Which approach is sound?
options: Only the color of packaging can ever matter.
Examine the relevant provision and pertinent product characteristics, uses, consumer preferences, and competition.
All foreign goods are automatically like all domestic goods.
The label foreign alone settles likeness.
questions.translation: 认定like products是否只看外国／本国标签？
questions.rule: “同类”不能按日常近似随意判断；相关比较因素和条款语境重要。
explanations: 不能机械只用一个因素。
正确。Likeness是依具体条款和相关事实的分析。
不同商品不能仅因来源而等同。
来源不代替商品比较。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Health justification与necessity
questions.stem: A member invokes GATT XX(b) to justify a trade restriction protecting human health. Which is most accurate?
options: Only purely economic interests may ever be protected.
Article XX(b) has no conditions.
The measure must satisfy the paragraph’s necessity inquiry and the Article XX chapeau.
Any health label automatically defeats every obligation.
questions.translation: 以保护健康援引XX(b)，是否只需说明目标重要？
questions.rule: Health目标与手段审查分开；necessity与chapeau均需满足。
explanations: XX(b)明确涉及生命健康。
必要性和chapeau不能省略。
正确。正当目标仍须对应具体条件。
标签不等于证明。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Conservation与国内限制
questions.stem: A member invokes GATT XX(g) for conserving an exhaustible natural resource. Which feature matters under that paragraph?
options: Domestic production must always be unrestricted.
Any protectionist resource subsidy automatically qualifies.
Only living resources can ever be exhaustible.
The measure relates to conservation and is made effective with restrictions on domestic production or consumption.
questions.translation: 资源保护例外中，国内生产或消费限制有何意义？
questions.rule: XX(g)用relating to等具体措辞，不应与XX(b)所有条件机械混同。
explanations: 不能只限外国而忽略该条件。
仍须符合条款及chapeau。
资源范围不能这样绝对限缩。
正确。XX(g)包含与国内生产／消费限制相配合的要求。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Arbitrary discrimination in application
questions.stem: A measure fits an Article XX paragraph but is applied to identical conditions in two countries in an arbitrarily discriminatory way. Which is best?
options: It may still fail the chapeau despite meeting the paragraph.
Meeting a paragraph makes all applications immune.
The chapeau applies only to domestic criminal trials.
The measure is valid if its title mentions fairness.
questions.translation: 已符合XX某分项，任意歧视的适用是否仍有问题？
questions.rule: 分项正当性不自动消灭chapeau下的任意或不合理歧视等限制。
explanations: 正确。两个层面都要通过。
适用方式仍可能使例外失败。
Chapeau是XX开头的适用约束。
标题不能替代事实。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Publication of trade rules
questions.stem: A government enforces a new import licensing rule without publishing it, preventing traders from knowing the applicable requirements. Which GATT principle is most directly relevant?
options: The right of governments to keep every trade rule secret.
Transparency and publication of trade regulations under Article X.
A rule making every unpublished private contract void.
A general requirement that all imports be subsidized.
questions.translation: 进口许可规则不公开就执行，涉及什么？
questions.rule: GATT X规定有关贸易规章的公布和管理要求；具体例外及范围另看。
explanations: 不能用保密笼统排除公开义务。
正确。贸易规章公开使经营者知道规则。
本题是政府贸易规章。
不存在普遍补贴要求。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Dumping的比较基准
questions.stem: An imported product sells cheaply. What is needed to identify dumping rather than merely a low price?
options: Any price below a domestic rival’s price automatically suffices.
Proof that the exporter is foreign, with no price comparison.
The applicable comparison between export price and normal value, under the governing rules.
Proof only that a domestic rival dislikes the price.
questions.translation: 低价进口是否就等于dumping？
questions.rule: Dumping不等于便宜；反倾销措施还涉及其他条件和调查。
explanations: 竞争者售价不是当然normal value。
外国来源不能代替dumping认定。
正确。Dumping有特定比较方法。
不满不是法律标准。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Anti-dumping不是自动加税
questions.stem: Assume dumping is established. Before an anti-dumping duty is lawfully imposed, which further matters ordinarily require examination?
options: Only whether the exporter has an unfamiliar brand.
No further condition at all.
Whether a single consumer complained about packaging.
Material injury or threat, causal connection, and the required investigation.
questions.translation: 确认dumping后是否就可任意征反倾销税？
questions.rule: 通常还要有适用的产业损害、因果联系及合规调查，不能单看低价。
explanations: 品牌陌生不是该条件。
仍有实体和程序要求。
个别包装投诉不是替代标准。
正确。Dumping本身不自动授权任意反倾销税。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Safeguard与unfair trade区分
questions.stem: Imports increase sharply and cause serious injury to a domestic industry, even though the imports are fairly traded. Which trade-remedy category is designed for this kind of emergency, subject to its requirements?
options: Safeguards.
A rule requiring proof of dumping in every case.
An automatic permanent import ban.
A private defamation action.
questions.translation: 公平交易的进口激增造成严重产业损害，可考虑哪类救济？
questions.rule: Safeguards与anti-dumping／countervailing不同，不能把所有救济都叫反倾销。
explanations: 正确。Safeguards关注激增进口及serious injury等。
不一定要有dumping。
措施仍受期限和程序等限制。
不是私人名誉纠纷。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Subsidy与dumping区分
questions.stem: A government makes a financial contribution that confers a benefit on a producer. Which characterization is the relevant starting point for subsidy analysis?
options: A guarantee that no trade remedy can apply.
A potentially relevant subsidy, with specificity and other applicable requirements still to examine.
Dumping is conclusively established without any price comparison.
Every government payment is automatically a prohibited subsidy.
questions.translation: 政府财政支持带来benefit，怎样与dumping区别？
questions.rule: Subsidy与dumping是不同概念；反补贴或禁止补贴须满足进一步要求。
explanations: 须继续按规则评估。
正确。补贴分析有具体定义及进一步条件。
补贴与出口价低于normal value不同。
并非所有补贴一律禁止。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Specific commitments
questions.stem: A member’s services schedule lists a sector and mode with stated limitations. What is the correct approach to market-access obligations?
options: Ignore the mode of supply.
Treat the schedule as unrelated to legal obligations.
Read that specific scheduled commitment and its limitations.
Assume every service sector is fully opened worldwide.
questions.translation: 服务市场准入为何要读schedule的sector和mode？
questions.rule: GATS specific commitments按部门与提供方式记录，不能用一般贸易直觉替代。
explanations: 同一sector不同mode可不同。
Schedules构成具体承诺的重要依据。
正确。Sector、mode、limitations都重要。
GATS不是全面无条件开放。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: National treatment的承诺范围
questions.stem: A GATS national-treatment claim concerns a service sector and mode. Which must be checked?
options: Only whether the service is intangible.
Whether all foreign suppliers are large corporations.
An assumption that every member committed every mode without limitations.
Whether and to what extent the member undertook the relevant scheduled national-treatment commitment.
questions.translation: 服务贸易national treatment是否不看具体承诺就普遍适用？
questions.rule: GATS的national treatment与GATT货物规则的结构不可直接互换。
explanations: 无形性不决定承诺范围。
企业大小不是该入口。
不能假定全面承诺。
正确。Article XVII要结合specific commitments。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Governmental authority双条件
questions.stem: Under GATS Article I:3, services supplied in the exercise of governmental authority are defined as supplied neither on a commercial basis nor in competition with other suppliers. Which meets that definition on the stated facts?
options: A service supplied on neither basis.
Any service supplied by a state-owned company for profit in competition.
Every hospital service regardless of its operation.
Every regulated service.
questions.translation: GATS政府权力服务排除是否只看国有身份？
questions.rule: 看供给方式；neither commercial nor competitive不能误读成只满足其中一个即可。
explanations: 正确。题干两项否定条件须同时满足。
国有本身不够，且有商业竞争。
医院身份不自动决定排除。
监管不等于政府权力服务。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: MFN与specific commitments不同
questions.stem: A student says GATS MFN matters only in sectors listed as fully liberalized in a member’s schedule. Which correction is best?
options: Unscheduled services are automatically outside the entire GATS.
MFN is generally a general obligation, subject to applicable exemptions and exceptions; specific commitments are a separate inquiry.
MFN and market access are identical provisions.
Every MFN exemption is permanently unlimited.
questions.translation: GATS MFN是否只在全面开放部门有意义？
questions.rule: GATS general obligations、specific commitments及Article II豁免分别分析。
explanations: 未承诺不等于GATS整体完全不适用。
正确。一般义务与具体承诺分开。
不同条款承担不同功能。
豁免须按其制度和条件理解。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Numerical supplier limit
questions.stem: A member has made a full market-access commitment for a sector and mode, with no relevant reservation. It then caps suppliers at three. Which GATS issue is most direct?
options: Automatic compliance if all three suppliers are foreign.
The law of wills.
A numerical limitation of a kind addressed by Article XVI.
A rule that supplier limits are never market-access measures.
questions.translation: 已无保留承诺市场准入，却限定最多三家供应者，涉及哪条？
questions.rule: Market access不只等于nationality discrimination；数量上限也可能违反承诺。
explanations: 即使不按国籍歧视，也可能是market access限制。
不是继承问题。
正确。供应者数量上限是XVI列举类型之一。
条约明确涉及此类限制。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Higher protection不必违法
questions.stem: A member provides intellectual-property protection above TRIPS minimum standards. Which is best?
options: Minimum standards are mandatory maximums.
Every member must use identical domestic statutes.
Higher protection automatically creates a worldwide patent.
TRIPS permits more extensive protection if it does not contravene the agreement.
questions.translation: TRIPS最低标准是否同时就是保护上限？
questions.rule: More extensive protection与minimum standards可以并存，但仍须不违反TRIPS。
explanations: 最低标准并非最高上限。
成员可选择国内实施方法。
国内保护不等于全球授权。
正确。Article1.1允许不抵触协定的更广保护。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · WTO

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: National treatment保护对象
questions.stem: Under TRIPS national treatment, what comparison is central, subject to the agreement’s exceptions?
options: Treatment of other members’ nationals compared with a member’s own nationals regarding intellectual-property protection.
Only imported wheat compared with domestic wheat.
Two different criminal sentences unrelated to IP.
A rule granting patent rights without an application.
questions.translation: TRIPS的national treatment主要比较什么？
questions.rule: TRIPS与GATT都用national treatment，但保护对象、条件和例外不同。
explanations: 正确。TRIPS按nationals及IP protection比较。
这是GATT式货物比较，不是本题对象。
与知识产权保护无关。
国民待遇不免除各项合法程序。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · WTO

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: MFN与外国国民
questions.stem: A member gives nationals of one foreign country an IP-protection advantage. What is the general TRIPS MFN starting point, subject to exceptions?
options: MFN abolishes the distinction between patents and trademarks.
Such an advantage generally must be extended immediately and unconditionally to nationals of other members.
It may always reserve the advantage to a favored nationality without analysis.
Only domestic nationals benefit from MFN.
questions.translation: TRIPS对某外国国民给予保护优势，MFN一般要求什么？
questions.rule: TRIPS Article4的一般义务及列明例外须结合阅读。
explanations: 不改变各类知识产权的制度区分。
正确。仍须查TRIPS适用例外。
偏好来源不是普遍免责理由。
MFN比较不同外国来源的国民待遇。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Consultations先行
questions.stem: A member alleges another member violates a covered WTO agreement. Which is the ordinary initial dispute-settlement step before requesting adjudication, subject to applicable procedures?
options: A private exporter directly issues a binding panel report.
Automatically seize all imports without procedure.
Request consultations to seek a mutually satisfactory solution.
Immediately order the other member’s police to arrest officials.
questions.translation: WTO争端正式裁判前通常先做什么？
questions.rule: DSU Article4重视磋商；紧急等程序及时间条件须按规则。
explanations: 私人公司不能自行作panel裁判。
不得任意跳过条约程序报复。
正确。Consultations是通常程序起点。
WTO不是跨国刑事警察机制。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · WTO
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Retaliation须走程序
questions.stem: A member alleges a WTO violation and immediately retaliates without using required DSU procedures or authorization. Which is best?
options: Any allegation automatically authorizes unlimited sanctions.
Private companies may authorize WTO retaliation.
The DSU concerns only criminal punishment.
Unilateral retaliation is constrained by the DSU; suspension of concessions requires the applicable procedures and authorization.
questions.translation: 认为对方违约，能否不经WTO程序自行无限报复？
questions.rule: DSU23约束单方判定／救济；依DSU22中止减让须符合具体条件。
explanations: 单方指控不等于授权。
企业不是DSB授权机关。
主要涉及成员间条约义务与救济。
正确。争端解决与执行均有程序限制。

questions.subject: WTO
questions.title: Compliance与赔偿方向
questions.stem: A panel finds a measure inconsistent with a covered agreement. What is the ordinary DSU recommendation?
options: Bring the measure into conformity with the agreement.
Automatically award each private exporter tort damages.
Imprison the trade minister.
Annul all domestic statutes worldwide.
questions.translation: Panel认定措施违约，通常建议什么？
questions.rule: DSU19的通常方向是bring the measure into conformity；执行及补偿／中止减让另按规则。
explanations: 正确。通常要求使措施符合协定。
WTO争端不是企业侵权赔偿诉讼。
不是刑事定罪机关。
裁判没有这种无限效力。

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Denying the antecedent
questions.stem: All certified interpreters passed examination E. Dana is not a certified interpreter. Which conclusion follows from these facts alone?
options: Nobody who passed E can be uncertified.
It is undetermined whether Dana passed E.
Dana necessarily failed E.
Dana necessarily passed E.
questions.translation: 所有认证译员都通过E，Dana未认证，能否推出她未通过？
questions.rule: P→Q与¬P不推出¬Q；缺少充分条件不决定必要条件是否存在。
explanations: 把必要条件倒置成充分条件。
正确。Certified→passed，不能从非certified推出非passed。
这是denying the antecedent。
同样没有足够信息。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Unless的方向
questions.stem: The rule says: "Unless a filing is timely, it will be rejected." A filing was not rejected. What must be true under this rule?
options: Every timely filing must be accepted.
No filing can ever be rejected.
It was timely.
It was late.
questions.translation: 除非及时提交，否则拒绝；现未被拒绝，必然推出什么？
questions.rule: 先把unless转为条件命题，再用逆否；不能偷换充分与必要条件。
explanations: 及时不一定足以接受，可能有其他要求。
规则并无此意思。
正确。非及时→拒绝，逆否为未拒绝→及时。
与逆否结论冲突。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Only if不等于if
questions.stem: A benefit is paid only if both eligibility and filing requirements are met. Which conclusion is valid?
options: Meeting eligibility alone guarantees payment.
Filing alone guarantees payment.
Payment implies that neither requirement was met.
Payment implies that both requirements were met.
questions.translation: 仅当两条件同时满足才支付，支付可以推出什么？
questions.rule: Only if引入必要条件；both A and B不等于A or B。
explanations: 只满足一个必要条件不足。
同理，未给出足够条件。
与原句相反。
正确。Paid→eligible且filed。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Some与all的范围
questions.stem: All advocates are trained. Some trained people are bilingual. Which must follow?
options: All advocates are trained; nothing stated guarantees a bilingual advocate.
All advocates are bilingual.
Some advocates must be bilingual.
No advocate can be bilingual.
questions.translation: 所有advocates受训，有些受训者双语，能否推出有双语advocate？
questions.rule: 共享大集合不保证两个子集相交。
explanations: 正确。两组trained中的成员不一定重合。
把some扩大成all。
没有给出交集中的advocate。
也未给出排斥关系。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: No A are B
questions.stem: No licensed broker is barred from practice. Lee is barred from practice. Which follows?
options: Every person is either licensed or barred.
Lee is not a licensed broker.
Lee is licensed.
Every unlicensed person is barred.
questions.translation: 没有licensed broker被禁业，Lee被禁业，能推出什么？
questions.rule: No A are B等价A→¬B，也可推出B→¬A。
explanations: 未给出穷尽分类。
正确。Licensed→not barred；barred→not licensed。
与给定关系冲突。
不能从非licensed倒推barred。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: At least one的存在
questions.stem: Every member of club A is a lawyer. The passage gives no information about whether club A has any members. Which is safest?
options: Every lawyer belongs to A.
No lawyer belongs to A.
The universal statement alone does not establish that a lawyer belongs to club A.
At least one lawyer necessarily belongs to A.
questions.translation: All A are lawyers但未说A有成员，是否必然有律师属于A？
questions.rule: 不能擅自从全称规则推出至少一个实例；要检查existence premise。
explanations: 把单向包含倒置。
原文也不保证A为空。
正确。现代逻辑不自动给全称命题加入存在前提。
没有已存在成员的条件。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Inclusive or
questions.stem: A permit requires condition A or condition B, or both. Which situation fails that stated condition?
options: Only A is met.
Only B is met.
Both A and B are met.
Neither A nor B is met.
questions.translation: A或B或两者均可，哪种情况不满足？
questions.rule: 区分inclusive or与exclusive or，不能自行加入“只能一个”。
explanations: 满足A已经够这一条件。
满足B也够。
题干明确or both。
正确。Inclusive or至少满足一个。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: 新成本与净节约
questions.stem: A firm argues that buying an expensive machine will reduce its total costs because it lowers labor costs. Which assumption is necessary for the conclusion?
options: The machine’s added costs will not entirely offset the relevant labor savings.
Every worker will leave the firm.
The machine has the newest paint color.
Labor costs are the firm’s only conceivable expense.
questions.translation: 降低人工成本就能推出总成本降低，还缺什么？
questions.rule: 净效果需比较新增支出与节约，不能只看一项收益。
explanations: 正确。若新增成本完全抵消节约，总成本不会下降。
不必全员离开。
与净成本关系无关。
这是过强假设，并非必要。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Missing bridge
questions.stem: A policy works only if inspectors can detect violations. The analyst concludes that the policy will work but gives no information about detection. Which assumption is required?
options: All citizens support the policy.
Inspectors can detect violations.
Every detected violation leads to the maximum penalty.
The policy has no administrative costs.
questions.translation: Works only if detectable，断定works必须依赖什么？
questions.rule: 找必要假设时检查否定后是否与结论的必要条件冲突。
explanations: 全民支持不是已给的必要条件。
正确。这是题设明确必要条件。
最大处罚并非题设要求。
零成本过强。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Correlation与confounding
questions.stem: Cities with more libraries have more reported thefts. An author concludes libraries cause theft. Which fact most undermines that inference?
options: Some libraries close at night.
The author likes cities.
Larger populations independently increase both library numbers and total theft reports.
Libraries contain books.
questions.translation: 图书馆多与盗窃报告多相关，为什么不能直接推因果？
questions.rule: Correlation需要排查共同原因、反向因果和其他解释。
explanations: 未直接排除或解释总体相关。
个人偏好不足以分析数据。
正确。共同原因可解释两者相关。
未说明因果关联为何有误。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Reverse causation
questions.stem: Firms using consultants have poor sales. A report concludes consultants cause poor sales. Which alternative most directly challenges the causal direction?
options: Consultants use computers.
Some firms sell different products.
Consultants receive payment.
Firms with declining sales are more likely to hire consultants.
questions.translation: 聘顾问公司销量差，可能是哪种反向解释？
questions.rule: Outcome导致选择某措施，与措施导致outcome要区分。
explanations: 工具使用不改变因果方向。
太笼统，未直接解释选择。
付费本身不说明谁先导致谁。
正确。可能是销量差促使聘请顾问。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Regression to the mean
questions.stem: A school selects pupils after one exceptionally low test score, tutors them, and treats later average scores as proof tutoring caused the increase. What is a key concern?
options: Some improvement may reflect regression toward typical performance without tutoring.
Every later score must be fabricated.
Tutoring can never help anyone.
A low score proves permanent inability.
questions.translation: 专挑一次极低分者再观察提升，为什么不能全归功于辅导？
questions.rule: 极端观测可能自然回到通常水平；因果评价需要适当比较。
explanations: 正确。以极端一次表现筛人会有回归均值问题。
没有造假证据。
这是过强否定。
一次低分不能证明永久能力。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Self-selected survey
questions.stem: An online poll open only to volunteers reports that 95% support a proposal. The author generalizes to all residents. What information is most important?
options: Whether the proposal has a short name.
Whether volunteers represent the broader resident population.
Whether the website uses blue headings.
Whether every volunteer owns a pen.
questions.translation: 自愿网络投票能否直接代表全体居民？
questions.rule: 样本大或比例高也不能自动消除selection bias。
explanations: 名称长短不解决抽样偏差。
正确。Self-selection可能使支持者过度出现。
颜色不解决代表性。
拥有笔无关。

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Survivorship bias
questions.stem: A study examines only companies still operating after ten years and finds all used strategy S. It concludes S guarantees survival. What is missing?
options: Proof that no company ever used another strategy.
A longer title for the study.
Information about companies that used S but failed.
The surviving firms’ favorite colors.
questions.translation: 只看存活公司都用了S，为什么不能说S保证存活？
questions.rule: Survivorship bias忽略未进入样本的失败案例。
explanations: Guarantee需要更严证据，C也不是恰当现有推断。
标题不改变方法。
正确。只看幸存者会漏掉采取同策的失败者。
无关变量不能补样本。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Hasty generalization
questions.stem: A reviewer tries two unusually busy restaurants on one holiday and concludes every restaurant in the country has poor service. The clearest flaw is:
options: Using a conclusion supported by every restaurant’s records.
Proving a universal rule with an exhaustive census.
Distinguishing a premise from a conclusion correctly.
Generalizing from a small, atypical sample to a much broader population.
questions.translation: 节日只吃两家店却概括全国，是什么缺陷？
questions.rule: 结论的范围不能大幅超出样本所能支持的范围。
explanations: 并未查全国记录。
不是全体普查。
D不是这个错误的描述。
正确。数量、时点和代表性均不足。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Average不决定individual
questions.stem: The average income of department A exceeds that of department B. Which follows from that fact alone?
options: It does not establish that every A employee earns more than every B employee.
Every A employee earns more than every B employee.
No B employee can be highly paid.
A has more employees than B.
questions.translation: A部门平均工资更高，是否人人都比B部门高？
questions.rule: Group average与individual distribution区分，注意all等量词。
explanations: 正确。平均比较不能逐人排序。
把均值扩成每个个体关系。
B仍可能有高收入者。
均值不决定人数。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Percentage与absolute number
questions.stem: Complaints fell from 10% of 1,000 transactions to 8% of 2,000 transactions. What happened to the number of complaints?
options: The percentages alone prove every customer became happier.
It rose from 100 to 160.
It fell from 100 to 80.
It stayed at 100.
questions.translation: 投诉比例下降但交易翻倍，投诉绝对数量怎样变化？
questions.rule: 比例变化与绝对量变化不同；先找分母。
explanations: 不支持每个顾客的情绪判断。
正确。需用各期分母相乘。
误把第二期分母仍当1000。
忽略交易数量变化。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Base rate
questions.stem: In a fictional screening exercise, 10 of 1,000 items are defective. A test flags all 10 and also 90 sound items. What fraction of flagged items is defective?
questions.translation: 已被标记的物品中缺陷比例，分母是谁？
questions.rule: 条件比例必须按所问条件选分母；这是虚构筛选练习。
explanations: 把非缺陷数当缺陷数。
忽略90个false positives。
正确。问的是被标记者，分母为100。
这是总体缺陷率，不是条件比例。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Rate与total
questions.stem: A town’s accident rate per trip falls by half, but the number of trips triples. Assuming those figures, total accidents would:
options: Necessarily fall by half.
Necessarily remain unchanged.
Become one third of the original number.
Become one and a half times the original number.
questions.translation: 每次出行事故率减半、出行量三倍，总事故数如何？
questions.rule: 比较总量时要同时考虑rate与exposure。
explanations: 只看rate未看暴露量。
两者变化并不恰好抵消。
不是把rate除以trips。
正确。Rate×trips＝0.5×3＝1.5。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Strengthen causal effect
questions.stem: A pilot program reduced defects at one factory. Which additional fact most strengthens the claim that the program caused the decline?
options: Comparable factories without the program showed no similar decline during the same period, and no other relevant changes differed.
The program’s name is memorable.
The factory existed for many years.
The manager praised the program before collecting data.
questions.translation: 一厂缺陷下降，哪项最增强归因于项目的论证？
questions.rule: Strengthen提高证据支持，不要求一项事实绝对证明所有因果。
explanations: 正确。对照和替代原因控制增加因果支持。
名称不说明效果。
历史长不排除共同原因。
事先评价不是效果证据。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Weaken plan
questions.stem: A library plans to increase weekday attendance by extending evening hours. Which fact most weakens the plan?
options: The building is older than nearby shops.
Most intended new users cannot travel to the library after dark and the extension changes no other access barrier.
The library has many shelves.
Some current users borrow novels.
questions.translation: 延长夜间开放以吸引新读者，哪项最削弱计划机制？
questions.rule: 攻击措施到目标之间的关键因果桥梁，比无关背景更有力。
explanations: 年龄不说明延时能否吸引人。
正确。直接削弱目标人群实际利用新增时段的能力。
不关关键机制。
现有借阅类型无关。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Evaluate预测所需信息
questions.stem: A city predicts parking revenue will rise after doubling fees. Which question most helps evaluate that prediction?
options: Whether every driver likes the mayor.
Whether the city has a long name.
How much parking demand will change in response to the higher fees.
Whether officials prefer blue uniforms.
questions.translation: 收费翻倍是否收入就翻倍，最需要了解什么？
questions.rule: Evaluate题寻找答案不同会显著改变论证支持程度的信息。
explanations: 喜好不是所需需求反应数据。
名称无关。
正确。收入取决于单价与使用量。
与收入机制无直接联系。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Resolve a paradox
questions.stem: A museum raised ticket prices, yet attendance increased. Which fact best explains how both can be true?
options: Higher prices make every person unable to attend.
The museum closed for the entire year.
No change affected visitors except a deterrent price increase.
A new popular exhibition and expanded transport access attracted many additional visitors.
questions.translation: 涨价但客流增加，哪项能解释表面矛盾？
questions.rule: Resolve题接受两项事实，找可同时容纳它们的条件。
explanations: 反而使现象更难解释。
与出席增加冲突。
排除可解释的需求变化。
正确。其他需求因素可超过价格抑制作用。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: False analogy
questions.stem: A public hospital should use the same customer-turnover target as a fast-food counter because both serve people. What most undermines this analogy?
options: Their service goals and consequences of rushing service differ in ways relevant to the target.
They both have doors.
Some people visit both.
Both may use signs.
questions.translation: 都服务公众就套同一周转指标，类比缺少什么？
questions.rule: 类比要比较与结论相关的相似和差异，不是任找一个共同点。
explanations: 正确。相关差异直接影响类比的可迁移性。
共同外观不足支持目标相同。
客户重叠不消除关键差异。
标牌相同无关。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Equivocation
questions.stem: A notice says admission is "free," meaning no charge. An argument concludes visitors are therefore free to ignore all rules. The flaw is:
options: Proving that every rule is a price.
Shifting the meaning of "free" between price and unrestricted action.
Using a valid definition consistently.
Drawing a numerical sample too small.
questions.translation: Free入场被推成free不守规则，犯了什么错？
questions.rule: Equivocation是关键用语在推理中偷换含义。
explanations: 这不是有效证明。
正确。同一词在前提和结论中含义不同。
并未保持同义。
不是抽样问题。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Circular reasoning
questions.stem: "This rule is fair because it is just, and it is just because it is fair." What is the central problem?
options: It proves a causal law using new evidence.
It distinguishes two independent standards with supporting facts.
The asserted support restates the conclusion without independent justification.
It supplies a controlled experiment.
questions.translation: 用fair解释just再用just解释fair，为什么没有增加支持？
questions.rule: Circular reasoning没有提供独立于待证结论的依据。
explanations: 没有新增因果证据。
没有独立事实支撑。
正确。理由只是用近义词转述结论。
没有实验。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Ad hominem
questions.stem: An analyst rejects an engineer’s bridge calculation solely because the engineer is rude, without examining the calculation. Which criticism is strongest?
options: Rudeness mathematically proves an arithmetic error.
Every rude person is necessarily unqualified.
Calculations cannot be checked independently.
The personal attack does not address whether the calculation is sound.
questions.translation: 只凭工程师无礼就否定计算，主要问题？
questions.rule: 来源可信度有时相关，但无关人格攻击不能替代对论证本身的评价。
explanations: 性格不自动决定算式真假。
这种全称没有依据。
计算可独立核验。
正确。需针对主张的证据或推导。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Popularity与truth
questions.stem: Most residents believe a bridge can carry a certain load. An argument treats that popularity alone as proof of its actual engineering capacity. What is wrong?
options: A belief’s popularity alone does not establish the physical claim’s truth.
Every popular belief is necessarily false.
Residents can never know engineering.
A majority vote changes the bridge’s physical structure.
questions.translation: 多数人相信桥能承重，是否仅凭多数即可证明物理命题？
questions.rule: Appeal to popularity不能单独证明需要独立事实依据的命题。
explanations: 正确。应看工程证据。
不能反向极端化。
居民也可能有知识，但题干只给人数。
投票不会自动改变物理承载力。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。
source.material: LEC知识库/02_知识点/逻辑推理

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Conjunction与necessary conditions
questions.stem: Every approved application is both complete and timely. This application is complete but late. What follows?
options: Nothing can be inferred even about approval.
It cannot be approved under the stated rule.
It must be approved because it is complete.
It must be timely because complete and timely mean the same thing.
questions.translation: Approved→complete且timely，完整但逾期，能推出什么？
questions.rule: ¬(A且B)包括任一条件不满足；不要把and误读成or。
explanations: 可用规则的逆否排除批准。
正确。缺少timely这一必要条件。
两个必要条件不能只满足一个。
两个词义不同。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Main conclusion
questions.stem: "The old roof leaks. Repairing it repeatedly now costs more than replacement would cost over five years. Therefore the council should replace it this year." What is the main conclusion?
options: Repeated repairs are costly.
The passage contains no recommendation.
The council should replace the roof this year.
The roof leaks.
questions.translation: 论证主结论是哪句，而非哪句提供理由？
questions.rule: Conclusion是作者要建立的主张；背景或证据可以为真但不是主结论。
explanations: 这是经济比较前提。
明确有should建议。
正确。Therefore后是要支持的建议。
这是事实前提。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Concession的作用
questions.stem: "Although the proposal is expensive, its demonstrated benefits exceed its costs, so it should be adopted." What role does the first clause play?
options: It states the final recommendation.
It denies that the proposal costs anything.
It proves adoption is impossible.
It acknowledges a consideration against adoption before offering a stronger supporting reason.
questions.translation: Although引导的昂贵这一点，在论证中扮演什么角色？
questions.rule: 识别concession有助于避免把反方考虑误读成作者最终结论。
explanations: 结论在should be adopted。
与expensive相反。
贵不等于不可能。
正确。Although引出让步／不利考虑。

source.label: LEC专项自编 · 逻辑推理
source.note: 依据保留的LEC范围及所列规则独立编写；非LEC历年原题，非NCBE官方MBE题。

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Self-undermining revenue plan
questions.stem: A government taxes gasoline heavily to reduce driving and promises to finance a fixed long-term project entirely from that tax. Which concern follows if the driving-reduction plan succeeds dramatically?
options: Its tax base may shrink, threatening the promised revenue.
Lower gasoline sales necessarily increase revenue without limit.
Driving has no relation to gasoline-tax receipts.
The plan guarantees every spending goal.
questions.translation: 减少驾车的汽油税，同时依赖固定税收筹资，会有什么张力？
questions.rule: 措施可能削弱自身依赖的条件；区分行为目标与筹资目标。
explanations: 正确。政策成功可能削弱自身筹资基础。
税率与税基共同决定收入。
题干明确用该消费税筹资。
没有这种保证。

questions.title: Trend与market saturation
questions.stem: Video-game sales have risen for three years. An author predicts continued growth solely from that trend. Which fact most weakens the forecast?
options: Past growth actually occurred.
Most potential buyers have recently acquired durable systems and few need replacements soon.
Some buyers enjoy games.
The product has a short name.
questions.translation: 过去增长就一定持续吗，哪项最削弱外推？

questions.subject: 逻辑推理
questions.title: Absence of evidence
questions.stem: A theory predicts a visible remnant, but no remnant has yet been detected with limited instruments. Which is the most cautious inference?
options: Every theory is immune to contrary evidence.
The remnant definitely exists because it has not been found.
The absence may challenge the theory but does not by itself conclusively show no remnant exists.
Nondetection always proves nonexistence.
questions.translation: 仪器有限而未找到预测遗迹，能否立即认定不存在？
questions.rule: Absence of evidence与evidence of absence取决于本应能检测到的程度。
explanations: 理论仍须面对证据。
反向推定也无依据。
正确。需看检测能力及预测强度。
把没发现直接等同绝不存在过强。

questions.subject: 术语与文化
questions.title: Verdict
questions.stem: In a jury trial, which term ordinarily describes the jury’s determination of the factual issues submitted to it?
options: Verdict.
Indictment.
Deposition.
Statute.
questions.translation: 陪审团对提交问题作出的裁断，通常叫什么？
questions.rule: Verdict与法院最终judgment、起诉indictment分开。
explanations: 正确。Verdict是陪审团对所交事实问题的裁断。
Indictment是起诉文件。
Deposition是审前宣誓作证记录／程序。
Statute是制定法。

Venue.

Burden of pleading.

Law printed only in black ink.

It must follow that controlling authority within the relevant legal hierarchy, subject to lawful distinctions.
