questions.subject: 术语与文化
questions.title: Precedent
questions.stem: Which most closely defines a judicial precedent?
options: A contractual promise to pay a deposit.
A prior decision used as authority or guidance in deciding a later legal question.
The introductory purpose paragraph of every statute.
A person who chairs a meeting.
questions.translation: Precedent指人还是先前裁判权威？
questions.rule: Precedent与president、precedence注意区分；先例可能binding或persuasive。
explanations: 不是先例。
正确。效力须看法院层级及holding等。
这是preamble类概念。
与president拼写／词义区别。

questions.subject: 术语与文化
questions.title: Written instrument
questions.stem: A statute refers to a "written instrument" creating legal rights or obligations. Which is the best meaning?
options: Only handwritten notes with no legal significance.
An oral conversation that was never recorded.
A formal legal document, such as a deed or contract.
Only a musical instrument.
questions.translation: Written instrument在法律文书语境是什么意思？
questions.rule: Instrument可指具法律意义的文件；是否有效还须看形式和内容条件。
explanations: 不局限于无法律意义的便笺。
Written不能忽略。
正确。Instrument在此是法律文件。
不要只按乐器翻译。

questions.subject: 术语与文化
questions.title: True bill
questions.stem: A grand jury returns a true bill. What does that ordinarily signify?
options: The defendant has already been convicted at trial.
The government has paid a correct invoice.
A civil jury has assessed damages.
It finds sufficient basis to indict, not a final determination of guilt.
questions.translation: Grand jury作出true bill，是否表示已定罪？
questions.rule: True bill属于起诉决定；罪责仍须依后续程序判断。
explanations: Indictment不等于conviction。
Bill在此不是普通账单。
不是民事损害裁断。
正确。Grand jury起诉门槛与trial定罪不同。

questions.subject: 术语与文化
questions.title: Prima facie
questions.stem: Evidence is sufficient to establish a prima facie case. Which is the best basic meaning?
options: It supports the required case if unrebutted, without necessarily deciding the ultimate outcome.
It conclusively wins regardless of contrary evidence.
It proves every unrelated claim.
It means no evidence exists.
questions.translation: Prima facie case是否就等于最终一定胜诉？
questions.rule: Prima facie在不同制度中后果可能不同，但不能一律译为不可推翻的证明。
explanations: 正确。初步足以支持与最终必胜有区别。
反证及最终负担仍可能改变结果。
只涉及相应要素。
与无证据相反。

questions.subject: 术语与文化
questions.title: Opening statement
questions.stem: At the start of trial, counsel outlines what the evidence is expected to show. What is this ordinarily called?
options: Judicial sentence.
Opening statement.
Closing argument.
Jury verdict.
questions.translation: 审判开始时律师说明预计证据将证明什么，叫什么？
questions.rule: Opening statement本身不是证据；应与closing argument、testimony区分。
explanations: Sentence是刑罚裁定等。
正确。是对预计证据和案件的开场说明。
Closing在证据之后作结案论述。
Verdict由事实裁判者作出。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Article 2的入口
questions.stem: A retailer contracts to buy 500 movable saw blades for $5,000. The jurisdiction has adopted UCC Article 2. Which law principally governs this sales contract?
options: Only common-law service-contract rules, because a salesperson negotiated it.
Article 2 only if both parties also sign a separate merchant certificate.
Federal constitutional law exclusively, because the price exceeds $500.
UCC Article 2, because the transaction is a sale of goods.
questions.translation: 零售商购买500片可移动锯片，适用哪套合同规则？
questions.rule: Article 2的主要入口是sale of goods；是否商人与是否达到SOF金额门槛是后续不同问题。
explanations: 交易核心是货物买卖，不是代理人服务。
Article 2不限双方都为商人的交易。
500美元涉及某些书面形式要求，不变成联邦宪法合同。
正确。锯片属于货物。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: 纯服务合同
questions.stem: A contractor is hired only to repaint an existing house, using paint supplied by the owner. Which framework ordinarily governs the agreement?
options: Article 2 automatically, because every contract involves property.
No contract rules, because painting cannot be promised.
Common-law contract principles, because the principal transaction is a service.
UCC Article 2 automatically, because the contractor uses a brush.
questions.translation: 只雇人刷房屋、材料由屋主提供，主要适用什么？
questions.rule: 纯服务合同通常以common law为框架；使用动产工具不把服务变成货物买卖。
explanations: 涉及财物不等于货物买卖。
服务承诺同样可形成合同。
正确。付款换取刷漆服务。
工具不是本交易买卖对象。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Mixed transaction的主要目的
questions.stem: Assume the governing court uses the predominant-purpose test. A $20,000 agreement primarily buys a commercial oven; routine installation is incidental. Which conclusion is strongest?
options: Only the title printed on the invoice controls.
Article 2 may govern the transaction because the predominant purpose is buying the oven.
Installation automatically excludes Article 2 from the entire transaction.
The presence of any goods always excludes common law from every mixed contract.
questions.translation: 主要买烤箱、安装仅附带；适用主要目的测试，如何分析？
questions.rule: Mixed transaction依题设的predominant-purpose test综合判断货物与服务的核心，不机械看出现过哪种要素。
explanations: 合同实质、语言及交易目的均可相关。
正确。题干已给定核心是购买设备。
附带安装不必然改变主要目的。
服务为主的混合交易可能有不同结果。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Implied-in-fact contract
questions.stem: A customer knowingly requests a restaurant meal, eats it, and has every reason to know payment is expected. No price is spoken aloud. What best describes the ordinary basis for payment?
options: A contract inferred from the parties' conduct.
No agreement can exist without spoken words.
A gift conclusively arises whenever the price is not spoken.
A criminal fine imposed by the restaurant.
questions.translation: 点餐并食用，明知需付款，但没口头说价格，是什么合同路径？
questions.rule: Implied-in-fact contract从行为判断真实合意；它与为避免不当得利而拟制的quasi-contract不同。
explanations: 正确。请求并接受有偿服务可表现合意。
意思表示可以通过行为作出。
未口头议价不等于赠与。
私人餐厅不是在科处罚金。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Restitution与未完成服务
questions.stem: An unforeseen fire discharges a service contract after useful work has been performed. Assume the governing restitution rule permits recovery of a benefit conferred before discharge. What should the court measure?
options: Punitive damages equal to ten times the contract price.
The full contract price solely because work began.
Zero in every case because an express contract once existed.
The value of the benefit conferred, rather than automatically the same fraction of the contract price.
questions.translation: 服务因意外障碍免责，之前已给对方有用利益；返还金额看什么？
questions.rule: Discharge后的restitution可按获益价值分析，不自动按工作比例分配合同全价；本题明确给定可返还规则。
explanations: 本题没有惩罚性赔偿根据。
开始履行不等于已赚取全部价格。
免责不必然排除已给利益的返还。
正确。合同价与受益价值是不同衡量。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Bilateral promise exchange
questions.stem: A homeowner promises $900 for a repair, and the repairer promises to perform it next week. Both intend to be bound now. What is the usual classification?
options: An executed contract, because both promises were spoken.
A bailment, because the work concerns a house.
A bilateral contract formed by an exchange of promises.
A unilateral contract that cannot exist until the repair is finished.
questions.translation: 双方现在交换有约束力的承诺，属于什么？
questions.rule: Bilateral contract以承诺交换承诺；executed通常指已完全履行。
explanations: 说出承诺不等于完成履行。
这不是暂时交付动产保管。
正确。双方承诺本身构成交换。
题干不限定只能以完成行为接受。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Objective assent与双方知道的玩笑
questions.stem: During an obvious joke, Eric offers his $250,000 house for $50,000. Douglas knows Eric is joking and does not reasonably understand a serious bargain. Under the objective-assent rule, which is best?
options: Douglas can force a sale merely by delivering a check the next day.
The known joke does not create a serious contractual offer.
Every use of a price creates a contract despite the shared understanding.
The low price alone conclusively creates duress.
questions.translation: 对方知道是玩笑，仍能仅凭报过价要求卖房吗？
questions.rule: Objective assent看合理理解；明知对方开玩笑，不能把玩笑当作可接受的认真要约。低价本身也不等于无对价。
explanations: 事后递支票不能创造此前不存在的要约。
正确。题干排除了合理的认真交易理解。
语境与双方已知情况不能忽略。
低价不自动证明不当威胁。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: 广告通常邀请交易
questions.stem: A newspaper advertisement merely lists an apartment and an asking price, invites inquiries, and reserves seller approval. A reader announces "I accept." What is most accurate?
options: The advertisement is ordinarily an invitation to negotiate, so the reader's response does not alone form a contract.
Every advertisement is irrevocable for three months.
Any reader becomes the owner by saying "I accept."
The advertisement is a signed land deed.
questions.translation: 广告列房与要价、保留审批并邀请联系，读者一句接受就成交吗？
questions.rule: 一般广告是邀请提出offer；明确限量、承诺履行等事实可能改变判断，本题已明确保留批准。
explanations: 正确。须另看卖方是否接受购买要约。
Firm offer有其他条件，不是所有广告。
没有这种自动物权移转。
广告不是交付契据。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: 明确限量广告可能是offer
questions.stem: An advertisement states: "First customer at 9 a.m. Saturday with $100 receives this identified used bicycle; no further approval required." Which fact most supports treating it as an offer?
options: It appears in print, which makes every advertisement binding.
The bicycle is used, which eliminates the need for assent.
The seller hopes many people will visit.
It specifies the item, price, offeree-selection method, and a commitment leaving nothing further to negotiate.
questions.translation: 明确第一位持款顾客可买特定自行车，何种事实使广告可能构成offer？
questions.rule: 是否是offer看客观承诺和确定性；广告不是绝对不能成为要约。
explanations: 印刷本身不是充分条件。
二手货也要合意。
营销愿望不替代具体承诺。
正确。题干排除了后续审批与谈判。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Open price不会当然阻止成立
questions.stem: Under UCC §2-305, two parties intend a binding sale of 100 standard chairs but leave price to be fixed later. No contrary intent appears. What may follow?
options: The buyer automatically receives the goods free.
The seller may charge any amount in bad faith.
A contract can exist with a reasonable price at the time for delivery.
A missing price always defeats every sale of goods.
questions.translation: 货物数量确定、双方想现在成交但价格留后，必然不成立吗？
questions.rule: UCC可在符合条件时补reasonable price；这不等于数量和成交意图都可忽略。
explanations: 未定价格不是赠与。
定价仍受good faith等限制。
正确。适用法允许价格缺项填补。
Article 2不一律要求已定具体价。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Requirements contract与good faith
questions.stem: A buyer promises to buy all of its actual flour requirements from one seller. It diverts genuine requirements to a cheaper seller solely to escape the bargain. Under UCC §2-306, which is strongest?
options: Any quantity demanded is enforceable regardless of estimates and good faith.
The diversion may breach the good-faith requirements commitment.
Requirements contracts are always illusory.
The buyer may report zero requirements while secretly buying the same flour elsewhere.
questions.translation: 全需求合同下，不能假报零需求再向别家采购来逃约。
questions.rule: Actual requirements须good faith，数量还受不合理偏离估计等限制。
explanations: 估计、历史需求和善意均可能限制数量。
正确。真实需求仍存在，题干说明恶意绕约。
Good-faith要求使数量可确定。
隐藏转单不是当然合法缩减需求。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Revocation须到达
questions.stem: Warren makes an ordinary revocable offer to sell his car. Before Joshua accepts, Joshua receives Warren's clear withdrawal. There is no option, firm offer, or reliance protection. Joshua later tenders payment. Which is best?
options: The withdrawal terminated Joshua's power to accept before he tendered payment.
The stated acceptance deadline alone made the offer irrevocable.
Tender always revives a withdrawn offer.
Warren must sell because Joshua found a higher market price.
questions.translation: 可撤销要约的明确撤回已先收到，之后付款能否接受？
questions.rule: 一般revocation以到达生效；仅写未来截止日不等于独立的不可撤销option。
explanations: 正确。后来的接受已无原要约可接受。
期限与不可撤销保护分开。
复活要约需其他意思表示。
市场差价不替代合同成立。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Indirect revocation
questions.stem: Before accepting an ordinary revocable land-sale offer, Bea reliably learns that the seller has sold the same parcel to another buyer. No irrevocability protection applies. Under traditional common law, what is the likely effect?
options: Only a notice personally delivered by the seller can ever revoke an offer.
The unknown private sale and Bea's reliable knowledge always have identical effects.
Bea automatically owns half of the parcel.
Reliable knowledge of the inconsistent sale can terminate Bea's power of acceptance.
questions.translation: 可靠获知要约人已经卖给别人，可能有什么效果？
questions.rule: Indirect revocation可由可靠信息使受要约人知道要约人已采取与交易不相容的行动；秘密卖出而受要约人不知情须另看。
explanations: 传统规则不限本人亲自通知。
信息是否到达受要约人可能改变结果。
不存在自动共有。
正确。题干给出可靠知情。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: 明确到达期限与lapse
questions.stem: A land-sale offer states that acceptance must be received by February 1. Acceptance is sent February 1 but arrives February 2. There is no waiver or renewed assent. What is the result?
options: The offeror's silence always accepts the late response.
A contract necessarily formed when the offeree began writing.
No contract arises from that late acceptance because the offer expressly required timely receipt.
The mailbox rule overrides every express receipt deadline.
questions.translation: 明确要求2月1日前收到，2月2日才到，通常如何？
questions.rule: Offeror可规定接受须到达才有效；一般mailbox rule不能推翻明确条件。
explanations: 题干没有沉默接受的特殊依据。
写草稿不等于接受生效。
正确。已过明确到达期限。
默认规则服从有效的明确接受要求。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Paid option保护选择机会
questions.stem: A buyer pays $200 in an enforceable exchange for a seller's promise to keep a land-sale offer open for one week. The seller purports to revoke on day three. Under ordinary option principles, which is best?
options: Every option expires after three months even if supported by consideration.
The option consideration can prevent revocation during the agreed week.
An option is impossible unless it concerns goods.
Paying for an option necessarily exercises it and completes the purchase.
questions.translation: 付钱买一周考虑期，和已经买下土地一样吗？
questions.rule: Option contract可由对价支持保留offer；保留选择机会与行使option为两步。
explanations: 三个月上限是无对价UCC firm offer的特定规则。
正确。题干明确存在可执行的保留承诺。
土地交易也可有option。
保留权利不是已经行使。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: UCC firm offer最长保护期
questions.stem: A merchant signs a written offer to sell goods and assures it will remain open for six months. No consideration supports an option. Under UCC §2-205 alone, what is the maximum irrevocability period?
options: Three months; the offer need not automatically lapse when that protection ends.
Six months automatically, because every assurance binds forever.
One year under every merchant offer.
Zero, because a firm offer always requires consideration.
questions.translation: 无对价商人确定要约写六个月，仅依2-205最多保护多久？
questions.rule: Signed merchant firm offer可无新对价不可撤销，但本条保护最多三个月；保护届满不同于offer自动失效。
explanations: 正确。须分开irrevocability与lapse。
超过本条无对价保护上限。
没有统一一年规则。
本条正是无对价的特定例外。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Unilateral offer开始履行
questions.stem: An offer promises $1,000 only upon completion of painting a specified fence. The painter begins the invited painting, not merely preparations. Assume Restatement §45 applies. Which is best?
options: The painter has already earned the full $1,000 by buying a brush.
The painter must complete the job merely because beginning created full bilateral liability.
The offeror may revoke at any moment even after invited performance begins.
An option protection arises, but the offeror's duty to pay remains conditional on completion.
questions.translation: 只能以完成刷栅栏接受，已真正开始刷，保护与付款条件怎样区分？
questions.rule: Restatement §45下开始被邀请的实际履行产生option protection；完成仍是offeror付款义务条件。
explanations: 买工具是准备，且本题说已实际开始。
此类单务要约下开始不当然强迫offeree做到底。
忽略开始履行的option保护。
正确。防撤销保护不等于已完成全部接受条件。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: 询问与counteroffer
questions.stem: A land seller offers a price of $200,000. The buyer replies, "Would you consider $190,000? I am still considering your original offer." Under common law, which is most accurate?
options: The buyer has unconditionally accepted $200,000.
The seller is now bound to accept $190,000.
This can be a mere inquiry rather than a rejection and counteroffer.
Every question mentioning another price automatically terminates the original offer.
questions.translation: 问能否降价并明确仍考虑原要约，是否必然counteroffer？
questions.rule: 整体语言决定是在询问还是拒绝原条件、只愿以新条件成交。
explanations: 询价不等于承诺原价。
要约人尚未接受新价格。
正确。题干明确保留原要约考虑。
不能只凭另一个数字机械判断。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Common-law conditional acceptance
questions.stem: Sim offers to sell an apartment without furniture. Bea replies, "I accept only if all furniture is included." No prior contract exists. Under common law, what is Bea's reply?
options: A transfer of the furniture's ownership immediately.
A counteroffer rather than an acceptance of Sim's existing terms.
An unconditional acceptance because it contains the word "accept."
An enforceable modification of an already formed contract.
questions.translation: “只有包含所有家具我才接受”，普通法下是什么？
questions.rule: 条件性更改实质交易条款通常为counteroffer；须先区分formation与后续modification。
explanations: 回复本身未转移家具产权。
正确。Only if使同意附条件。
不能只认accept单词。
题干明确尚无原合同。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Mailbox rule的通常时间点
questions.stem: A common law doctrine providing that an acceptance made in response to an offer is valid and forms a binding contract at the time of its dispatch, as when it is placed in the mailbox, if that method of accepting is a reasonable response to the offer, is called:
options: Mailbox Rule
First-in-Time Rule
Mailing Rule
Business Judgment Rule
questions.translation: 通常允许的接受方式下，合规承诺发出时生效的规则叫什么？
questions.rule: Mailbox rule一般适用于适当发出的接受；option或明确要求收到的offer等可能不同。
explanations: 正确。Mailbox Rule为该规则常见名称。
主要用于优先时间规则，不是此处术语。
不是该题标准的规则名称。
主要属于公司董事经营判断领域。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Option acceptance通常须收到
questions.stem: A valid option permits exercise until Friday. The governing rule requires receipt of an option acceptance. The option holder mails Thursday, but it arrives Monday. No extension applies. Which is best?
options: Mailing necessarily exercises every option immediately.
The option automatically renews for another month.
Monday receipt is timely simply because the letter was posted earlier.
The option was not timely exercised.
questions.translation: 题设option须期限内收到，信过期才到，如何？
questions.rule: Option acceptance通常以receipt为准；先查看offer明文和题设适用规则。
explanations: 把一般mailbox默认规则错误推广到option。
不存在自动续期。
题设明确需要及时到达。
正确。收到时已过期限。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Mitigation的合理性
questions.stem: After an employer breaches a fixed-term employment contract, the employee reasonably rejects a substitute job requiring materially different, humiliating duties. Assume ordinary mitigation principles. Which is best?
options: The employee automatically receives punitive damages.
No effort to find comparable work can ever be required.
Mitigation ordinarily does not require accepting materially inferior or different employment.
The employee must accept any job at any location, however different.
questions.translation: 减损是否要求接受实质低劣、不同的替代工作？
questions.rule: Reasonable mitigation要求合理减少可避免损失，不要求接受实质不同或明显低劣工作；可比工作仍须合理考虑。
explanations: 合同违约不当然带来punitive damages。
不能因此完全免除合理寻找替代机会。
正确。减损不是无限牺牲义务。
过度扩大reasonable efforts。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: 错误发货：接受并违约
questions.stem: Bar orders five Reg machines for prompt shipment. Without first promising performance or giving an accommodation notice, Art promptly ships two Regs and three nonconforming Ods. Under UCC §2-206, which is best?
options: Every nonconforming shipment is necessarily only an accommodation.
The shipment can accept the order and simultaneously breach the resulting contract.
Shipment can never manifest acceptance.
The seller automatically accepts only two-fifths of every order.
questions.translation: 未说明accommodation，直接发两台正确三台错误机器，法律效果？
questions.rule: UCC允许通过及时发货接受；未适时说明仅为accommodation的不合格货可构成acceptance加breach。
explanations: Accomodation需要适时通知等条件。
正确。合同成立与合格履行是不同问题。
2-206明确承认发货接受。
本题没有这种自动拆分。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Accommodation shipment
questions.stem: A buyer orders red mugs. Before any other acceptance, the seller promptly ships blue mugs and seasonably states that they are offered only as an accommodation. Under UCC §2-206, which is best?
options: The shipment is a counteroffer, not acceptance of the red-mug order.
The seller necessarily accepted and breached despite the proper accommodation notice.
The buyer is compelled to accept blue mugs.
The original order never needed any assent.
questions.translation: 尚未先行接受，发替代货并适时说明仅供通融，是什么？
questions.rule: Proper accommodation notice可使不合格发货走counteroffer路径；若卖方此前已接受则需另行分析已成合同。
explanations: 正确。此处明确通知及时间条件。
忽略2-206中的accommodation例外。
买方仍可不接受反要约。
形成合同仍须相应意思表示。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Nonmerchant附加条款
questions.stem: Under UCC §2-207, a consumer's definite, timely acceptance adds a proposed delivery instruction but is not expressly conditional. The seller has not assented to the new term. Which is best?
options: Any additional term prevents formation in every goods contract.
The consumer's added term automatically binds the seller as a merchant-to-merchant rule.
The seller must accept all later consumer suggestions.
A contract may form, while the added instruction remains only a proposal.
questions.translation: 消费者明确承诺但加一项提议，合同成立和新条款进入要分几步？
questions.rule: 2-207先判断acceptance，再判断additional term；非双方商人时附加条款通常为提议。
explanations: Article 2不机械要求所有表格镜像。
本题不是between merchants。
提议不自动获得效力。
正确。成立与内容是两个问题。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Merchant material alteration
questions.stem: Two merchants exchange forms. A definite acceptance is not expressly conditional but adds a term that materially alters the bargain. No express assent follows. Under UCC §2-207(2), which is best?
options: The material addition necessarily prevents any contract from forming.
A material alteration becomes effective only because it is printed in small type.
The added term does not automatically enter merely because both parties are merchants.
All merchant additions automatically bind without exceptions.
questions.translation: 双方商人，承诺附加实质改变交易的条款，是否自动进入？
questions.rule: Between merchants仍须排查material alteration、offer限制及及时异议等；不把双方商人当作全部条件。
explanations: 题干说明接受并非expressly conditional，需另查内容。
小字印刷不使实质改变自动有效。
正确。2-207(2)明列material alteration限制。
忽略例外。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: 合法克制也是consideration
questions.stem: An adult nephew who is legally free to smoke promises his uncle to refrain for one year in exchange for $5,000. He fully refrains for that year, then resumes. What best supports recovery?
options: The health benefit means the nephew supplied no consideration.
The nephew supplied the bargained-for legal forbearance.
The uncle must personally gain property for consideration to exist.
Resuming after the agreed year necessarily breaches a lifetime promise.
questions.translation: 成年侄子换取5000元承诺一年不吸烟并完成，之后复吸影响这笔对价吗？
questions.rule: Bargained-for forbearance可作consideration；依法有权做却为交换克制，不要求对自己有害或给对方金钱利益。
explanations: 行为对自己有益不消灭法律克制。
正确。完成的是约定一年的法律克制。
不要求许诺人直接取得财物。
合同没有终身不吸烟条件。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Past consideration
questions.stem: Without any prior request or payment expectation, Mira helps move a friend's sofa as a gift. Afterward the friend promises $100 solely for that completed favor. No statutory or restitution exception applies. Which is best?
options: The past favor was not bargained for in exchange for the later promise.
Any past kindness is automatically new consideration.
The sofa's weight determines whether a bargain existed.
The promise is enforceable solely because it was generous.
questions.translation: 无事先有偿请求的帮助已完成，事后纯感谢承诺通常缺什么？
questions.rule: Past consideration通常不是为后来承诺交换的consideration；题干排除了事先请求和其他救济路径。
explanations: 正确。时间和交换关系不足。
已完成的纯赠与行为不是新交换。
体力多少不替代bargain。
慷慨不是通常的合同执行依据。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Preexisting duty：多付但不多做
questions.stem: Bart already owes Alex driveway work for $4,000. He later demands $600 more for exactly the same work. Assume traditional common law, no honest dispute or unanticipated-circumstances exception, and no new detriment. Which is best?
options: Every modification is binding because the price increased.
A promise of the same existing duty always supplies new consideration.
Article 2 controls solely because paving uses materials.
Alex's additional promise lacks new consideration under the preexisting-duty rule.
questions.translation: 原服务义务完全不变，只要求多付600，传统普通法怎样看？
questions.rule: Preexisting-duty rule通常要求修改有新consideration；本题明确排除争议和未预见情形等例外。
explanations: 加价本身不产生对价。
原已负担义务不能重复算成新交换。
交易核心为给定的服务合同，题设要求普通法。
正确。新增付款没有对应的新交换。

questions.title: UCC good-faith modification
questions.stem: After an unforeseen supply disruption, buyer and seller honestly agree in good faith to change a goods contract's price. All applicable writing requirements are met. Under UCC §2-209, which is best?

A seller may extort any increase through bad-faith threats.
The modification does not fail merely for lack of new consideration.
Every goods modification requires a new legal detriment exactly as at traditional common law.

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Promissory estoppel的核心
questions.stem: A manufacturer clearly promises a distributor an exclusive territory, reasonably expecting expansion in reliance. The distributor reasonably incurs substantial expansion costs. Assume no enforceable bargain and injustice absent relief. Which theory is strongest?
options: Punitive damages for every broken promise.
Promissory estoppel based on the foreseeable, reasonable detrimental reliance.
An automatic restitution claim for every dollar spent, even if the manufacturer received no benefit.
A fully executed sales contract solely because negotiations occurred.
questions.translation: 无可执行交换合同，但明确承诺引发合理可预见的重大支出，考虑何种路径？
questions.rule: Promissory estoppel要求承诺、合理可预见且实际的不利信赖，并考察避免不公的需要；救济可依justice限制。
explanations: 破诺不当然应惩罚赔偿。
正确。题干明确提供相应条件。
Restitution通常要看对方获益，不与信赖相同。
谈判和支出不必然组成完整销售合同。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Minor的voidable contract
questions.stem: A 16-year-old buys a nonnecessary car. The jurisdiction permits a minor to disaffirm and requires return of the car still possessed, with no further recovery in these facts. He timely disaffirms and tenders the car back. Which is best?
options: He may invoke the stated minority protection rather than owing all future installments.
Only the adult seller may disaffirm because the buyer is young.
The contract is automatically a felony.
Minority never affects a vehicle contract.
questions.translation: 题设允许未成年人撤销非必需品交易并返还仍持有物，如何适用？
questions.rule: Minority通常使合同voidable at the minor's option，返还和必要品规则有法域差别，依本题明确条件作答。
explanations: 正确。题干已给出撤销与返还规则。
保护通常给未成年人，不是成年方借口。
合同能力不是自动刑事犯罪。
不能一律否认未成年人合同抗辩。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Assignment of payment right
questions.stem: A seller validly assigns its earned right to receive $10,000 to FinanceCo. The buyer receives notice; no defense or restriction applies. Who ordinarily may demand that payment?
options: Nobody, because an assignee was not an original contracting party.
The seller alone forever, despite a valid complete assignment.
Any employee of FinanceCo personally, regardless of the assignment.
FinanceCo as assignee of the payment right.
questions.translation: 合法转让已赚取价款请求权，债务人已通知且无抗辩，谁收款？
questions.rule: Assignment移转contractual right；不是assignment一词就自动把付款责任或所有义务转走。
explanations: 合同权利可在符合规则时转让。
完整转让后不能仍排除assignee。
权利属于指定受让主体，不是任意个人。
正确。受让人取得该请求权。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Intended与incidental beneficiary
questions.stem: A college buys bottled water for its event. A salesperson for the named brand would economically benefit, but the parties did not intend to give that salesperson an enforceable contractual right. Which is best?
options: Being outside the original parties always defeats even an intended beneficiary.
The salesperson automatically becomes the buyer's assignee.
The salesperson is only an incidental beneficiary on these facts.
Every person who might profit may enforce the contract.
questions.translation: 指定品牌销售代表会得经济好处，但双方未想赋予其执行权，属于什么？
questions.rule: Incidental benefit不足以产生third-party beneficiary enforcement；真正intended beneficiary可能不同。
explanations: 不能把所有第三人一概排除。
没有转让该权利的事实。
正确。获益与被有意赋予权利分开。
间接盈利不是充分条件。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Delegation不自动解除原债务
questions.stem: Rudy owes a client services and validly delegates them to Cliff. Cliff agrees to perform. The client consents to the delegation but does not agree to release Rudy or substitute Cliff as sole obligor. Which is best?
options: A delegation transfers only the right to receive payment, never duties.
Rudy ordinarily remains responsible for performance absent a novation or other release.
Any delegation automatically releases the delegator.
The client's permission to use Cliff necessarily releases all original duties.
questions.translation: 允许找Cliff代做，但未释放Rudy，原责任是否消失？
questions.rule: Delegation交给别人履行，不自动解除delegator；novation须有替代并解除原债务的合意等条件。
explanations: 这是assignment of rights与delegation的混淆。
正确。题干排除了release。
委托代做与免除责任是两件事。
同意代做不必然同意唯一更换债务人。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Mutual mistake与basic assumption
questions.stem: Both parties contract for sale of an identified painting, mistakenly believing it exists. It had already been destroyed. The mistake materially affects the exchange, and the buyer did not bear that risk. Under ordinary mutual-mistake principles, which is best?
options: The adversely affected party may have a basis to avoid the contract.
Every mistake concerning a contract is automatically irrelevant.
The case is necessarily later impossibility because destruction occurred after formation.
The seller is entitled to the full price regardless of the stated risk allocation.
questions.translation: 订约前标的已毁，双方误以为仍存在，怎样与后来不能履行区分？
questions.rule: Mutual mistake关注订约时基本假设的共同事实错误、重大影响及风险承担；订约后才发生障碍另用discharge分析。
explanations: 正确。题干提供共同错误的核心条件。
不能一概否认重大共同错误。
题干明确在订约前已毁。
卖方不能无视错误与风险规则。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: 承担风险后不能仅因赌输撤销
questions.stem: A buyer knows a coin may be genuine or a replica and expressly agrees to bear that uncertainty at a fixed price. It proves to be a replica. No fraud or other defense exists. Which is best?
options: Every disappointing valuation is automatically a mutual mistake warranting rescission.
The buyer can always rewrite the allocation after discovering the result.
Express risk allocation has no relevance to mistake.
The allocated risk ordinarily defeats avoidance based solely on that uncertainty.
questions.translation: 明确承担真伪不确定性，结果不利能否只凭mistake反悔？
questions.rule: Mistake救济须考虑是否承担风险；有意接受不确定性不同于双方都未察觉的基本事实错误。
explanations: 不是所有价值落差均有撤销权。
不能只因结果不利就改分配。
承担风险是重要条件。
正确。题干明确分配了同一风险。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Material misrepresentation
questions.stem: A real-estate professional knowingly gives a homeowner a false statement of a concrete material fact, intending to induce a sale. The owner justifiably relies and agrees. Assume all avoidance elements are met. Which defense most directly fits?
options: Automatic impossibility of performance.
The mailbox rule.
Fraudulent misrepresentation inducing assent.
Lack of consideration solely because the price is low.
questions.translation: 专业者故意虚报重要事实，引发正当信赖而订约，直接对应什么抗辩？
questions.rule: Material或fraudulent misrepresentation在正当信赖等条件下可能使合同voidable；低价和欺诈诱导是不同分析。
explanations: 没有履行障碍事实。
接受时间规则不解决欺诈问题。
正确。题干给出故意虚假事实与诱导信赖。
价格不等本身通常不消灭consideration。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Economic duress
questions.stem: A supplier wrongfully threatens to withhold an essential item it already owes unless the buyer accepts an unrelated costly deal. The buyer has no reasonable alternative and assents because of the threat. What doctrine most directly applies?
options: Every urgent purchase is necessarily unconscionable.
Economic duress may make the induced agreement voidable.
Any hard bargain is automatically a crime.
The buyer's consent conclusively prevents a duress defense.
questions.translation: 不当威胁加上无合理替代办法所导致的同意，考虑什么？
questions.rule: Duress关注improper threat及no reasonable alternative；经济压力或差交易本身并不充分。
explanations: 急迫不自动构成unconscionability。
正确。题干提供两项关键条件及因果联系。
不是所有不利议价都犯罪。
受胁迫同意正是抗辩讨论对象。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Unconscionability看订约时
questions.stem: A sales term was unconscionable when the contract was made. Under UCC §2-302, which response is available to a court?
options: It may refuse enforcement, sever the clause, or limit its operation to avoid an unconscionable result.
It must enforce every printed term regardless of oppression.
It must award the seller an extra penalty.
It may consider only whether market prices changed years later.
questions.translation: 订约时条款unconscionable，法院有哪些处理方式？
questions.rule: UCC2-302以订约时为焦点，允许不执行全部、剔除或限制特定条款；不是替每份合同保证等价。
explanations: 正确。三种处理须结合事实。
印出来不保证条款可执行。
本条不是给压迫方加惩罚收益。
事后行情失望不是该时点测试。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: 一年从订约时计算
questions.stem: On January 1, parties orally agree on a fixed two-year service term beginning February 1. No exception applies. Under the ordinary one-year Statute of Frauds rule, why is a writing required?
options: Every service contract requires a writing regardless of duration.
The one-year period begins only after the first missed payment.
A possible breach counts as complete contractual performance within a year.
The agreed performance cannot be completed within one year from formation.
questions.translation: 1月订约、2月起两年服务，一年规则怎么计算？
questions.rule: One-year provision看从订约起依条款能否在一年内完全履行；违约或解约不是约定履行完成。
explanations: 不是所有短期服务都要书面。
起点通常是formation。
把不履行误当成履行。
正确。固定两年期限无法一年内完成。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: UCC writing的数量边界
questions.stem: Assume UCC §2-201's $500 threshold applies. A sufficient signed record indicates a sale but states only 40 units. The alleged oral bargain was for 70. No exception applies. Under subsection (1), enforcement is limited to:
options: Zero units because every sales record must include every detail.
Any quantity chosen later by the plaintiff.
The 40 units shown in the record.
All 70 units solely because price is omitted.
questions.translation: 合格签署记录只写40件，口称70件，普通书面路径执行多少？
questions.rule: UCC2-201(1)允许某些条款遗漏，但执行不得超过书面所示数量；其他例外另论。
explanations: 不要求记录所有条款。
原告不能自行补任意数量。
正确。数量构成执行边界。
遗漏价格不把数量扩大。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Merchant confirmation只排形式抗辩
questions.stem: Between merchants, a timely sufficient confirmation of an alleged oral sale is received with reason to know its contents. No written objection is made within ten days. Under §2-201(2), which is best?
options: Every consumer is treated as a merchant for this exception.
It can satisfy the writing requirement against the recipient, but does not by itself prove that the alleged agreement actually occurred.
Silence conclusively proves every disputed term and formation.
A recipient must always sign again for subsection (2) to apply.
questions.translation: 商人确认书十日未书面异议，会自动证明合同确曾成立吗？
questions.rule: Merchant-confirmation exception处理SOF的writing障碍，不把沉默变成所有争议事实的决定证据。
explanations: 必须满足between merchants。
正确。形式与实际合意分开。
该例外不免除证明真实交易。
本条正可在符合条件时对未另签的接收商人有效。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Specially manufactured goods
questions.stem: A seller substantially begins custom uniforms clearly made for the buyer before receiving repudiation. They are unsuitable for ordinary sale to others. Under §2-201(3)(a), which is strongest?
options: The specially manufactured-goods exception may overcome the absence of a signed writing.
Custom work automatically makes the contract a land sale.
The exception requires completed delivery in every case.
Any standard inventory qualifies merely because the buyer ordered it.
questions.translation: 拒绝前已实质开始、无法通常转售的定制货，有何形式例外？
questions.rule: Special manufacture还要求不适合通常转卖及适时实质开始或采购承诺，不能只看custom标签。
explanations: 正确。题干给出本条条件。
仍为货物生产买卖。
实质开始或采购承诺可能足够。
普通库存不符合所列特殊条件。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Judicial admission限于承认数量
questions.stem: A defendant admits in court that an oral goods contract existed for 30 units, while the plaintiff alleges 90. No other exception or writing applies. Under §2-201(3)(b), the admission exception permits enforcement for:
options: All 90 units automatically.
No units, because an admission can never affect the writing defense.
A quantity decided by the seller after trial.
The admitted 30 units.
questions.translation: 法院中承认30件，不等于承认或可执行全部90件。
questions.rule: Judicial-admission exception的执行范围受在法庭承认的quantity限制。
explanations: 不能把例外扩大到未承认部分。
2-201(3)(b)明确规定此路径。
数量不是事后单方决定。
正确。只及承认数量。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Prior contradiction与integration
questions.stem: A final integrated goods contract sets payment at $4,300. One party offers a prior oral agreement for $4,000 solely to contradict that final term. No invalidity or interpretation exception applies. Under §2-202, which is best?
options: A prior oral price automatically defeats the final writing.
The rule concerns only spoken evidence, never prior letters.
The prior agreement ordinarily cannot contradict the final written price.
Parol evidence excludes every statement made after formation as well.
questions.translation: 只想用先前口头价推翻最终整合书面价，通常怎样？
questions.rule: Parol evidence rule保护final expression；不等于所有口头话都排除，也不只管口头证据。
explanations: 不能据此推翻最终约定。
先前书信也可能涉及本规则。
正确。题干排除了另有用途的例外。
后续modification不是此向后看规则直接排除的对象。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Later modification另行分析
questions.stem: After signing a final goods contract, both parties later agree to change its delivery date. Which is the proper approach?
options: Assume a modification can never be made after an integration.
Analyze the later agreement under modification, good-faith, and applicable form requirements.
Reject it automatically under the parol evidence rule solely because it was later and oral.
Treat every later oral statement as an irrevocable firm offer.
questions.translation: 整合书面合同之后再改交货日，应分析什么？
questions.rule: 后来modification不同于用先前约定改变最终文本；仍须看UCC2-209和形式等。
explanations: Integration不永远冻结合同。
正确。时间顺序决定分析路径。
不能把parol evidence机械用来排除所有后续协议。
Firm offer和修改不是一回事。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Course of performance
questions.stem: Under one ongoing supply contract, a buyer knowingly accepts the same delivery practice on ten repeated occasions without objection. Which label most directly describes this conduct?
options: Course of performance.
Course of dealing concerning prior separate contracts.
Usage of trade, even without evidence of an industry practice.
A new statute enacted by the buyer.
questions.translation: 同一份合同十次履行的做法，叫什么？
questions.rule: Course of performance对应本交易重复履行；course of dealing对应双方以往交易；usage对应行业惯例。
explanations: 正确。是同一现存合同。
题干不是其他旧交易。
未证明行业普遍做法。
当事人行为不成为成文法。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Express warranty不需要magic words
questions.stem: During a goods sale, the seller states as part of the bargain that a pump delivers 100 liters per minute. It does not. No disclaimer issue applies. Which is best?
options: Only a document titled "Guarantee" can create an express warranty.
Every measurable performance statement is merely sales praise.
An express warranty exists only if the seller is a merchant.
The factual performance affirmation can create an express warranty without using the word "warranty."
questions.translation: 作为交易基础的具体每分钟100升陈述，可能构成什么？
questions.rule: UCC2-313中与货物有关且成为basis of bargain的事实、承诺、描述或样品可创express warranty；无需正式词。
explanations: 不要求这种特定标题。
可测事实不等于一般puffery。
Express warranty不以merchant身份为统一必要条件。
正确。题干为可核实的性能事实。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Merchantability关注通常用途
questions.stem: A merchant who regularly sells kitchen kettles sells one that cannot safely boil water. No exclusion applies. Which implied warranty is most directly implicated under §2-314?
options: A guarantee that the buyer can resell at a profit.
A promise of lifetime perfection without any wear.
Merchantability: fitness for the ordinary purposes of such goods.
A warranty that every kettle will satisfy any undisclosed unusual industrial purpose.
questions.translation: 专业售水壶商卖的水壶不能安全烧水，最直接涉及什么？
questions.rule: Merchantability通常要求相关货物商人所售货物适合ordinary purposes，非无限完美或任意用途保证。
explanations: 不保证市场利润。
正常质量标准不是永远不磨损。
正确。烧水是通常用途。
特殊用途另有知情与依赖条件。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Fitness for particular purpose
questions.stem: A seller knows a buyer needs boots for an unusual chemical environment and is relying on the seller's selection. The seller selects unsuitable boots. No exclusion applies. Under §2-315, what is most directly implicated?
options: A rule that a buyer's undisclosed preference alone always creates a warranty.
The implied warranty of fitness for that particular purpose.
Only a price guarantee.
An absolute rule that no warranty applies unless both parties are merchants.
questions.translation: 卖方知道特殊用途及买方依赖其选择，选品不适合，涉及什么？
questions.rule: Fitness要求seller有理由知道particular purpose与reliance；不一律要求seller为该类merchant。
explanations: 未告知的个人喜好不自动满足条件。
正确。题干明确两种知情。
不是对价格作承诺。
2-315不以双方商人为一般门槛。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Written merchantability disclaimer
questions.stem: A seller seeks to exclude the implied warranty of merchantability solely through a written disclaimer under §2-316(2). No "as is" or other exception applies. Which requirement is correct?
options: The writing must mention merchantability and be conspicuous.
A hidden statement saying only "No problems" necessarily suffices.
The word merchantability must never appear.
A conspicuous writing automatically cancels all inconsistent express warranties.
questions.translation: 仅走2-316(2)书面免责路径，merchantability的免责需什么？
questions.rule: 本条一般要求提到merchantability，书面时须conspicuous；as is等其他路径和express warranty冲突须分别判断。
explanations: 正确。题干排除其他例外路径。
模糊隐藏语句不满足这项要求。
恰恰要求mention merchantability。
Express warranty不能被任意矛盾措辞抹除。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Shipment contract的风险点
questions.stem: Under a UCC shipment contract, conforming goods are duly delivered to the carrier. No breach, contrary agreement, or special rule applies. They are then accidentally destroyed in transit. Who bears the risk under §2-509(1)(a)?
options: The seller always bears risk until the buyer physically opens the package.
The carrier's possession means no party bears contractual risk.
Risk automatically stays with whichever party originally manufactured the goods.
The buyer, because risk passed upon due delivery to the carrier.
questions.translation: Shipment contract合格交承运人后意外毁损，无其他因素时谁承担？
questions.rule: Shipment contract通常以合格交承运人为风险转移点；先排除breach及contrary agreement。
explanations: 把destination或其他规则一概套用。
仍须在交易双方间分配risk。
制造者身份不是该规则标准。
正确。不是所有运输合同都等买方收货。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Destination contract的风险点
questions.stem: A UCC contract expressly requires the seller to deliver conforming goods at Buyer's warehouse. They are accidentally destroyed in transit before arrival. No contrary agreement or buyer breach applies. Who bears the risk?
options: The buyer merely because the invoice was issued.
Risk shifts automatically when either party asks the question.
The seller, because required destination tender has not occurred.
The buyer as soon as the seller seals the carton.
questions.translation: 约定必须到买方仓库交货，途中未到即毁，谁承担？
questions.rule: Destination contract通常须货在约定目的地、承运人占有下适当tender使买方可接收时转移风险。
explanations: 开票不替代交付条件。
风险依法与约定，不是主张时间。
正确。尚未到达所需交付节点。
包装不是目的地tender。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Merchant pickup的receipt
questions.stem: A merchant seller holds a conforming television for the buyer to collect. There is no carrier, bailee document, contrary agreement, or breach. A fire destroys it after notice that it is ready but before the buyer receives it. Under §2-509(3), which is best?
options: Risk cannot ever shift in a local pickup sale.
Risk remains with the merchant seller until the buyer's receipt.
Notice that goods are ready always shifts risk for merchant sellers.
Payment alone always shifts risk under subsection (3).
questions.translation: 商人卖方现场自取，已通知可取但买方未收到时毁损，怎样？
questions.rule: 非运输等情况下，merchant seller通常至buyer receipt才转移；nonmerchant通常为tender，须分开。
explanations: 接收后仍可能依法转移。
正确。题干排除其他路径。
把非商人的tender规则套在商人上。
Payment与receipt不同。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Perfect tender与有效拒收
questions.stem: In a single-delivery UCC sale, the seller tenders the wrong model. Assume no installment contract, cure right, contractual limitation, or other exception defeats timely rejection. The buyer promptly gives notice before acceptance. What may the buyer do?
options: Reject the nonconforming tender under the perfect-tender rule.
Accept the wrong model merely because it has similar market value.
Reject only if the seller committed fraud.
Keep every unit without payment solely because delivery was nonconforming.
questions.translation: 单次交货型号错误，题干排除cure等限制且及时通知，能否拒收？
questions.rule: UCC2-601允许不合格交付的拒收选择，但须考虑cure、installment和及时有效rejection等限制。
explanations: 正确。题干明确满足此处拒收条件。
相近价值不自动满足约定型号。
不以fraud为必要条件。
不合格不自动赠送货物。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Revocation of acceptance
questions.stem: A buyer accepts a machine without discovering a hidden defect that substantially impairs its value to her. Discovery before acceptance was reasonably difficult. She promptly notifies revocation before any unrelated substantial change. Which doctrine may apply?
options: Initial rejection, because she never accepted.
An automatic loss of all remedies upon acceptance.
A right to revoke for any trivial scratch regardless of statutory conditions.
Revocation of acceptance under UCC §2-608.
questions.translation: 已接受后才合理发现严重隐蔽缺陷，可能走什么路径？
questions.rule: Revocation of acceptance不同于初次rejection，须substantial impairment及接受原因、及时通知和状态变化等条件。
explanations: 题干明确已经accept。
接受不消灭所有救济。
轻微不满不自动足够。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Adequate assurance的书面要求
questions.stem: A buyer has reasonable grounds to fear the seller will not perform a UCC supply contract, but the seller has not unequivocally repudiated. What may the buyer do under §2-609?
options: Refuse performance permanently without any relevant facts or process.
Demand assurance only after final delivery is already completed.
Demand adequate assurance in writing and, when commercially reasonable, suspend unreturned performance pending assurance.
Treat every unsupported rumor as automatic repudiation.
questions.translation: 有合理不安但尚无明确拒绝，UCC下可怎么做？
questions.rule: Reasonable grounds for insecurity可引出written demand for adequate assurance；与已经明确的anticipatory repudiation区分。
explanations: 本条要求事实基础和相应过程。
目的正是保障未来履行期待。
正确。Suspension也须commercially reasonable。
无根据传闻不自动足够。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Material breach与暂停己方履行
questions.stem: Under common law, a contractor commits an uncured material breach of an exchange of dependent promises. No waiver or other qualification applies. What may follow for the owner's remaining performance?
options: Only punitive damages are available.
It may be excused while the material failure remains uncured under the applicable rules.
Every trivial deviation automatically cancels all duties.
Material breach can never affect the other party's duty.
questions.translation: 普通法依存交换中的重大未补救违约，可能怎样影响另一方剩余义务？
questions.rule: Material breach可能影响对待履行；minor breach一般仍有damages而不当然免除全部履行。
explanations: 通常以补偿性救济为主。
正确。题干明确material与未补救。
轻微瑕疵不同于重大违约。
否定了依存履行规则。

questions.title: Identified goods无过错全毁
questions.stem: A UCC contract requires delivery of a uniquely identified stored machine. Before risk passes to the buyer, it is totally destroyed without either party's fault. No contrary risk allocation applies. Under §2-613, which is best?
options: The contract is avoided because the identified goods suffered total casualty.
The seller must always create an identical unique machine regardless of possibility.
The buyer must pay the full price despite risk remaining with the seller.
The seller is automatically liable for punitive damages.
questions.translation: 订约时特定化机器在风险转移前无双方过错全毁，如何？
questions.rule: UCC2-613对identified goods的无过错casualty有专门规则；部分损失与全毁后果不同。
explanations: 正确。题干给足本条适用条件。
不是任意通用品供货义务，本题标的特定。
风险尚未转给买方。
无自动惩罚赔偿依据。

questions.title: Expectation扣除节省成本
questions.stem: A valid service contract promised a performer $2,000. The customer repudiates before performance, causing the performer to save $500 in performance costs. No other loss, substitute earnings, or damages limitation applies. What is the expectation recovery?
options: $2,000 without deducting saved costs.
$500 only, because that was saved.
$4,000 as an automatic penalty.
questions.translation: 合同价2000，违约使表演者节省500成本，无其他因素，期待利益多少？
questions.rule: Expectation把受害方放到如约履行的经济位置，须扣除因违约节省的履行成本等。
explanations: 忽略节省成本造成过度补偿。
节省成本是扣项，不是唯一损失。
合同损害并非自动倍增处罚。

questions.subject: 合同法
questions.title: Liquidated damages与penalty
questions.stem: A goods contract fixes damages at an amount unreasonably large in light of anticipated or actual harm and the difficulty of proving loss. Under UCC §2-718(1), which is best?
options: The excessive amount automatically becomes a criminal sentence.
The breaching party loses all possible right to contest the clause.
The clause is unenforceable as a penalty.
Every signed damages clause must be enforced regardless of size.
questions.translation: 与预期或实际损害、举证困难相比不合理巨额的约定赔偿，怎样？
questions.rule: Liquidated damages须符合合理性标准；不能把不合理高额penalty只改名称就使其有效。

仍可主张条款不可执行。

签字不能抹去该限制。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Largest estate：fee simple absolute
questions.stem: Which is the largest estate recognized by traditional common law?
options: Fee tail.
Life estate.
An estate for a term of 99 years.
Fee simple absolute.
questions.translation: 传统common law中最大的estate是哪种？
questions.rule: Fee simple absolute具有潜在无限存续时间；“最大”不等于不受税收、征收、nuisance等法律限制。
explanations: Fee tail受血统继承限制。
Life estate以衡量生命限制。
期限再长仍为term。
正确。相对life estate、term与fee tail，范围最广。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Heirs是limitation而非现在受赠人
questions.stem: Under traditional conveyancing, O grants land "to A and A's heirs." What do A's presently living children receive solely from those words?
options: A present remainder in every case.
A fee tail independent of A's title.
No present remainder; the words describe A's fee simple.
An automatic life estate measured by A.
questions.translation: To A and A's heirs中的heirs，是否现在给孩子remainder？
questions.rule: 传统heirs为words of limitation，说明A的estate性质；不是words of purchase赋予现存孩子独立权益。
explanations: 把limitation误作第三人赠与。
并非to heirs of body式fee tail。
正确。孩子未来是否继承取决于届时继承安排等。
没有这种独立life estate。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Life estate pur autre vie
questions.stem: O grants Blackacre "to A for the life of B." Under traditional estate rules, when does A's possessory estate ordinarily end?
options: Only when A chooses to sell.
At B's death.
At A's death in every case, regardless of B.
Exactly 99 years after the deed.
questions.translation: To A for the life of B，衡量生命是谁？
questions.rule: Life estate pur autre vie以另一人的生命为衡量；持有人和measuring life必须分开。
explanations: 转让不延长原衡量期间。
正确。文书指定B的生命。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Life tenant能转让多大权益
questions.stem: Fred holds a life estate measured by Fred's life, followed by Nora's valid remainder. Fred conveys all he owns to Buyer. No other interest is transferred. What does Buyer receive?
options: An estate that ordinarily ends when Fred dies.
Fee simple absolute merely because Buyer pays a high price.
A new life estate lasting for Buyer's own entire life.
Nora's remainder automatically.
questions.translation: Life tenant把自己全部权益卖出，买方能超过原life estate吗？

explanations: 正确。买方承接原life estate的限制。
价格不扩大产权。
衡量生命不会自动改成Buyer。
Fred未拥有Nora的remainder。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Permissive waste
questions.stem: A life tenant neglects ordinary preservation and allows serious, avoidable deterioration of the building. A remainderman seeks an injunction against further damage. Under ordinary waste principles, which is best?
options: Every deterioration is voluntary mineral extraction.
Future-interest holders can never protect the property before possession.
A life tenant owes no preservation duties of any kind.
The remainderman may seek protection against permissive waste.
questions.translation: Life tenant疏于维护而让建筑严重可避免地败坏，后续权利人怎么办？
questions.rule: Permissive waste通常涉及疏于合理维护；未来权益人可在符合条件时请求制止继续损害。
explanations: Voluntary waste与不作为导致败坏不同。
否定了保护future interest的路径。
Life tenant仍受waste规则限制。
正确。尚未占有不等于没有可保护的权益。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: 开新矿与voluntary waste
questions.stem: A life tenant of a working farm begins a new gravel mine solely for personal profit. No open-mine exception, permission, or contrary instrument applies. A remainderman objects. Under traditional waste rules, which is strongest?
options: The remainderman must wait until every mineral is exhausted.
Operating a farm automatically authorizes every new mine.
The remainderman can seek to stop destructive extraction as voluntary waste.
The life tenant may consume the corpus without limit.
questions.translation: 农场life tenant新开砾石矿卖掉资源，没有例外时如何？
questions.rule: 传统voluntary waste限制life tenant对土地实体资源的破坏性消耗；open-mine等例外须有相应事实。
explanations: 可请求预防性救济。
农业使用不等于既有矿业。
正确。题干已排除例外。
占有期间有限，不能任意耗尽后续权益。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: 升值不必然免除waste
questions.stem: A life tenant proposes to demolish a historic mansion for a hotel, over the remainderman's objection. Assume the jurisdiction's traditional ameliorative-waste rule bars this material alteration and no exception applies. What is best?
options: The remainderman must accept money whenever offered.
The remainderman may enjoin the change despite a higher projected market value.
Any projected increase in value automatically eliminates all waste claims.
The life tenant owns the remainder merely because college costs are high.
questions.translation: 题设传统规则禁止实质改造，即使改酒店可能更值钱也能阻止吗？
questions.rule: Ameliorative waste的现代规则有差别；本题明确传统规则及无例外，不能只凭升值压倒后续权利。
explanations: 没有自动强买后续权益权。
正确。适用题设规则而非仅看经济收益。
忽略题设明定限制。
个人财务需要不转移产权。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Condition subsequent与right of entry
questions.stem: O grants land "to A, but if alcohol is sold there, O may reenter and terminate the estate." Under traditional rules, what future interest does O retain?
options: A right of entry, also called a power of termination.
A third-party remainder.
No future interest because A has possession.
An executory interest held by A's heirs.
questions.translation: But if发生后O可以选择进入终止，O保留什么？
questions.rule: 明确保留选择终止权的fee simple subject to condition subsequent，对应right of entry；与自动终止的determinable区分。
explanations: 正确。文书明确O may reenter。
Grantor保留此权不是第三人remainder。
现占有人与后续权利可同时存在。
文书没有给A继承人该权。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: 第三人接续的executory interest
questions.stem: O grants land "to A and A's heirs while used for public debate; if that use ends, then to B and B's heirs." Assume the future interest is valid. What does B hold?
options: A possibility of reverter retained by O.
A remainder that waits for the natural end of a life estate.
A present possessory life estate.
An executory interest that divests A upon the stated event.
questions.translation: 用途停止时转给第三人B，B的future interest如何分类？
questions.rule: 第三人权益在事件发生时切断A的defeasible fee，为executory interest；possibility of reverter典型在grantor。
explanations: 不是由O保留。
前面是defeasible fee，不是自然终止的life estate。
B尚无现时占有。
正确。B会divest A的estate。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: 已确定且无先决条件的remainder
questions.stem: O conveys land "to A for life, then to B and B's heirs." B is alive and identified, and no survival or other condition is imposed. What does B hold?
options: A possibility of reverter.
No interest until A's death.
An indefeasibly vested remainder in fee simple.
A contingent remainder solely because possession is future.
questions.translation: B确定、无先决条件，仅未来占有，是否就是contingent？
questions.rule: Vested remainder看受让人确定且无未满足condition precedent；未来占有不等于权益尚不存在。
explanations: B不是保留权益的grantor。
权益已存在，等待的是占有。
正确。B现在已有既得后续权益。
Future与contingent不是同义。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Vested remainder subject to open
questions.stem: O conveys "to Diane for life, then to Diane's children." Diane has two living children and can have more. No separate condition is imposed. Under traditional class-gift rules, the children's interest is:
options: A possibility of reverter in the children.
A vested remainder subject to open.
Necessarily contingent because every class gift is contingent.
A fee simple absolute in present possession.
questions.translation: Diane现有两个孩子但可能再生，孩子组的remainder是什么？
questions.rule: 已存在且无先决条件的class成员可vest，但份额可能因新增成员而减少，称subject to open。
explanations: 不是grantor保留权益。
正确。份额仍可因class扩大而变化。
Class gift不必然contingent。
Life estate尚在。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Unborn widow与传统RAP
questions.stem: An inter vivos deed grants "to Frank for life, then to his widow for life, then to Frank's children living at the widow's death." Apply the unmodified common-law Rule Against Perpetuities; a widow could be born after the deed. What is the classic concern?
options: The children's contingent gift might vest beyond lives in being plus 21 years.
Every gift after a life estate is automatically invalid.
A widow must always have been alive when the deed was executed.
RAP measures only the market price of the property.
questions.translation: 可能是订约后出生的widow，按她死亡时存活子女赠与，传统RAP担心什么？
questions.rule: 传统RAP针对可能过晚vesting；unborn-widow问题在于衡量事件可能依赖设权时尚未出生者的生命。现代法域改革另论。
explanations: 正确。这里是经典过远归属风险。
许多可及时归属的后续赠与有效。
“Widow”在Frank死时识别，可能为后生者。
RAP关注归属时间，不是估价。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Joint tenancy的survivorship
questions.stem: A and B own land as joint tenants with a valid right of survivorship. B dies without any severance or encumbrance. Who takes B's former interest?
options: B's heirs automatically as tenants in common with A.
The government automatically, regardless of A.
A tenant selected by the probate executor.
A by survivorship.
questions.translation: Joint tenancy未分割、无负担，一人死亡，其份额怎样？
questions.rule: Right of survivorship是joint tenancy的重要特征；须先排除生前severance及适用法对负担的处理。
explanations: 不是依B遗产继承移转。
仍有存活joint tenant。
执行人不因此取得任意选择权。
正确。题干明确未sever。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Joint tenant生前转让
questions.stem: Heathcliff and Sonia hold as joint tenants. Heathcliff validly conveys his entire undivided share to Clyde during life. Assume ordinary severance rules and no other agreement. What relationship ordinarily remains?
options: Clyde becomes a joint tenant with Sonia automatically.
Clyde gets only a right to inherit after Sonia dies.
Sonia and Clyde hold as tenants in common.
Sonia automatically owns everything despite the valid lifetime transfer.
questions.translation: Joint tenant生前把自己全部份额有效转给孩子，会怎样？
questions.rule: 有效生前让与通常severs该份额的joint tenancy，使受让人与另一方成为tenants in common；婚姻称谓本身不改变既定产权。
explanations: Unities被打破，不自动同等joint tenant。
这是现时让与，不只是未来继承期待。
正确。孩子取得的份额通常无原survivorship关系。
生前severance阻断该份额survivorship。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Tenancy in common可不同份额
questions.stem: A deed expressly creates a tenancy in common, giving A a one-third share and B a two-thirds share. Which is correct?
options: A's share automatically disappears at death by survivorship.
Unequal fractional shares are compatible with tenancy in common.
Tenants in common must always own equal shares.
B necessarily has exclusive possession of a physically marked two-thirds area.
questions.translation: TIC可以三分之一、三分之二吗？
questions.rule: TIC可有不同份额；undivided share不等于地面自动画线，通常也无当然survivorship。
explanations: TIC通常经遗产移转而非当然survivorship。
正确。份额可不相等。
把joint tenancy某些特征机械套用。
法律份额不是自动物理分割。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Undivided interest与共同占有
questions.stem: Two tenants in common have no agreement allocating particular rooms. Under ordinary cotenancy rules, which is correct?
options: Each generally has a right to possess the whole, subject to the other cotenant's equal possessory right.
One cotenant may exclude the other from all land merely by arriving first.
Each owns only an invisible physical strip fixed by the deed's fraction.
Neither can enter without a lease from the other.
questions.translation: 未分配具体房间的TIC，份额与占有权怎样区分？
questions.rule: Undivided cotenancy通常使各方可占有全体但须尊重他方同等占有权；不等于一人可独占排斥另一人。
explanations: 正确。权利并存。
先到不产生当然ouster权。
分数份额不自动对应物理条带。
本身就是有占有权的共有人。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Ouster后的占用责任
questions.stem: One cotenant changes every lock and expressly refuses the other cotenant any access. Assume this is an ouster under governing law. What most directly distinguishes it from mere sole occupancy?
options: Any sole occupancy always extinguishes the absent owner's title immediately.
Ouster automatically transfers fee simple to the locked-out cotenant alone.
The lock changes can never have legal significance.
Wrongful exclusion may create liability for the excluded cotenant's share of rental value.
questions.translation: 换锁明确排除另一共有人，与只是一个人住有何不同？
questions.rule: Mere occupancy与ouster区分；明确非法剥夺共同占有可能触发合理租值份额等责任。
explanations: 单独住不立即消灭别人产权。
赔偿和产权转移不同。
排除事实正是关键。
正确。题干明确符合ouster。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Partition的意义
questions.stem: Unmarried cotenants cannot agree on continued ownership. No enforceable restriction bars partition. What does a partition action ordinarily seek?
options: A compulsory gift of all title to whichever cotenant first sues.
A new right of survivorship created solely by disagreement.
A lawful division of the property or, where appropriate, sale and allocation of proceeds.
Automatic criminal punishment of the less wealthy cotenant.
questions.translation: 共同所有无法继续，partition通常求什么？
questions.rule: Partition可依条件采用实物分割或司法出售分配；不等于先起诉者独得全部。
explanations: 不构成先诉先得。
争执不自动改成joint tenancy。
正确。救济方法依适用标准与土地状况。
不是刑事罚。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Term of years的明确终点
questions.stem: A written lease creates a fixed five-year term ending June 30. Assume no renewal, holdover, statutory-notice modification, or contrary agreement. When does that term ordinarily end?
options: Never, because all leases create fee simple.
At the stated June 30 expiration.
Only when the tenant dies.
Automatically after the first month.
questions.translation: 固定五年、明确6月30日到期，无续租等因素，何时结束？

正确。依题设固定期限。

questions.title: Periodic tenancy
questions.stem: A lease renews month to month until properly terminated. The statute requires one month's advance notice. The tenant gives only one day's notice before moving. Which issue is central?
options: Whether the periodic tenancy was terminated with the required notice.
Whether the tenant obtained fee simple by paying rent.
Whether every monthly tenancy lasts exactly one day.
Whether leaving secretly automatically cancels every rent obligation.
questions.translation: 月度续租须提前一月通知，仅前一天通知搬走，重点是什么？

租金不自动买下产权。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Lease assignment：全部剩余期间
questions.stem: A tenant transfers her entire remaining leasehold to a transferee without retaining a reversion. Under the traditional duration-based test specified here, the transfer is:
options: A sublease merely because the tenant labels it one.
A fee simple conveyance of the landlord's title.
A bailment of personal property.
An assignment of the leasehold.
questions.translation: 依题设传统期间测试，租户让出全部剩余leasehold叫什么？

租户不能给出房东fee simple。
租赁土地权益不同于动产bailment。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Sublease：保留回归期间
questions.stem: A tenant has two years left on a lease but grants another person possession for one year, retaining the final year. Under the traditional duration-based test, what is created?
options: A fee simple determinable in the building.
A present life estate in the landlord.
A sublease, because the original tenant retains a reversion in the leasehold.
An assignment of the entire remaining leasehold.
questions.translation: 余两年只转租一年并保留最后一年，是什么？

和衡量生命无关。

questions.title: Assignment后原租户的contract duty
questions.stem: A tenant assigns the entire lease to a new occupant. The landlord consents but does not release the original tenant from the lease promises. No novation occurs. Under ordinary rules, which is best?
options: The original tenant and assignee automatically become owners in joint tenancy.
The original tenant may remain liable on her contractual promises.
Consent to assignment always releases every original contractual duty.
The landlord loses title because an assignment occurred.
questions.translation: 房东同意assignment但未释放原tenant，原合同责任是否当然消失？

正确。须看原promise是否被有效解除。
把允许转让与释放责任混为一谈。
Lease assignment不移转房东title。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Habitability与严重供暖缺陷
questions.stem: A residential lease is governed by a statute implying basic habitability. Serious winter heating failure persists after proper notice and a reasonable repair opportunity. The statute authorizes rent abatement proportionate to reduced rental value. Which remedy fits these facts?
options: Seek the authorized proportionate rent abatement.
Automatically keep the building as fee simple compensation.
Ignore every notice requirement because any defect permits all remedies.
Demand permanent free housing for any cosmetic scratch.
questions.translation: 严重冬季无供暖、通知修复条件满足，法条准许比例减租，应如何？
questions.rule: Habitability关注基本居住条件；具体救济依适用法，本题给定比例abatement及前提，不扩成任意全额停租。
explanations: 正确。按给定法条范围主张。
违约救济不自动移转房东产权。
通知与修复机会仍可能是条件。
小外观问题与基本居住条件及比例救济不同。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Constructive eviction的vacating条件
questions.stem: A landlord substantially interferes with a tenant's beneficial use, fails to cure after proper notice, and causes the tenant to leave within a reasonable time. Under the ordinary constructive-eviction doctrine, which is best?
options: Physical removal by a sheriff is always indispensable.
Any minor annoyance permits staying forever without rent.
The doctrine concerns only ownership by adverse possession.
The tenant may have a constructive-eviction defense to later rent.
questions.translation: 严重干扰、通知不修且合理期间搬离，可能形成什么？
questions.rule: Constructive eviction通常涉及重大干扰、notice/cure机会及适时vacating；与只因小瑕疵任意停租不同。
explanations: 不要求房东实际用执达员赶走。
轻微干扰与未搬离不满足题设规则。
不是取得所有权的制度。
正确。题干提供典型条件。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Landlord mitigation不等于保证成功出租
questions.stem: After a tenant abandons a fixed-term apartment, governing law requires reasonable efforts to relet. The landlord advertises and reasonably considers applicants but finds none. What is the central mitigation inquiry?
options: Whether mitigation invariably cancels all unpaid rent.
Whether the landlord owns any other unrelated property.
Whether the efforts were reasonable, not whether a replacement tenant was guaranteed.
Whether the tenant found commuting inconvenient.
questions.translation: 房东依法合理寻租仍没租出，减损是否等于保证成功？
questions.rule: Mitigation通常以合理努力为标准，不保证实际成交；责任与证明负担依给定法。
explanations: 减损只排除可合理避免的损失。
无关资产不是本问题核心。
正确。题干已给定义务标准。
换工作不方便不替代履约或减损分析。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Trade fixtures的及时移除
questions.stem: A commercial tenant installs removable shop shelves for its trade. Assume governing law permits their removal before lease expiration if removal causes no substantial injury and any damage is repaired. All those conditions are met. Which is best?
options: The tenant may demolish the structural building merely because shelves are removable.
The tenant may remove the shelves as trade fixtures.
All business equipment automatically belongs to the landlord from installation.
Any nail makes removal categorically impossible.
questions.translation: 商业承租人店用货架符合及时、无重大损害及修复条件，可否移除？
questions.rule: Trade fixtures有条件的移除规则区别于一般永久改良；须看时间、用途及损害。
explanations: 不能把有限移除权扩成拆建筑权。
正确。依题设满足条件。
商业附着物不一概自动归房东不可取回。
一颗钉子不是绝对测试。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Structural improvement与fixture
questions.stem: A tenant builds a permanent loft structurally integrated into the building. Removing it would substantially damage the structure. The lease gives no removal right, and governing law treats such a loft as a permanent fixture. Which is best?
options: The tenant cannot rely on a trade-fixture privilege to remove this structural loft.
Every improvement paid for by a tenant may always be removed.
The loft is necessarily a movable table.
The landlord must convey fee simple to reimburse the tenant.
questions.translation: 永久嵌入建筑、移除会严重损坏结构的loft，能仅凭自己付钱拆走吗？
questions.rule: Fixture分析关注附着、适应及意图等；付款者身份不自动压倒永久结构属性，本题明定分类。
explanations: 正确。给定规则不允许此种拆除。
费用来源不产生无限移除权。
题干明确永久结构，与独立家具不同。
不存在自动移转整栋产权。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Easement appurtenant
questions.stem: A deed gives every owner of Lot A a nonpossessory right to cross Lot B to reach a road, benefiting Lot A rather than a named individual personally. What is the usual classification?
options: A lease giving exclusive possession of all Lot B.
A profit to remove minerals.
A personal ownership of Lot B's fee simple.
An easement appurtenant to Lot A.
questions.translation: 利益附于Lot A而非个人、可跨Lot B通行的非占有权是什么？
questions.rule: Appurtenant easement有dominant land受益、servient land负担；不等于排他占有或移转fee。
explanations: 通行使用不同于排他lease。
没有取走资源的权利。
没有授出整个所有权。
正确。权利随受益地而非纯个人身份描述。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Profit in gross
questions.stem: Smith Minerals receives a personal, nonpossessory right to enter Terry's land and remove minerals. The right does not benefit another parcel owned by Smith. Which is most accurate?
options: A profit appurtenant to an identified dominant parcel, although none exists.
A life estate in Terry's entire land.
A profit in gross.
Only an easement to walk, because removal of minerals is irrelevant.
questions.translation: 个人享有到他人土地取走矿物的权利、不附于另一地块，是什么？
questions.rule: Profit允许取走土地自然资源；in gross不依赖dominant parcel，appurtenant则附于受益土地。
explanations: 题干明确没有这种受益土地。
Nonpossessory不授出全部life estate。
正确。题干同时说明取资源及无dominant parcel。
移除资源是profit的重要区别。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: License与easement
questions.stem: A landowner gives a neighbor bare oral permission to cross the lawn for one afternoon. No writing, estoppel, irrevocable interest, or prescription is involved. Which is most accurate?
options: An automatic lease for 99 years.
A generally revocable license, rather than a permanent easement.
A fee simple transfer because entry is allowed.
An easement by prescription created instantly.
questions.translation: 仅给一下午口头通行许可、无其他保护，通常是什么？
questions.rule: Bare license是许可，不当然是土地非占有权益；不可撤销license、estoppel或prescription需额外条件。
explanations: 没有授予这种租期。
正确。题干排除了其他创设路径。
允许通行不等于移转产权。
Prescription需要期间等条件。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Necessity：共同所有后分割
questions.stem: An owner divides a single tract, conveying a landlocked rear parcel while retaining the parcel adjoining the public road. Strict necessity exists at severance. Assume ordinary necessity-easement rules. What can arise?
options: An easement by necessity across the retained parcel.
An automatic transfer of fee simple to the road parcel.
A profit to remove every tree on the retained land.
No right can arise without twenty years of use in every case.
questions.translation: 同一整体地块分割时后地无路、满足严格必要性，可能创设什么？
questions.rule: Necessity easement通常检查prior common ownership、severance及该时点必要性；不是单靠长期使用。
explanations: 正确。题干给定典型条件。
只产生相应通行权益。
通行不带任意取资源权。
Necessity与prescription是不同路径。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: 仅方便不等于necessity
questions.stem: Two neighboring parcels have never been under common ownership. One owner wants a shorter route over the other's land but already has legal road access. No statute, grant, or prescription applies. Under traditional necessity rules, which is best?
options: A shorter trip always creates a necessity easement.
Every adjoining owner has a right to cross for free.
The requested shortcut automatically transfers the servient fee.
Convenience alone does not establish an easement by necessity.
questions.translation: 从未共同所有、已有合法道路，只想走近路，能否当然necessity？
questions.rule: Traditional necessity不是“更方便”测试，须符合共同所有、分割及相应必要性等条件。
explanations: 近不等于必要。
相邻本身不产生普遍通行权。
更不移转所有权。
正确。题干同时欠缺典型来源与必要程度。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Implied prior use
questions.stem: Before dividing two buildings, the common owner uses an apparent, continuous stairway in Building 1 as the reasonably necessary access to Building 2's upper floor. Assume all governing implied-prior-use elements are met at severance. What can arise?
options: A tenancy in common of both buildings for every customer.
A rule that no unwritten easement can ever exist.
An implied easement benefiting Building 2.
An automatic fee-simple conveyance of all Building 1.
questions.translation: 共同业主分割前已有明显持续且必要的楼梯使用，条件均满足，可能是什么？
questions.rule: Implied easement from prior use可在分割时根据既有使用产生，和necessity、prescription各有条件。
explanations: 客户不自动成为共有人。
部分地役权可依implied路径形成。
正确。题干明确满足对应要件。
有限使用权不是全产权。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Easement的合理维修权
questions.stem: Amy has a valid stairway easement across Bob's building. The stairs require ordinary repairs to keep the easement usable. Amy offers to pay; repairs stay within scope and do not unreasonably burden Bob. Which is best under ordinary rules?
options: Amy may enlarge the stairway without any scope limitation.
The easement ordinarily includes a reasonable right to enter and make necessary repairs.
Bob can extinguish any easement by refusing all maintenance.
Amy must own Bob's fee simple before she can make any repair.
questions.translation: 有有效楼梯easement，合理必要维修且不加不合理负担，可否进入修？
questions.rule: Easement通常附合理维持使用的权力；维修与扩大权利范围不同，费用及共同使用仍看约定和法律。
explanations: 不能把维修权扩成任意扩建权。
正确。题干明确限于合理维修。
Servient owner不能靠任意拒修消灭既有权利。
Easement本来就是在他人土地上的有限权利。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Scope：通行不当然含电线
questions.stem: A carefully drafted easement expressly permits pedestrian passage only and expressly excludes utility installation. No implied right or statute overrides those terms. May the dominant owner insist on installing power lines under that easement?
options: No; the proposed utility use exceeds the expressly limited scope.
Yes, because any useful activity is automatically within every easement.
Yes, because the dominant owner has the power company's eminent-domain authority personally.
Yes, because a desire to develop land overrides all grants.
questions.translation: 明文仅行人通行、排除公用设施，能否以此要求布电线？
questions.rule: Easement使用须在grant的scope内；utility必要性与通行权不是自动同一权利。
explanations: 正确。题干明确排除扩大解释和其他路径。
便利不等于原grant授权。
私人受益者不自动继受公用事业征收权。
开发愿望不推翻权利范围。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Merger终止easement
questions.stem: A owns both the dominant and servient parcels in the same capacity and complete fee simple. Assume ordinary merger rules. What generally happens to the easement between them?
options: It becomes a mortgage automatically.
It must survive forever regardless of unified ownership.
It transfers fee simple to every prior easement user.
It terminates by merger; a later separation may require a new basis for an easement.
questions.translation: 同一人同身份完全拥有受益地与负担地，原easement怎样？
questions.rule: 完整相同所有权统一通常导致merger；后来再分割是否产生新的implied/necessity easement须另分析。
explanations: 不同于担保债务。
忽略merger。
有限使用权不会变成普遍产权。
正确。旧权利终止不排除以后新来源。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Permissive use不累计成prescription
questions.stem: For twenty years, homeowners use a recreation tract solely under an express permission that expires at year twenty. They never repudiate permission. No estoppel or other right applies. Why does duration alone not establish a prescriptive easement?
options: Recreational use can never be noticed by an owner.
A prescription claim requires a purchase price in every jurisdiction.
The use was permissive rather than adverse.
Every twenty-year use always transfers fee title.
questions.translation: 一直依明确许可用二十年，没有转为对抗，时间够就prescription吗？
questions.rule: Prescriptive use一般须adverse而非许可；长时间使用不是单一充分条件。
explanations: 使用是否可见是另一要件，不是本题障碍。
通常不是付购买价的制度。
正确。许可性质阻止按题设累计对抗使用。
未满足所有权取得或prescription全部条件。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Hostile不是情绪敌意
questions.stem: An adverse-possession statute applies an objective, nonpermissive-use test. A gardener openly occupies land for the full statutory period without permission and meets all other elements. He is personally friendly with the owner. Which is best?
options: Hostility always requires knowing theft in every state.
Personal friendliness does not defeat hostility under the stated objective test.
He must first insult the owner to make possession hostile.
A fight between neighbors' children automatically establishes all title elements.
questions.translation: 题设客观不许可使用标准下，彼此友善会否排除hostile？
questions.rule: Hostile/adverse一般是权利上的对抗概念，不能拿吵架等情绪代替；具体主观标准依州法，本题已给定。
explanations: 各州主观测试并不完全一致。
正确。依题设非许可的占有性质判断。
法律不要求骂人。
争吵不证明actual、continuous等要件。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Disability发生时间
questions.stem: G openly possesses H's land for twenty-five years and meets all ordinary adverse-possession elements. The period is twenty years. The statute tolls only for a disability existing when possession begins; H becomes disabled ten years later. Which is best?
options: The later disability does not toll this period under the stated statute.
Every later disability restarts every limitations period automatically.
H's disability defeats title regardless of the statutory language.
Only a personally hostile motive can make time run.
questions.translation: 法条仅保护起算时已有失能，十年后才失能，是否中止？
questions.rule: Disability tolling须按法条看发生时点；不把后生disability自动加入原有保护。
explanations: 正确。题干明确失能在进入后发生。
不存在题设以外的自动重启。
应按给定法条而非忽略它。
题干已满足相应adverse标准。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Tacking与privity
questions.stem: A adversely possesses a parcel for six years, then voluntarily transfers possession and the claimed interest to B, who continues the same adverse possession for five years. The statute requires ten years and permits tacking with privity. All other elements hold. Which is best?
options: Every possessor must personally occupy for ten years regardless of privity.
An unrelated trespasser can always tack time without any legal connection.
Privity means friendship alone.
B may tack A's six years to B's five years under the stated rule.
questions.translation: 六年后自愿移交权利及占有，接续五年，题设允许privity下tacking，怎样？
questions.rule: Tacking合并前后占有期间通常需privity等连接；不是任意陌生占有人自动拼时间。
explanations: 忽略题设tacking规则。
缺少privity时不能一概合并。
关注法律连接，不仅私人关系。
正确。合计十一年超过十年。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Color of title与独立未占有地块
questions.stem: Suzanne farms Parcel South under a defective deed also describing a separate Parcel North across a road. She never actually occupies North. Assume governing law does not extend constructive possession from one separate parcel to the other. Which is best?
options: Rare walks always satisfy actual possession of woodland regardless of governing law.
Good faith alone supplies all adverse-possession elements.
She cannot establish adverse title to North merely by farming South.
A defective deed automatically transfers every described parcel without possession.
questions.translation: 瑕疵deed涉及独立南北两块，北块未占有且题设不延伸constructive possession，怎样？
questions.rule: Color of title与constructive possession的范围依地块及法域；本题明确排除从独立已占地块扩到未占地块。
explanations: 须满足针对该地块的实际法律标准。
善意不是全部条件。
正确。依给定规则欠缺North的占有基础。
瑕疵文书不能自行变成有效产权。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Future gift promise
questions.stem: John emails Mary, "I will give you my house next month." He does not execute or deliver a deed, make a present transfer, or receive consideration. No will, trust, or other exception applies. What is best?
options: Every expectation of a gift supplies consideration.
The statement is an uncompleted promise of a future gift.
The email necessarily conveys fee simple immediately.
John's later death automatically makes every prior promise a valid will.
questions.translation: 只说下月送房，无现时移转、deed等，是否完成gift？
questions.rule: 完成inter vivos gift须present donative intent、delivery及acceptance等；未来允诺与现时转移分开。
explanations: 期待本身不是交换。
正确。题干明确没有完成移转路径。
不能忽略不动产形式及present intent。
死亡不自动补成合格遗嘱。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Completed gift通常不可任意撤回
questions.stem: Dana presently gives a watch to Eli, physically delivers it, and Eli accepts. The gift is unconditional and valid under governing law; no fraud or other avoidance ground exists. Dana later regrets it. Which is best?
options: Regret alone does not revoke the completed inter vivos gift.
All gifts remain revocable forever because no price was paid.
Eli must give new consideration after accepting a gift.
Ownership automatically returns to Dana at the next birthday.
questions.translation: 有效无条件赠表已交付接受，仅后悔能否撤回？
questions.rule: 完成的inter vivos gift通常无需consideration，不能只因赠与人后来后悔撤回。
explanations: 正确。题干排除了条件及撤销依据。
缺少价款不使已完成gift永远可撤。
赠与与有偿合同不同。
没有这种当然期限。
