questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Lost property：finder与true owner
questions.stem: A customer accidentally drops a wallet on a public shop floor. A lawful finder picks it up. Assume traditional lost-property rules, no employee or embedded-property issue, and no modifying statute. Against whom does the finder ordinarily lack a superior claim?
options: Every later stranger who demands it.
A thief who arrives after the finder.
Anyone who offers the finder a smaller amount of money.
The true owner.
questions.translation: 传统lost property规则下，合法拾得人的优先权通常不能对抗谁？
questions.rule: Finder的相对占有权通常可对抗后来无更优权利者，但仍须返还true owner；失物、遗忘物及场所规则分开。
explanations: 后来的普通陌生人没有因此更优权。
窃贼不取得更优权。
出价不自动形成产权。
正确。题干已排除其他优先占有问题。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Bailment看交付与接受控制
questions.stem: A parking attendant takes a driver's car keys, accepts custody, and undertakes to move and return the car. A ticket says "space rental only." Assuming no effective disclaimer of the duty at issue, which fact most supports bailment?
options: The car's color automatically determines the legal relationship.
Payment alone always establishes strict liability for every loss.
The attendant's accepted custody and control of the car.
The printed label alone conclusively prevents any bailment.
questions.translation: 管理员收钥匙并接受看管、挪车、返还，票上标签是否单独决定？
questions.rule: Bailment看delivery与bailee接受占有控制等实质；成立bailment也不等于所有损失自动strict liability。
explanations: 车色与该问题无关。
费用与bailment、责任标准分别分析。
正确。实际移交和接受控制是关键。
标签不是不顾实际行为的绝对结论。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Entrustment给商人的处分权
questions.stem: An owner entrusts a watch to a merchant who regularly deals in watches. The merchant wrongfully sells it to a buyer in ordinary course, who meets all UCC requirements. Under §2-403(2), which is best?
options: The buyer acquires only a temporary right to inspect.
The merchant can transfer the entruster's rights to that qualifying buyer.
The merchant can never transfer rights because the owner privately prohibited sale.
Every thief selling to any buyer has the same entrustment power.
questions.translation: 交表给经营此类货物的商人，商人卖给合格ordinary-course buyer，如何？
questions.rule: Entrustment是UCC2-403特定例外，须该类merchant和合格buyer in ordinary course；不同于单纯窃贼。
explanations: 本条可移转entruster权利。
正确。题干给足特定例外条件。
私下限制不必然排除本条entrusting。
盗取与owner entrustment不同。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Thief的void title
questions.stem: A thief steals an owner's watch and sells it to an innocent buyer for value. The owner never entrusted it, and no statutory exception applies. Under ordinary title rules, which is best?
options: The thief generally cannot convey the true owner's title.
Innocence always cures stolen title.
Paying fair value automatically creates ownership against the true owner.
Every theft is a consensual transaction of purchase giving voidable title.
questions.translation: 未entrust、没有例外的窃贼卖表，买方善意付款是否必然取得真所有权？
questions.rule: Void title通常不能移转true owner的产权；voidable title在自愿purchase transaction中的例外及entrustment另看。
explanations: 正确。善意购买不是所有盗赃的万能治愈。
缺乏相应例外。
付款不当然压倒true owner。
单纯盗窃不同于经自愿交付的fraudulent purchase。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Devisee不是purchaser for value
questions.stem: O validly conveys land to B, who fails to record. O later dies, and a will purports to leave that land to D. D records first but pays no value. A notice statute protects only subsequent purchasers for value without notice. Who is protected on these facts?
options: D automatically, because recording first cures every missing requirement.
D automatically, because a will reverses every lifetime conveyance.
Neither, because every unrecorded deed is void between the parties.
B; D cannot use that purchaser-for-value protection merely by taking under the will.
questions.translation: 前手有效交付未登记，后人仅受遗赠并先登记，能用BFP保护吗？
questions.rule: Recording act的资格须逐项满足；devisee通常不是purchaser for value，且已生前处分的财产不因遗嘱文字自动回来。
explanations: 先登记不是全部条件。
遗嘱不能任意回转有效生前让与。
未登记不一概使双方间deed无效。
正确。D未满足value门槛。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Mortgagee for value的notice保护
questions.stem: B's earlier deed is unrecorded. A later lender advances new money and takes a mortgage without actual, inquiry, or record notice. The governing notice statute expressly protects qualifying mortgagees for value. Which is strongest?
options: The borrower's risky business plan alone gives notice of every unrecorded deed.
B's earlier date defeats every recording statute regardless of its text.
The lender may obtain priority over B's unrecorded interest under the stated statute.
Lenders can never qualify because only outright buyers pay value.
questions.translation: 明确保护善意有偿mortgagee的notice statute下，新放款人无任何notice，怎样？
questions.rule: Mortgagee是否获保护依recording act；本题明确纳入并给足value/notice条件，不能只背first in time。
explanations: 信用风险与产权notice不同。
忽略所给statutory exception。
正确。成文优先规则可改变普通时间顺序。
法条明确可保护合格mortgagee。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Nominal gift与purchaser for value
questions.stem: After conveying land to W, O later gives the same land to a friend as a gift, taking a purely nominal $1 token rather than genuine purchase value. The friend records first. A race-notice statute protects only purchasers for value without notice who record first. What is the friend's main problem?
options: Recording first removes the statutory value requirement.
The transaction may not qualify as a purchase for value.
Every quitclaim deed is automatically void.
A warranty deed always wins solely because of its label.
questions.translation: 题设明确是真赠与、一元仅象征，先登记能否绕过value门槛？
questions.rule: Recording protection要求满足全部法定资格；名义赠与不是当然purchase for value，不把真实低价买卖一概等同于赠与。
explanations: 先登记不是唯一条件。
正确。题干限定一元纯象征、无真实购买价值。
Quitclaim可有效让与已有产权。
契据标题本身不是优先权万能排序。

questions.subject: 财产法
questions.title: Marketable title与现存违规
questions.stem: A land-sale contract requires marketable title. The building presently violates a binding setback restriction and exposes a buyer to substantial enforcement litigation. No accepted exception or timely cure applies. Which fact most supports the buyer's title objection?
options: The existing violation and resulting substantial litigation risk.
The mere existence of ordinary zoning regulations, without any violation.
The buyer's later discovery of a more attractive bargain elsewhere.
The absence of any defect, coupled only with regret.
questions.translation: 现有建筑违反有效退界限制并面临实质诉讼风险，为什么可能影响marketable title？
questions.rule: Marketability关注reasonable doubt和产权负担等；法规存在与现存违规分开，本题给定实质风险及无法及时补救。
explanations: 正确。不能把违法状态与普通法规存在混同。
一般法规本身不当然使title unmarketable。
另有更好交易不自动给解除权。
后悔不等于产权瑕疵。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Retailer也可能承担strict liability
questions.stem: A commercial car dealer sells a car with a manufacturing defect that causes the buyer's injury. Assume all strict-products-liability elements are proved. The dealer used reasonable care. Which is correct?
options: The dealer may be strictly liable despite reasonable care.
Only the manufacturer can ever be liable.
Reasonable care automatically defeats strict liability.
The buyer must prove the dealer intended injury.
questions.translation: 商业零售商尽到注意，是否因此免除严格产品责任？
questions.rule: Strict products liability可适用于商业销售链条；合理注意不自动消除缺陷产品的严格责任。
explanations: 正确。合理注意与严格责任分别分析。
商业零售商也可能在责任链内。
尽到注意不等于不存在严格责任。
不要求证明故意伤人。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Respondeat superior的根据
questions.stem: An employee negligently hits a pedestrian while delivering the employer's goods within the scope of employment. Why may the employer be vicariously liable?
options: The pedestrian must first collect nothing from the employee.
The tort occurred within the employee's scope of employment.
The employee has no money.
Every person who signs a contract guarantees all torts.
questions.translation: 员工送货中肇事，雇主替代责任基于什么？
questions.rule: Respondeat superior通常要求employment及scope of employment；员工有没有钱并非该责任的成立依据。
explanations: 通常不以先执行员工财产为前提。
正确。关键是雇佣及职务范围。
支付能力不决定替代责任。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Joint and several：不能重复受偿
questions.stem: Under a stipulated pure-comparative-fault and joint-and-several-liability system, G's loss is $10,000 and G is 30% at fault. H and J are each 35% at fault. What is G's maximum total recovery from H and J combined?
options: $3,500 in total regardless of collectibility.
$14,000 in total.
$7,000 in total.
$10,000 from each defendant.
questions.translation: 总损失10,000，原告30%过错；连带责任下最多合计收回多少？
questions.rule: 先按原告过错减少可赔总额，再看被告之间追偿与分担；joint and several不允许重复受偿。
explanations: 连带责任不把总额机械减半。
超过了扣除原告过错后的损失。
不得对同一损害收两遍全额。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: 特殊关系的救助义务
questions.stem: K lies helpless and bleeding after an accident. L is K's spouse, knows the danger, and can reasonably summon help. Assume the jurisdiction recognizes a spousal duty of reasonable assistance. What most directly supports a duty?
options: L happens to walk on the same sidewalk.
Every passerby must provide professional medical treatment.
K must first offer payment for help.
The recognized special relationship between spouses.
questions.translation: 题设承认配偶合理救助义务，最关键的义务来源是什么？
questions.rule: 一般陌生人无普遍救助义务，但题设认可的special relationship可产生合理协助义务。
explanations: 仅路过通常不足以产生同等义务。
合理协助不等于必须专业治疗。
这种义务不以报酬为前提。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: 陌生路人无当然救助义务
questions.stem: L, an ordinary stranger, sees K injured beside a road. L did not create the risk, undertake assistance, or have a special relationship or statutory duty. Under the traditional no-duty-to-rescue rule, which is best?
options: Mere failure to rescue ordinarily does not establish breach of a legal duty.
Being physically present always creates a duty.
Every nurse owes every stranger the same duty on all occasions.
Any death proves all witnesses were negligent.
questions.translation: 没有危险创设、承诺、特殊关系或法定义务的路人，传统规则如何？
questions.rule: 道德上希望救人，不自动等于传统侵权法上的affirmative duty；例外须有额外依据。
explanations: 正确。需先证明法律上的义务。
存在于现场本身不足够。
职业名称不自动适用于任何情境。
后果不能替代义务要件。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Trespass的intent不能从事故倒推
questions.stem: Rocket testing causes an unexpected subsurface intrusion onto a neighboring farm. Assume the tester neither intended an entry nor knew an entry was substantially certain. Under an intent-based trespass rule, which fact matters most?
options: National usefulness automatically privileges every private test.
The absence of intent or substantial certainty of an entry.
No employee personally walked onto the farm, which always ends the case.
The farm was purchased after testing began.
questions.translation: 意外地下侵入，intent-based trespass最关键的欠缺是什么？
questions.rule: Trespass to land要求相应故意入侵；事故结果本身不自动建立intent，negligence或strict liability另分析。
explanations: 社会有益不等于无条件公共必要免责。
正确。题干排除所需intent。
可通过物体等间接造成入侵。
先后来此不自动消灭请求。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Foreseeable risk的范围
questions.stem: A rocket-test operator is sued in negligence for damage at a very distant farm. Assume no reasonable operator could foresee any risk to that farm or persons similarly situated. Which is the strongest defense under the stated foreseeability rule?
options: Hiring competent staff always removes the operator's own duties.
The land was already fragile, so no aggravation can be compensated.
The plaintiff and harm lay outside the reasonably foreseeable risk.
Every industry custom conclusively establishes reasonable care.
questions.translation: 遥远农场完全不在合理可预见风险内，哪项抗辩最直接？
questions.rule: Negligence须把被告应防范的风险与该原告损害连接；行业惯例本身不决定合理注意。
explanations: 不能用选人谨慎替代所有注意义务。
脆弱状态不自动排除加重损害。
正确。依题设，缺少可预见风险联系。
惯例通常只是证据而非最终标准。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: 时间上的but-for不等于法律责任
questions.stem: DeeDee borrows Poteet's car to collect pizza, briefly browses a bookstore, and parks the car safely. An unrelated driver later hits it. The delay created no unreasonable foreseeable risk. On a negligence theory, which is best?
options: Any delay makes the borrower an insurer.
But-for timing alone proves every negligence element.
A borrower never owes any duty of care.
The delay alone does not establish negligence liability for this collision.
questions.translation: 若无短暂延误车不会恰好在那里，是否已经足够证明过失责任？
questions.rule: 时间顺序上的but-for联系不能替代breach及scope of liability；须有可归责的不合理风险。
explanations: 借车人不是当然保险人。
事实因果不是全部要件。
借车人仍须合理注意。
正确。题设排除了不合理风险创设。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Transferred intent与误伤旁人
questions.stem: Doug deliberately shoots a spitball intending an offensive contact with Babette. It misses and strikes Antoinette in the eye. Assume traditional transferred-intent rules. What is Antoinette's strongest intentional-tort claim?
options: Battery, because the relevant intent transfers to the person struck.
No intentional tort because Doug named the wrong target.
Assault necessarily, even if Antoinette never saw it coming.
IIED automatically, without proof of severe distress.
questions.translation: 故意冒犯甲却打中乙，传统transferred intent如何作用？
questions.rule: 在传统可转移故意的侵权中，针对甲的接触故意可支持实际被打中乙的battery请求。
explanations: 正确。实际有接触，故意可转移。
误中他人不自动消除故意责任。
Assault须有对迫近接触的认识。
IIED另有极端行为及严重痛苦门槛。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: 救助者滑倒：不是一切接触都battery
questions.stem: Waitress Marie reasonably runs to help an injured patron, slips on pudding negligently left by the restaurant, and falls onto another patron. Marie neither intended contact nor acted negligently. Which is best?
options: The restaurant is immune whenever an employee slips.
Marie is not liable on these facts; the restaurant's negligence may be a separate basis of recovery.
Marie committed battery solely because contact occurred.
A person who volunteers help is automatically liable for every injury.
questions.translation: 救助时无故意、无过失而滑倒碰人，应怎样区别责任？
questions.rule: Battery要求相应intent，negligence要求breach；受伤本身不证明每个接触者都有侵权责任。
explanations: 餐厅自身过失须另行分析。
正确。分别识别行为人的要件。
接触不是battery的全部要件。
自愿救助不等于严格责任。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Private necessity仍赔实际损失
questions.stem: To escape an oncoming bus, Bill reasonably jumps into Carol's garden and damages her flowers. Under traditional private-necessity rules, which is correct?
options: Private necessity never permits entry.
Liability depends solely on whether Bill owns a car.
The entry may be privileged, but Bill may owe compensation for the damaged flowers.
A privileged entry always eliminates all compensation.
questions.translation: 为避个人危险合理进入花园，实际损失是否当然免赔？
questions.rule: Private necessity可使进入获得特权，但通常仍须赔偿为避险造成的实际财产损害。
explanations: 危急情况下可有进入特权。
车辆所有权与本题无关。
正确。进入特权与损失分配分开。
私人必要特权通常是不完全的。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Licensee与已知隐患
questions.stem: Carol permits Bill to enter her garden to retrieve his wallet, solely for his benefit. Under the traditional licensee rule, Carol knows of a hidden live wire that Bill is unlikely to discover. What should she do?
options: Do nothing because all permitted visitors are trespassers.
Guarantee safety from every unknown condition.
Treat permission itself as complete immunity.
Exercise reasonable care to warn of or make safe the known hidden danger.
questions.translation: 为自己利益获准进园找钱包者，主人已知隐蔽电线危险时有何义务？
questions.rule: 传统licensee规则要求对已知、来客不易发现的危险作合理警告或使安全；并非invitee式普遍检查义务。
explanations: 有许可并非trespasser。
不是绝对安全保证。
许可不能免除已有义务。
正确。核心是已知而来客不易发现的危险。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Injunction需要衡平判断
questions.stem: A cement factory causes a proved private nuisance. Closing it would impose extraordinary community costs. Under a rule allowing courts to balance hardships when choosing relief, which is correct?
options: The court may consider those hardships in deciding whether to issue an injunction.
An injunction is mandatory in every nuisance case.
Economic value makes a proved nuisance legally disappear.
Courts can never award damages for nuisance.
questions.translation: 妨害成立后，是否必须一律停厂？
questions.rule: 侵权成立与选择injunction或damages是两个判断；题设允许衡平权衡，不是妨害一成立就必须全面停业。
explanations: 正确。依题设考虑救济的适当性。
未必必须全面停业。
救济权衡不等于抹去责任。
金钱赔偿可能是适当救济。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Moral wrong与legal tort不同
questions.stem: Which statement best distinguishes a tort claim from a complaint that conduct is merely morally objectionable?
options: A lawful act can never cause any harm.
A tort claim requires the applicable legal elements, not merely moral disapproval.
Every rude act automatically creates a damages claim.
Moral criticism alone conclusively proves negligence.
questions.translation: 侵权请求与单纯道德不满有什么区别？
questions.rule: 侵权责任须满足可适用的法律要件；不赞同某种行为本身不足以建立duty、breach、causation与damages。
explanations: 是否有害与是否违法是不同问题。
正确。先找可适用的法律请求。
冒犯不当然满足具体侵权要件。
道德评价不能代替证明要件。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: IIED不机械要求身体伤害
questions.stem: Assume a jurisdiction requires extreme and outrageous conduct, intent or recklessness, causation, and severe emotional distress for IIED. All these are proved, but there is no bodily injury. Which is best?
options: Any mildly bruised feeling would satisfy severe distress.
The defendant must have physically touched the plaintiff.
The absence of bodily injury alone does not defeat the claim.
Physical injury is always an additional mandatory element.
questions.translation: IIED全部列明要件已证明，缺乏身体伤害是否当然败诉？
questions.rule: 依题设IIED规则，严重精神痛苦是核心；身体伤害不是额外的必备要件。
explanations: 轻微不快不等于severe distress。
IIED不同于必须接触的battery。
正确。题设要件已满足。
题设没有该额外要求。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Res ipsa推论的作用
questions.stem: A barrel falls from a warehouse under the defendant's management. The proved circumstances support the inference that this kind of accident ordinarily would not occur without negligence. What does res ipsa loquitur permit under the ordinary inference approach?
options: Automatic punitive damages.
Strict liability for every warehouse accident.
Elimination of any need to connect the accident to the defendant.
An inference of negligence without identifying the precise careless act.
questions.translation: 事故符合res ipsa基础时，普通推论方式允许什么？
questions.rule: Res ipsa可允许事实审理者推断negligence；不等于每一要件或严格责任已自动成立。
explanations: 不自动产生惩罚性赔偿。
该doctrine不是一般严格责任。
仍须有适当归责基础。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Negligent manufacture仍须breach
questions.stem: A pipe explodes and injures Porter. In a negligence action against its manufacturer, which finding most directly establishes a relevant breach?
options: A reasonable manufacturing inspection would have discovered the defect that caused the explosion.
Any explosion conclusively proves manufacturer negligence.
The manufacturer is immune once possession passes to a customer.
A product can never be defective if it was sold years earlier.
questions.translation: 管道爆炸后，针对制造商的negligence路径最需要哪种事实？

explanations: 正确。明确了应做而未做的合理检查。
结果不能自动证明breach。
转移占有不当然免除责任。
时间与损坏原因须具体判断。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Pure vicarious liability与indemnity
questions.stem: Assume a valid stipulated statute makes a blameless vehicle owner pay $25,000 solely for a permitted driver's negligence. No federal-preemption issue is presented. Traditional indemnity is available to a purely vicariously liable party. What may the owner seek from the negligent driver?
options: A second recovery of the victim's losses for the owner's personal profit.
Indemnity for the $25,000 paid.
Exactly one-half in every case.
Nothing solely because the victim chose to sue the owner.
questions.translation: 依题设有效规则，无直接过错的车主仅代偿，传统indemnity如何？
questions.rule: Indemnity可将仅替代承担的损失最终转由实际责任人负担；按题设，不概括任何现实租车法的有效性。
explanations: 追偿只弥补已支付损失，不供额外获利。
正确。纯替代责任按题设可求全额补偿。
分摊与全额indemnity不同。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Negligent entrustment是直接过错
questions.stem: An owner knowingly entrusts a car to an obviously incompetent driver. Both are found directly negligent and jointly and severally liable for a $100,000 indivisible injury. No statute limits either party's direct-negligence liability. Which is correct?
options: The owner has no liability because it was not driving.
The victim may collect $100,000 twice.
The victim may collect the unpaid judgment from either, up to $100,000 total.
Each defendant is necessarily liable for only $50,000.
questions.translation: 车主也有直接委托过失且已判连带，受害人总额如何收取？
questions.rule: 直接negligent entrustment区别于纯替代责任。连带责任可向任一人追收未获赔总额，但不得重复受偿。
explanations: 车主本身也有直接过失。
同一损失不得重复赔偿。
正确。以未获赔判决总额为限。
连带不等于各自绝对半额。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Negligence通常需要actual harm
questions.stem: Movers negligently drop John's anvil. It is completely undamaged, and John suffers no other compensable harm. Under ordinary negligence rules, may John recover merely nominal damages?
options: Yes; every careless act requires nominal damages.
Yes; punitive damages substitute for missing injury.
Yes; the defendant must purchase the anvil at full value.
No; the negligence claim lacks actual compensable harm.
questions.translation: 虽有过失但原告没有可赔损失，可否仅据negligence取得名义赔偿？
questions.rule: Negligence通常以actual harm为要件；不同于某些可凭侵害权利本身获得nominal damages的故意侵权。
explanations: 不能把所有过失都变成可赔侵权。
惩罚性赔偿不自动填补基础要件。
无损物品不当然要求全值赔付。
正确。实际损害要件欠缺。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Zone of danger并非看到财物损坏
questions.stem: Jane watches from safety as an anvil falls onto her empty parked car. She is never threatened with bodily harm and has no qualifying close-relative claim. Assume the jurisdiction uses the zone-of-danger rule for this NIED claim. Which is best?
options: The NIED claim fails under the stated rule.
Ownership of the damaged car automatically creates bodily danger.
Any visible accident satisfies the rule.
Property damage always proves a close-relative claim.
questions.translation: 安全处目睹自己汽车被砸，适用zone-of-danger规则时如何？
questions.rule: 题设NIED入口要求处于身体危险范围；仅因财产被损而痛苦不满足该入口。
explanations: 正确。题设排除对应身体危险及亲属入口。
财产所有权不是身体危险。
看到事故不等于身处危险。
财产请求与亲属目击请求不同。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Undertaking不自动证明causation
questions.stem: Howard volunteers to rescue Rex and handles a rope carelessly. Rex nevertheless falls at exactly the same time and in the same way he would have fallen without Howard's conduct. No reliance or worsened position is shown. What element is missing?
options: Proof that Rex owned the rope.
A causal connection between Howard's breach and Rex's injury.
A promise to accept a rescue fee.
A rule making every rescuer strictly liable.
questions.translation: 主动救助且有疏忽，但损害完全不会因该行为而改变，欠缺什么？
questions.rule: 承担救助义务后仍须证明该breach造成可赔伤害；undertaking不是因果关系的替代物。
explanations: 绳子产权不是本题要件。
正确。题设排除导致或加重损害。
免费救助也可能产生注意义务。
不是严格责任。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Public records与private facts
questions.stem: A newspaper accurately reports a home purchase price from an open public deed record and publishes a photograph taken from the public sidewalk. Assuming no other wrongful conduct, what most directly defeats a claim for public disclosure of private facts?
options: A newspaper can never invade privacy.
All facts about a homeowner are automatically confidential.
The disclosed information is public rather than private.
Every true statement is immune from every privacy tort.
questions.translation: 公开契据中的房价被准确报道，private-facts请求主要缺什么？
questions.rule: Public-disclosure tort要求真正private facts等条件；公开档案中的事实通常不因本人不喜欢报道就变成私密事实。
explanations: 不能对媒体一概免疫。
身份是房主不使公开交易记录保密。
正确。具体看是否私密。
真实隐私公开也可能构成侵权。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Independent contractor的一般规则
questions.stem: Merchant hires an independent painting partnership that controls its own methods. A painter negligently damages a parked car while collecting paint. Assume no negligent selection, nondelegable duty, or other exception. Is Merchant vicariously liable merely for hiring the partnership?
options: Yes, every customer is an employer for tort purposes.
Yes, every contract creates joint and several liability.
No, because independent contractors themselves can never be liable.
No, not merely because Merchant hired the independent contractor.
questions.translation: 独立承包关系且无例外，客户是否仅因聘用而替代负责？
questions.rule: 一般不为independent contractor每次侵权承担respondeat superior；直接过错及不可转移义务等另论。
explanations: 雇员与承包人须区分。
普通合同不产生这种当然后果。
承包人本身仍可能负责。
正确。题设排除了相关例外。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Partnership business与个人绕道
questions.stem: Partners Joe and Bill operate a painting business. Bill negligently crashes while obtaining paint for a partnership job after a minor personal stop. Assume he remains within the ordinary course of partnership business. Which is best?
options: The partnership-business basis of liability remains available despite the minor stop.
Any brief personal stop automatically ends all business-related liability.
A partner can never expose the partnership to tort liability.
Only the owner of the paint can be liable.
questions.translation: 合伙人采购油漆时小幅个人绕行，仍属合伙业务范围，另一合伙人如何？
questions.rule: 合伙业务中的侵权可能使合伙承担责任，并依适用合伙规则及题设归责；不能只把借车人与承租人关系拿来结案。
explanations: 正确。题设明确仍在ordinary course。
小幅detour不自动等于frolic。
合伙业务中的侵权可能归责。
油漆产权不决定交通过失。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Occasional seller不等于commercial supplier
questions.stem: Sandra privately sells her own used car once. A defective tire later injures the buyer. Under the ordinary strict-products-liability rule limited to commercial suppliers, and with no statute extending it, which is best?
options: A private seller is immune from every possible legal claim.
Sandra is outside that strict-liability category merely as an occasional private seller.
Every private seller is automatically a commercial tire supplier.
The buyer must always prove the seller intended injury.
questions.translation: 偶尔转卖自己旧车的个人，是否仅凭缺陷就负商业链严格责任？
questions.rule: 传统严格产品责任通常针对商业供应者；偶然私人出售不自动进入该责任链，其他过失或保证路径另论。
explanations: 不排除其他责任理论。
正确。按题设区分商业供应者。
一次出售自用物不当然商业经营。
不是要求故意，而是责任主体类型问题。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Justifiable reliance
questions.stem: Hawker knowingly tells Vic that hot dogs contain beef, intending Vic to buy them. They contain none. Vic justifiably relies and suffers proved loss. Which theory most directly fits?
options: Fraud is impossible because buyers must distrust every factual representation.
No claim unless Hawker physically delivered the food.
Intentional misrepresentation.
Battery, without any contact.
questions.translation: 明知配料虚假、意图诱导购买，且有正当信赖和损失，对应什么？
questions.rule: Fraud通常要求重大虚假表示、知情或相应recklessness、诱导意图、正当信赖及损害；违约或不实并非自动fraud。
explanations: 并无一概禁止信赖的规则。
责任不机械取决于亲自交货。
正确。题设给齐了关键要件。
没有相应身体接触。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Public figure仍有商业身份利用利益
questions.stem: Vic uses an unauthorized poster falsely presenting actress Myrna as endorsing his hot dogs. Assume the jurisdiction recognizes commercial appropriation and no protected-news-use defense applies. Which is best?
options: Public figures automatically consent to all advertisements.
Appropriation requires physical contact.
The advertiser is immune whenever no profit has yet been earned.
Myrna's public fame does not by itself defeat an appropriation claim.
questions.translation: 未经许可的广告代言，公众人物身份是否自动排除请求？
questions.rule: 公众人物并不因此放弃姓名肖像的商业利用利益；广告与正常新闻报道要区分。
explanations: 公众身份不是概括同意。
与接触类侵权不同。
尚未获利不当然消灭商业利用侵权。
正确。名气不等于广告授权。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Substantial certainty属于intent
questions.stem: Dan pulls away a chair knowing with substantial certainty that the person already sitting down will hit the floor. He hopes no injury occurs. Under the traditional intent rule, which is best?
options: His substantial certainty can establish the relevant intent.
Intent requires a desire for serious injury in every case.
A joking motive automatically defeats all intentional torts.
Only a signed admission can establish intent.
questions.translation: 明知几乎必然落地，却希望不受伤，是否仍有相关intent？
questions.rule: 传统intent包括目的或对相关后果的substantial certainty；善意愿望不自动排除该认识。
explanations: 正确。明知相关后果实质必然即可。
不要求一律希望严重伤害。
动机和intent分别判断。
可由事实与认识证明。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: 与身体紧密相关的物品
questions.stem: A waiter deliberately knocks a plate from a patron's hand to insult her. The contact is offensive, unconsented, and unprivileged. Under the traditional extended-personality rule, which is best?
options: No intentional tort can occur without medical expenses.
Battery may be established through the plate held in her hand.
Battery is impossible without touching bare skin.
Only property ownership can be involved.
questions.translation: 故意打掉手中餐盘、没有碰到皮肤，也可构成什么？
questions.rule: Battery的接触可通过与身体紧密相关的物品发生，不以直接皮肤接触或骨折为前提。
explanations: 不机械要求医疗账单。
正确。手持物品可属身体人格接触范围。
直接皮肤接触不是统一必要条件。
也可能侵犯身体尊严。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Sleeping victim：battery与assault
questions.stem: D intentionally gives an unconsented offensive touch to P while P sleeps. P remains unaware until later. Assume no privilege. Which distinction is correct?
options: Assault necessarily exists whenever battery exists.
Awareness after waking retroactively creates apprehension before contact.
Battery may exist although assault lacks contemporaneous apprehension.
Neither tort can occur while a person sleeps.
questions.translation: 睡着时被故意冒犯接触，battery与assault有何不同？
questions.rule: Battery不要求当时意识到接触；assault通常须当时合理预期迫近接触。
explanations: Battery不自动证明assault。
事后获知不能倒填当时预期。
正确。两项侵权的认识要件不同。
睡着不使身体免于法律保护。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Future threat与imminence
questions.stem: D emails P, "I will punch you next month." D is far away, and P reasonably anticipates no immediate contact. Under the ordinary apprehension-based assault rule, what is missing?
options: Proof that the email was grammatically correct.
A requirement that P already suffered a physical contact.
A requirement that every threat concern death.
Apprehension of imminent harmful or offensive contact.
questions.translation: 只威胁下月再打，没有当下接触危险，assault欠缺什么？
questions.rule: Assault关注对imminent接触的合理预期；单纯遥远未来威胁通常不满足该要件。
explanations: 语法不是该侵权要件。
Assault不要求接触已发生。
不必都是死亡威胁。
正确。所给威胁缺少迫近性。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Apparent ability与空枪
questions.stem: D points an unloaded gun at P intending to make P believe he will shoot immediately. P reasonably believes it is loaded. Under an apprehension-based civil assault rule, which is best?
options: The unknown fact that the gun is unloaded does not by itself defeat assault.
An empty gun always prevents civil assault.
Assault requires a bullet actually to strike.
P must prove D wanted to kill rather than frighten.
questions.translation: P合理以为枪能立即开火，实际上空枪，是否当然排除civil assault？
questions.rule: 合理的迫近接触预期可根据apparent ability判断；受害者不知道枪未装弹时，真实无弹不自动消灭assault。
explanations: 正确。根据当时合理感知判断。
实际能力与表观能力区分。
击中属于接触，不是assault必要条件。
故意制造迫近接触预期可足够。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Known safe exit与confinement
questions.stem: A shopkeeper blocks one door, but a second exit is clearly visible, known to P, safe, and reasonably usable. P stays solely to finish an argument. Under the stated ordinary rule, what defeats false imprisonment?
options: A store customer can never bring false imprisonment.
P is not confined within boundaries on these facts.
False imprisonment requires handcuffs in every case.
Every argument creates confinement.
questions.translation: 明知有安全可合理使用出口，仍只为争论留下，拘束要件如何？
questions.rule: Confinement通常要求没有原告知道且可合理安全使用的逃离途径；不满意留下的理由不等于被拘禁。
explanations: 顾客也可在要件满足时起诉。
正确。存在已知合理安全出口。
拘束不限于手铐。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Moral pressure本身不是拘禁
questions.stem: A manager asks an employee to remain for an interview. No force, threat, false legal authority, or blocked exit exists. The employee knows she may leave and stays only from a desire to please. What is missing?
options: Proof of severe physical injury, required in every confinement case.
The employee's name on the office door.
Actual confinement for false imprisonment.
A signature on the employment contract.
questions.translation: 没有强迫或障碍，仅不想让上司失望而留下，欠缺什么？

门牌与要件无关。

questions.title: Trespass中的权属误会
questions.stem: D deliberately walks onto the particular parcel in front of him, honestly believing it belongs to him. It actually belongs to P. Under traditional trespass-to-land rules, which is best?
options: Only a desire to violate the law establishes trespass.
Every ownership mistake grants permission.
Trespass always requires substantial physical damage.
The mistaken belief about ownership ordinarily does not negate intent to enter.
questions.translation: 有意进入眼前土地但误认产权，是否当然无trespass intent？

误认不等于实际许可。
某些土地侵入可无实际损害。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Conversion与善意购买赃物
questions.stem: A buyer purchases a stolen watch in good faith and exercises dominion over it. Assume the thief could transfer no title and the jurisdiction follows traditional conversion rules. Which is best?
options: Good faith alone does not necessarily defeat the owner's conversion claim.
Payment always gives title superior to the true owner.
Conversion requires personal participation in the original theft.
A purchaser is liable only if the watch is physically broken.
questions.translation: 善意买家取得盗窃手表并控制使用，善意是否当然免责？
questions.rule: 在题设无有效title转移下，严重干预他人所有权可构成conversion；善意不当然是完整抗辩。
explanations: 正确。题设排除了有效产权转移。
向无权处分者付款不必然获好产权。
不必亲自完成最初盗窃。
严重控制干预也可能足够。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Consent的范围
questions.stem: A patient consents only to examination of her arm. Without emergency, further consent, or privilege, the doctor intentionally performs an unrelated invasive procedure. What is the key consent issue?
options: Consent can never be limited.
The procedure exceeded the scope of the consent actually given.
Any medical appointment authorizes every beneficial procedure.
The doctor's good motive automatically creates consent.
questions.translation: 同意检查手臂，不等于同意无关的额外侵入性操作，关键是什么？
questions.rule: Consent限于其合理范围；没有紧急或其他特权时，超出授权的有意接触可能缺少同意抗辩。
explanations: 同意可以限定对象和程度。
正确。核对同意的具体范围。
并非一概授权。
有益动机不代替同意。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Reasonable mistake与self-defense
questions.stem: P raises a realistic fake weapon in circumstances that reasonably make D believe serious injury is imminent. D uses proportionate force reasonably necessary for protection. Assume the jurisdiction permits reasonable mistakes in self-defense. Which is best?
options: D may use unlimited force after the apparent danger ends.
A fake weapon always eliminates any reasonable belief.
D may have a self-defense privilege despite the reasonable mistake.
Any factual mistake necessarily defeats self-defense.
questions.translation: 对迫近攻击的合理误判，适当程度防卫是否当然失去特权？
questions.rule: 按题设，reasonable belief可支持self-defense，即使后来发现危险并不真实；仍须必要及比例适当。
explanations: 防卫不容事后报复或无限用力。
真实度与当时情境可能支持合理认识。
正确。题设允许合理误判。
规则并非只看事后真相。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Deadly force不能只保护财物
questions.stem: A homeowner sets a concealed spring gun solely to protect unoccupied property from trespassers. It seriously injures an intruder who threatened no person. Under traditional defense-of-property rules, which is best?
options: Ownership permits any degree of force.
A mechanical device is automatically immune from tort rules.
Trespassers lose all protection from intentional serious injury.
Defense of property ordinarily does not justify the deadly trap.
questions.translation: 无人身危险时，用致命机关保护空屋财物，能否仅凭财产权免责？
questions.rule: 仅保护财产通常不能使用可造成死亡或严重伤害的武力；机械装置不能取得主人亲自也没有的特权。
explanations: 财产权不是无限人身伤害许可。
不能以机关规避限制。
侵入者仍有相应人身保护。
正确。防卫程度受限制。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Adult inexperience不降低标准
questions.stem: An inexperienced adult driver injures a pedestrian. Assume no physical disability or emergency. Under the ordinary objective negligence standard, how is the driver judged?
options: By the care of a reasonable driver under the circumstances.
By whatever care this particular novice can personally manage.
By the standard of the least careful driver in town.
By strict liability solely because the driver is new.
questions.translation: 成人新手司机是否依更低的个人经验标准判断？
questions.rule: 普通成年人通常适用客观reasonable-person标准；缺乏经验不自动降低对他人的注意。
explanations: 正确。情境相关，但并非主观能力免责。
新手身份不自动降低标准。
合理标准不是最差人的做法。
新手不因此自动严格责任。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Physical disability的比较标准
questions.stem: A blind pedestrian is accused of negligence while walking with a cane. Under the ordinary physical-disability rule, what is the standard?
options: The pedestrian's purely subjective personal preference.
A reasonable person with the same physical disability in the circumstances.
An imaginary person with perfect vision in every circumstance.
No duty of reasonable care at all.
questions.translation: 视力障碍者的合理注意如何比较？
questions.rule: 身体障碍一般作为情境因素，以合理的同类身体障碍者为参照；不免除所有合理注意。
explanations: 不是纯主观选择标准。
正确。适当纳入相同身体障碍。
不能无视相关身体状况。
仍须合理行事。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Child engaging in adult activity
questions.stem: A thirteen-year-old drives a car on a public highway and injures another driver. Assume the jurisdiction applies the adult-activity exception to children operating motor vehicles. Which standard applies?
options: Automatic immunity until age eighteen.
Strict liability for every act by a minor.
The ordinary reasonable-adult-driver standard.
A child's playground standard regardless of the activity.
questions.translation: 题设采用成人活动例外，儿童公路驾车如何判断？
questions.rule: 在题设通常由成年人从事的汽车驾驶活动中，儿童适用成人合理注意标准，而非普通儿童游戏标准。
explanations: 年龄不产生一概豁免。
也不是一概严格责任。
正确。题设已明确成人活动例外。
活动性质会改变标准。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Bad result不自动证明professional negligence
questions.stem: An engineer uses the skill and care reasonably expected of competent engineers under comparable circumstances. An extraordinary, unforeseeable storm nevertheless damages the structure. Assume no defect-based strict-liability rule applies. Which is best?
options: Every unsuccessful professional service is negligent.
Professionals never owe clients any duty.
A client's approval automatically waives all negligence.
The bad outcome alone does not establish professional negligence.
questions.translation: 专业人士已达合理同业标准，仅坏结果能否自动证明过失？
questions.rule: Professional negligence不是结果担保；仍要证明未达适用专业注意标准及因果等要件。
explanations: 不是保证每次成功。
专业关系仍有注意义务。
批准不一概免除责任。
正确。结果不是breach的充分证明。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Invitee与reasonable inspection
questions.stem: A shop floor has been dangerously wet long enough that a reasonable inspection would have discovered it. A customer slips. Assume traditional invitee rules. Which is best?
options: Lack of actual knowledge alone does not excuse failure to inspect reasonably.
Only deliberately created hazards can create liability.
Every customer injury creates strict liability.
A shop never needs to inspect its premises.
questions.translation: 商店不知道积水，但合理检查本应发现，是否当然免责？
questions.rule: 对invitee的合理注意通常包括发现并处理合理检查可发现的危险；actual knowledge并非唯一入口。
explanations: 正确。须看constructive notice和合理检查。
已知或应知危险也可涉及义务。
不是绝对安全保证。
对商业来客可能有检查义务。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Child trespasser与人工危险
questions.stem: A landowner knows young children regularly enter and cannot appreciate a concealed artificial hazard posing a grave risk. Eliminating it is inexpensive. Assume all other child-trespasser-rule requirements are met. Does a NO TRESPASSING sign alone necessarily defeat liability?
options: No; landowners are insurers of every accident to every child.
No; reasonable protective measures may still be required.
Yes; every sign conclusively removes all duties to children.
Yes; artificial hazards are always legally harmless.
questions.translation: 幼童不能理解隐蔽人工危险且预防负担小，仅警示牌够吗？
questions.rule: 按题设儿童人工危险规则，须评估儿童理解危险能力及合理防护；并非贴牌就自动免责。
explanations: 责任仍取决于列明条件。
正确。符号告示未必能使儿童理解危险。
不是绝对免责公式。
人工危险仍须具体判断。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Landlord保留common area控制
questions.stem: A landlord retains control of an apartment building's common stairway and negligently fails to repair a known broken step. A tenant is foreseeably injured. Which fact most directly supports the landlord's duty?
options: Only tenants can ever control common stairs.
A tenant must own the entire building to recover.
The landlord retained control over the common stairway.
Renting any unit eliminates every premises duty.
questions.translation: 房东保留公用楼梯控制，责任分析关键是什么？
questions.rule: 保留共同区域控制可产生合理维护义务；出租各套房并不自动免除对保留区域的义务。
explanations: 题干明确房东保留控制。
产权并非来客受保护的必要条件。
正确。控制与维护义务相连。
保留区域仍需分别判断。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Protected class与protected risk
questions.stem: A statute requires pool barriers to prevent young children from drowning. Its unexcused violation causes a child of the protected age to drown. Under a jurisdiction adopting negligence per se, what does the statute most directly supply?
options: Automatic proof of every remaining tort element.
An automatic punitive-damages award.
A rule eliminating factual causation.
The relevant standard of care and its breach.
questions.translation: 防儿童溺水法规被违反并造成对应事故，最直接作用在哪环节？
questions.rule: Negligence per se通常以法规确定注意标准及违反；protected class与harm type须吻合，causation和损害仍要证明。
explanations: 其余要件不能一概跳过。
不自动产生惩罚性赔偿。
仍须因果联系。
正确。法规解决相应标准与违反。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: 违法与事故无因果联系
questions.stem: Roger drives in daylight with defective headlights, violating a statute. A speeding driver rear-ends him. Assume the headlight defect played no causal role and no other fault by Roger is shown. Under contributory-negligence rules, what is best?
options: The unrelated violation alone does not bar Roger's recovery.
Any misdemeanor automatically bars every tort claim.
Speeding makes every other driver strictly liable.
A causal connection is never required for contributory negligence.
questions.translation: 车灯违法与白天被追尾完全无因果联系，是否当然共同过失阻却？
questions.rule: 违法不自动证明与本次伤害有关的contributory negligence；仍须看防范风险及因果联系。
explanations: 正确。题设排除了事故相关因果。
不能机械以违法代替归责。
超速者可能过失，但非所有人严格责任。
原告过错也须与伤害相关。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Two independently sufficient fires
questions.stem: Two negligently started fires reach a house simultaneously. Either fire alone would have destroyed it. Assume the jurisdiction recognizes liability for multiple independently sufficient causes. Which is correct?
options: All negligence requirements disappear whenever two fires meet.
Each fire may qualify as an actual cause under the stated rule.
Neither fire can ever be a cause.
Only the fire started first in the morning can be a cause.
questions.translation: 两场各自足以毁屋的火同时到达，机械but-for为何不合适？
questions.rule: 按题设multiple sufficient causes规则，不能仅因另一原因也足够，就使两个实际充分原因都逃脱事实因果责任。
explanations: 仍须证明其他责任条件。
正确。题设采用多重充分原因处理。
不能机械让双方都免责。
不以最早起火时点机械决定。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Subsequent medical negligence
questions.stem: D negligently breaks P's leg. During ordinary treatment, a doctor negligently aggravates that injury. Assume the treatment negligence is a foreseeable consequence within the original risk. Which is best?
options: Doctors can never be liable for treatment errors.
D must be liable for all unrelated illnesses forever.
The doctor's intervention does not automatically relieve D of liability for the aggravation.
Every later negligent act necessarily breaks the chain.
questions.translation: 初始伤害后可预见的治疗过失加重损害，是否自动切断因果？
questions.rule: 可预见的后续医疗过失通常不当然构成superseding cause；原侵权人的责任范围可能包含该加重。
explanations: 医生责任可并存。
不扩大至所有无关疾病。
正确。依题设仍在风险范围。
Intervening不等于必然superseding。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Eggshell plaintiff
questions.stem: A negligent impact that would bruise an ordinary person causes P a severe fracture because of a hidden bone disorder. Bodily injury of this general kind was foreseeable. Under the eggshell-plaintiff rule, which is best?
options: Damages are capped at what a healthy person would suffer.
The hidden disorder eliminates all causation.
P must disclose every vulnerability before using a public road.
D may be liable for the full injury caused, despite its unexpected severity.
questions.translation: 同类身体伤害可预见，但脆弱体质使程度特别重，如何赔偿？
questions.rule: Eggshell rule通常要求接受受害人实际体质；建立责任后，伤害严重程度不必完全可预见。
explanations: 不能机械按健康人轻伤封顶。
特殊体质不自动消灭因果。
不存在这种普遍先行告知条件。
正确。赔偿仍以实际造成的损害为限。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Mitigation只影响可避免增量
questions.stem: After an actionable injury, P unreasonably refuses a safe, ordinary treatment. The refusal causes an identifiable additional $5,000 loss. Under avoidable-consequences principles, what is the usual effect?
options: The avoidable additional loss may be excluded from damages.
All original damages must disappear.
The defendant automatically owes double damages.
Any refusal, however reasonable, eliminates recovery.
questions.translation: 不合理拒绝合理治疗导致可区分增量损失，通常影响什么？
questions.rule: Mitigation通常限制本可合理避免的后续损失，不把最初已成立的侵权损害全部抹去。
explanations: 正确。针对可避免的增量。
不当然消灭最初损害。
没有自动加倍规则。
要看拒绝是否不合理。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Pure comparative fault计算
questions.stem: In a pure comparative-negligence jurisdiction, P proves $100,000 total damages and is 70% at fault. D is 30% at fault. No other adjustment applies. How much may P recover from D?
options: $0 solely because P exceeds 50% fault.
questions.translation: 纯粹比较过失下，原告70%过错、损失100,000，可赔多少？
questions.rule: Pure comparative negligence按原告过错比例减少，即使原告超过50%也不因此一概归零。
explanations: 这是纯粹制，不是修改制门槛。
未扣除原告70%。
70,000是原告过错对应部分。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Modified comparative fault的50%门槛
questions.stem: A statute bars recovery when a plaintiff's fault is 50% or more. P suffers $80,000 loss and is exactly 50% at fault. What is the result under that stated statute?
options: $80,000, because ties favor plaintiffs.
$1 in nominal negligence damages.
P recovers nothing.
$40,000, because every comparative system is pure.
questions.translation: 达到50%即阻却的明确法条下，原告恰好50%时如何？
questions.rule: 修改制须读清“50% or more”与“more than 50%”；两种门槛在恰好50%时结果不同。
explanations: 无该平局全赔规则。
不能以名义赔偿绕过阻却。
正确。恰好达到题设阻却门槛。
题设明确不是纯粹制。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Wild animal的典型危险
questions.stem: A keeper exercises great care, but a captive tiger escapes and bites a passerby. Assume the jurisdiction imposes strict liability for harm resulting from a wild animal's characteristic dangerous tendencies. Which is best?
options: The keeper is immune because there was no negligence.
Liability requires a previous bite by the same tiger.
Strict liability makes causation irrelevant.
Reasonable care alone does not defeat the stated strict-liability claim.
questions.translation: 尽到高度注意但老虎逃出咬人，题设严格责任如何？
questions.rule: 野生动物严格责任关注其典型危险造成的伤害；合理注意不是该责任的当然抗辩。
explanations: 严格责任不以过失为统一前提。
不存在统一先咬一次条件。
仍要证明适用危险与伤害因果。
正确。责任依据并非未尽注意。

questions.subject: 侵权法
questions.title: Abnormally dangerous：风险范围
questions.stem: A court has classified D's blasting operation as abnormally dangerous. Flying rock from the blast injures P. D used every reasonable precaution. Under the stated strict-liability rule, which is best?
options: D may be strictly liable for the characteristic blasting harm.
Every reasonable precaution necessarily eliminates strict liability.
P must prove D wanted to hit P.
D is automatically liable for every unrelated illness in the neighborhood.
questions.translation: 已认定异常危险的爆破飞石伤人，尽到注意是否当然免责？
questions.rule: Abnormally dangerous activity的严格责任须针对使该活动异常危险的风险；飞石是典型爆破风险。
explanations: 正确。活动分类及典型风险均已给定。
尽到注意不是当然抗辩。
无须故意伤害。
仍限于相应风险造成的损害。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Motive使保险合同具有相关性
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Y is charged with killing his spouse one day after obtaining life insurance naming himself beneficiary. The policy is offered to show a financial motive. Assuming authentication and no overriding exclusion, which is correct?
options: The policy has relevance to motive.
Life insurance is always irrelevant to homicide.
Any insurance document is absolutely excluded by Rule 411.
Relevance requires the policy alone to prove guilt.
questions.translation: 人寿保险用于证明杀人动机，是否相关？
questions.rule: FRE401只要求对有争议且重要的事实具有概率影响；人寿保险动机用途不是用责任保险证明过失。
explanations: 正确。可能说明经济动机。
动机可有证明价值。
411不是一切保险材料的绝对禁令。
相关性不要求单项证据独立定案。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Later repair不能直接证明原先过失
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. After a collision, Kathy readjusts the repaired car's brakes. The plaintiff offers that later measure solely to prove her earlier negligent repair. No permitted alternative purpose is involved. Which is best?
options: The repair proves every causation issue conclusively.
Rule 407 ordinarily excludes that use.
Every repair is an admission that must be admitted.
Rule 407 applies only to criminal cases.
questions.translation: 事故后调整刹车，仅为证明此前过失，407如何？
questions.rule: FRE407限制用事故后补救措施证明此前negligence等；其他真实且适用的目的另论。
explanations: 后续修理不自动证明因果。
正确。题设只提出被禁止的过错用途。
修理不当然等于承认。
此限制并非仅刑事。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Civil propensity与good driving record
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. In an ordinary civil collision case, Kathy offers testimony that she is generally a careful driver solely to prove she drove carefully on this occasion. No character-in-issue exception applies. Which is best?
options: Calling it favorable makes it automatically nonhearsay and admissible.
Every description of driving ability is necessarily a habit.
The ordinary character-propensity prohibition applies.
Good character is always admissible in civil cases.
questions.translation: 普通民事碰撞案，以一贯谨慎推这次谨慎，通常如何？
questions.rule: FRE404(a)通常禁止民事中以一般品格推断特定时点行为；与具体habit或可信度用途区分。
explanations: 有利不等于可采。
一般谨慎与具体固定反应不同。
正确。这里是一般倾向推行为。
无普遍民事好品格例外。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Habit不要求事故目击者印证
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A sufficient foundation shows Elmer invariably follows the same specific routine at a particular stop sign. Habit evidence is offered to show conduct there on the accident date. Is eyewitness corroboration of that date always required by Rule 406?
options: Yes; a habit can never be used without an eyewitness.
Yes; the habit must be written into a contract.
No foundation is needed for any repeated-behavior claim.
No; Rule 406 does not invariably require corroboration or an eyewitness.
questions.translation: 充分确立的具体habit用于证明事故日行为，406是否总要求当日目击印证？
questions.rule: FRE406允许habit推断该次行为，不以存在目击者或独立印证为统一必要条件；habit基础本身仍须充分。
explanations: 把额外条件强加给406。
合同不是habit的成立条件。
仍须确立足够具体的习惯。
正确。规则明确允许无该印证时使用。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Employee statement against employer
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. While still employed as a mechanic, Kathy says she poorly repaired brakes during her work. The statement concerns her assigned duties and is offered against her employer in a civil action. Which hearsay exclusion most directly fits?
options: An opposing party's employee statement under Rule 801(d)(2)(D).
Only a dying declaration could apply.
An employee must always be the company's official spokesperson.
The employee must first be unavailable.
questions.translation: 在职员工谈职责范围内的修理问题，针对雇主提出，适用何入口？
questions.rule: FRE801(d)(2)(D)涵盖关系存续时员工就职务范围事项的陈述；不要求员工专门获授权向公众发言。
explanations: 正确。满足在职与职责范围条件。
不以临终为唯一入口。
授权发言与职务事项是不同路径。
此排除定义不要求不可作证。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Dying declaration不要求死于所述事故
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Violet believes death imminent after a collision and identifies its cause. She survives, later dies of an unrelated heart attack, and is unavailable at a civil tort trial. Assuming relevance and the stated belief is proved, which is correct?
options: It automatically qualifies as a present sense impression despite a long delay.
The statement may qualify under Rule 804(b)(2).
It fails solely because she survived the collision.
The exception is never available in civil cases.
questions.translation: 当时相信将死并谈事故原因，后来因无关原因死亡，民事案804(b)(2)如何？
questions.rule: Dying declaration要求不可作证、当时相信死亡迫近、谈死亡原因情形；不要求实际死于该原因，且适用于民事案。
explanations: 不能忽略803(1)的时间要求。
正确。题设给齐对应条件。
不要求立即或因该事故死亡。
本例外包括民事诉讼。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Technical inference不能绕过expert gate
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Mechanic Wrench infers pre-collision vehicle speeds from how overturned wheels continued spinning. The inference requires specialized mechanical analysis rather than ordinary perception. Which route is required?
options: All mechanics automatically qualify for every scientific opinion.
Any eyewitness is entitled to give every accident reconstruction opinion.
The opinion must satisfy the expert-testimony requirements if offered.
Calling it personal opinion avoids Rule 702.
questions.translation: 凭事故后轮子转速作专业速度推断，能否仅称lay opinion？
questions.rule: FRE701(c)排除基于专业知识的lay opinion；专业推断须通过702的资格与可靠性等审查。
explanations: 职业名称不保证具体意见合格。
目击不等于拥有所有专业能力。
正确。看推理依赖的知识性质。
标签不能规避专家把关。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Lay opinion：appeared intoxicated
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Wanda personally observes a driver's slurred speech, staggering, and odor of alcohol. Her helpful opinion is that he appeared intoxicated, without scientific blood-alcohol analysis. Which is best?
options: It is excluded solely because it is an opinion.
A medical degree is always required.
It is necessarily a dying declaration.
It may be proper lay opinion under Rule 701.
questions.translation: 亲见言语步态等普通表现而说似乎醉酒，属于什么？
questions.rule: FRE701允许基于亲身感知、有助理解且不依赖专业知识的lay opinion；并非所有意见都要专家。
explanations: 意见不一概排除。
普通醉酒表现判断不一律需医学学位。
与临终陈述无关。
正确。题设符合普通感知意见基础。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 不能预先堆诚实品格证据
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Quincy testifies from personal knowledge in a civil trial. No one has attacked his character for truthfulness. His proponent offers another witness solely to say Quincy is an honest person. Which is best?
options: The truthful-character bolstering is premature.
Every witness must be supported by a character witness.
Truthful-character evidence is never allowed after any attack.
The evidence becomes admissible merely because this is civil.
questions.translation: 证人诚实品格未受攻击，能否先提出诚实名声支持？
questions.rule: FRE608(a)通常在truthful character受到攻击后才允许这种支持；单纯希望增强可信度不够。
explanations: 正确。尚无对应品格攻击。
无此强制佐证要求。
适当攻击后可能允许修复。
民事身份不取消608限制。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Pending charge可用于证明bias
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Wiener testifies for an arson defendant and is separately charged over the same fire. The opponent asks about that charge to show a motive to shift blame, not a general dishonest character. Assuming no privilege prevents an answer, which is best?
options: Only a final conviction can ever show bias.
The question may be allowed to show bias or interest.
An accusation can never be relevant for any purpose.
Every arrest automatically proves untruthful character.
questions.translation: 同一火灾另案被控用于显示转嫁责任动机，是否一定要先有定罪？
questions.rule: Bias是独立的可信度路径；未定罪的起诉不等于609定罪，但可与具体偏向有关。
explanations: 偏向不以定罪为统一前提。
正确。看具体偏向推理。
不能把609限制扩成所有用途禁令。
起诉不是不诚实行为已证明。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 照片不必只能由摄影者认证
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A photograph of the collision scene is offered. A witness who personally saw the scene can testify that the image fairly and accurately depicts it. The photographer is unavailable. What is best?
options: Every photograph is self-authenticating without foundation.
An image is always barred by the original-writing rule.
The knowledgeable witness may supply an adequate foundation.
Only the person who pressed the shutter can authenticate.
questions.translation: 摄影者不能来，但亲见现场者能确认照片准确，是否一定欠认证？
questions.rule: FRE901可由具知识证人建立足够认证基础；摄影者不是所有照片的唯一认证人。
explanations: 普通照片仍须适当认证。
最佳证据规则非照片一律禁令。
正确。重在有知识并准确描绘。
不机械要求摄影者本人。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Former testimony的opportunity与similar motive
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Witt gives a lawful deposition about a collision. The opposing party has an opportunity and similar motive to cross-examine her. Witt dies before trial. What is the most direct hearsay exception for offering that deposition against the same party?
options: Dying declaration merely because the witness later died.
Business record merely because lawyers filed it.
No exception can ever cover a deposition.
Former testimony under Rule 804(b)(1).
questions.translation: 证人死前证言录取，对方有类似动机和询问机会，适用什么？
questions.rule: FRE804(b)(1)要求不可作证及合格先前证言，针对有opportunity和similar motive发展证言的一方提出。
explanations: 事后死亡不把所有旧话变临终陈述。
存入案卷不自动满足业务记录。
依法deposition可属于本例外。
正确。死亡导致不可作证且给过相应询问机会。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 针对party提出自己的旧信
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. In Winston's civil suit, Abigail's properly authenticated letter admits taking jewelry. Winston offers it against Abigail. The letter was not under oath. Which is best on hearsay?
options: It may qualify as an opposing-party statement despite lacking an oath.
Every unsworn statement is necessarily excluded hearsay.
Only a declaration against interest could cover it.
Abigail must be unavailable before the exclusion can apply.
questions.translation: 经认证的被告旧信由对方提出，未宣誓是否妨碍801(d)(2)？
questions.rule: 对方当事人自己的陈述针对本人提出，通常属801(d)(2)(A)排除定义；不统一要求宣誓或作出时不利。
explanations: 正确。按提出方向和陈述者身份判断。
宣誓不是本路径统一条件。
对方陈述与against-interest不同。
本排除不要求不可作证。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 旧话的实体用途须独立入口
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Charles previously told Winston, in an ordinary unsworn conversation, that Abigail stole jewelry. Charles now testifies inconsistently. Winston offers the old statement to prove the theft. No party-statement exclusion or hearsay exception applies. What is best?
options: A witness's changed story abolishes all hearsay limits.
The old statement cannot be used for its truth on these stated facts.
Any impeachment evidence automatically proves its content substantively.
Every unsworn conversation is testimony in a deposition.
questions.translation: 普通未宣誓旧话，能用于弹劾就一定能证明偷窃事实吗？
questions.rule: 仅有impeachment用途不自动满足truth用途；801(d)(1)(A)另要求先前在列明程序中承受伪证处罚等条件。
explanations: 不一致不取消所有传闻限制。
正确。题设排除了实体用途入口。
两种用途须分开。
普通谈话不等于法定程序证言。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Fifth Amendment也可用于民事问答
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. In a civil theft suit, Abigail faces a question whose truthful answer would create a real, reasonable danger of criminal prosecution. No immunity removes that danger. Can the court reject the privilege solely because the case is civil?
options: Yes; every civil party must confess any crime when asked.
No; every inconvenient question is privileged.
No; the privilege may apply in the civil proceeding.
Yes; the privilege never applies outside a criminal trial.
questions.translation: 民事案问题会实际引发刑事自证危险，能仅因民事而拒绝特权吗？
questions.rule: Fifth Amendment可保护任何程序中具有真实刑事自证危险的强迫证言；不是仅刑事被告庭审才适用。
explanations: 无此概括强制供认规则。
须真实合理危险而非仅尴尬。
正确。重点在刑事自证危险。
程序名目不是唯一标准。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 没有证言可供impeach
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Abigail has supplied no substantive testimony in the civil trial and properly invokes a privilege when first asked about theft. Her opponent offers a past felony conviction solely to impeach her testimony. What is missing?
options: A requirement that every conviction be less than one year old.
A rule making all civil parties automatically witnesses on every issue.
A requirement that every felony concern the same property.
Testimony by Abigail whose credibility is being impeached.
questions.translation: 未作实体证言者，单为impeachment提出前科缺少什么？
questions.rule: 609用于攻击作为证人的可信度；没有所针对的证言时，不能仅换impeachment名义输入不良品格。
explanations: 609并非一年前统一期限。
当事人身份不等于已作全部证言。
不要求每次都同一财物。
正确。题设未给可弹劾的实体证言。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Voice familiarity可在诉讼准备中形成
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Wanda hears Donald's voice only after his arrest, under circumstances reliably connecting the voice to him. She is now familiar with it and identifies the same voice on a recording. Which is correct?
options: The timing alone does not disqualify her voice identification.
Voice familiarity must always predate the dispute.
Only a laboratory expert can identify a voice.
Every voice identification is a hearsay statement offered for truth.
questions.translation: 逮捕后才熟悉声音，901(b)(5)是否一律不允许？
questions.rule: 声音辨认可基于任何时间形成的适当熟悉；不要误套非专家笔迹辨认“非为本次诉讼取得”的限制。
explanations: 正确。看可靠的声音身份联系。
该严格前置条件并非声音规则。
普通熟悉者也可能认证。
身份认证不同于证明话语内容真。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Cross-examination通常可leading
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. On cross-examination, counsel asks an opposing witness, "You went to the park that Wednesday, didn't you?" It is within scope, not misleading, and no special reason forbids leading. What is best?
options: Cross-examination can never revisit direct testimony.
Its leading form is ordinarily permitted on cross-examination.
All leading questions are forbidden in every examination.
A leading question automatically proves its suggested answer.
questions.translation: 正常范围的cross中暗示性问句，是否只因leading就排除？
questions.rule: FRE611(c)通常允许cross使用leading；direct的一般限制不能不加区别地搬过来。
explanations: Cross通常可涉及direct事项。
正确。给定条件下通常允许。
规则区分询问阶段和情形。
问句本身不是答案的证据。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 亲见意识状态的普通意见
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Hospital orderly Hugo personally observes that a patient does not respond, move, or appear conscious on arrival. He offers a helpful ordinary observation that she appeared unconscious, without a medical diagnosis. Which is best?
options: The opinion conclusively establishes the medical cause of unconsciousness.
The existence of a hospital chart always bars eyewitness testimony.
It may be admissible lay opinion if Rule 701's requirements are met.
Every observation about a human body requires an expert.
questions.translation: 亲见到院状态的勤杂员可否说“看起来昏迷”？
questions.rule: 非专家可提供基于亲身感知的普通概括；不因此取得作专业病因诊断的资格。
explanations: 可采观察不等于专业病因结论。
记录存在不抹去亲知证言。
正确。限定为普通感知概括。
不是所有身体观察都专业。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 阻挠证人可显示案件意识
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Parker offers Weiss's testimony that Dillon tried to pay him to give a false account of the collision. It is offered as evidence of Dillon's effort to fabricate a defense, not merely to show a generally dishonest character. Which is best?
options: It is never relevant unless Dillon was convicted of bribery.
Every specific act is barred for all purposes by Rule 608(b).
The attempt proves liability conclusively without other evidence.
It may be relevant substantive evidence, subject to other applicable limits.
questions.translation: 买假证词用于说明编造抗辩，而非一般坏品格，怎样分析？
questions.rule: 行为可因具体妨碍或掩饰推理而相关；不能把608(b)仅为诚实品格的外部证据限制扩成所有用途禁令。
explanations: 不统一要求先定罪。
608(b)不是所有行为证据总禁令。
相关不等于单项决定责任。
正确。这里有独立的具体推理用途。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 403看unfair prejudice及substantially
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A relevant exhibit strongly supports P's case and therefore hurts D's chances. D seeks exclusion under Rule 403 solely because the evidence is damaging, without identifying unfair prejudice or another listed danger. Which is best?
options: Ordinary damage to an opponent's case is not itself unfair prejudice.
Every damaging exhibit must be excluded.
Any slight prejudice automatically outweighs probative value.
Relevance conclusively prevents all judicial balancing.
questions.translation: 仅因相关证据对自己不利，就满足403排除了吗？
questions.rule: 403要求列明危险substantially outweigh证明价值；正常证明力导致的不利，不等于unfair prejudice。
explanations: 正确。须辨别不公平危险与正常证明作用。
不利不等于不公平。
权衡方向与substantially不能漏。
相关证据仍可受403审查。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Disputed claim与settlement
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. After disputing liability for a collision, D offers $8,000 during genuine settlement negotiations. P offers the proposal solely to prove D was liable. Which rule most directly excludes that use?
options: Rule 408 protects only offers by plaintiffs.
Rule 408.
Rule 408 never applies before a complaint is filed.
Every settlement offer conclusively admits liability.
questions.translation: 责任有争议后的真实和解报价，仅用于证明责任，适用什么？
questions.rule: FRE408保护争议请求的和解让步等，不许用来证明该请求有效、无效或金额；真实其他用途另论。
explanations: 双方的符合条件协商都可能受保护。
正确。题设给出争议请求及被禁用途。
不统一要求已正式起诉。
报价可能为避免争讼，不等于承认。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Offer medical bills与伴随事实承认
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Immediately after an accident, before any settlement negotiations, D says, "I ran the red light, and I will pay your hospital bill." P offers only the red-light admission against D. Which is best?
options: The payment offer must be admitted to prove negligence.
Only a sworn admission can qualify as an opposing-party statement.
Rule 409 does not automatically exclude the separate red-light admission.
Every word said beside a medical-payment offer is absolutely protected.
questions.translation: 非和解场景中，“我闯红灯；我付医疗费”应拆开看吗？
questions.rule: FRE409排除医疗费支付提议用于证明责任，不自动保护伴随的独立事实承认；后者可另经801(d)(2)。
explanations: 支付提议的责任用途受限制。
801(d)(2)不一律要求宣誓。
正确。拆开支付提议与事实话语。
409不自动包住整段谈话。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Liability insurance用于bias
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A witness denies any connection to D. P offers evidence that the witness is employed by D's liability insurer solely to show possible bias. Assuming Rule 403 is satisfied, which is best?
options: Insurance can never be mentioned for any purpose.
The employment proves D was negligent.
Only uninsured witnesses can testify.
Rule 411 does not impose an absolute bar on that bias use.
questions.translation: 责任保险雇员关系仅用于证明证人偏向，411是否绝对排除？
questions.rule: FRE411禁止用有无责任保险证明过错，但可允许真正用于bias、agency、ownership、control等目的。
explanations: 不是一切用途都禁。
保险联系不自动证明实体过失。
无此证人资格限制。
正确。题设是偏向用途。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Remedial measure用于争议中的feasibility
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. D claims a guard could not technically have been installed on a machine. After P's injury, D successfully installs that guard. P offers the change solely to rebut the disputed feasibility claim. Which is correct under Rule 407?
options: The evidence may be admitted for that genuinely disputed feasibility purpose.
Every post-accident change is excluded for all purposes.
The change conclusively proves punitive liability.
A simple denial of negligence always makes every change admissible.
questions.translation: 被告争执防护装置技术不可行，后续安装能用于反驳该点吗？
questions.rule: 407允许对真正有争议的feasibility等另作使用；不能假借目的偷偷证明此前过失。
explanations: 正确。题设明确技术可行性受争议。
规则有适当目的入口。
可行性不等于全部责任。
不能把任何否认都当作可行性争议。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Signature method与identity
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Two robberies share an unusually distinctive combination of details strongly identifying the same perpetrator. Evidence of the earlier act is offered on disputed identity, with proper notice and sufficient foundation. Which is best?
options: Prior acts can never be used for identity.
A nonpropensity identity use may be allowed, subject to the remaining rules.
Any previous crime is admissible solely to show bad character.
Calling the act identity evidence automatically resolves Rule 403.
questions.translation: 高度独特共同手法用于身份，而非“坏人再犯”，怎样分析？
questions.rule: 404(b)可容许真正非倾向目的，如有辨识力的signature identity；仍要403及其他条件。
explanations: 规则承认适当identity用途。
正确。须有真实身份推理联系。
单纯倾向用途通常受禁。
仍需权衡及基础。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Character是essential element时的证明
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. In a negligent-entrustment action, the driver's incompetence is an essential element under the governing substantive law. Relevant specific driving incidents are offered to prove that incompetence. Which is best?
options: The evidence automatically proves every remaining tort element.
Only an unrelated reputation witness can ever be used.
Rule 405(b) permits proof by relevant specific instances.
Specific instances are forbidden even when the trait is an essential element.
questions.translation: 实体法把驾驶不适任性设为要件，可否用相关具体事例？
questions.rule: FRE405(b)在character或trait本身为essential element时，允许相关specific instances；区别于仅用性格推该次行为。
explanations: 其他要件仍须分别证明。
不是只有名声一种方法。
正确。题设明确品格本身为要件。
忽略405(b)入口。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Rule 702：proponent的门槛责任
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. An expert has impressive degrees, but the proponent cannot show more likely than not that the opinion uses reliable methods reliably applied to sufficient case data. What is best under current Rule 702?
options: A degree makes all methodology questions solely for the jury.
Every expert must have published a randomized trial regardless of field.
The opponent always bears the entire burden of disproving reliability.
Credentials alone do not satisfy the admissibility requirements.
questions.translation: 学历优秀但未证明方法及应用可靠，702如何？
questions.rule: 现行702由提出方以more likely than not证明可采条件；专家头衔不代替可靠性、事实基础与帮助性。
explanations: 资格与可靠性是不同要求。
可靠性审查不是统一硬套单一方法。
提出方承担门槛证明。
正确。法官仍须审查具体意见。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Expert reliance不等于jury可听全部基础
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. An expert reasonably relies on inadmissible data of a type experts in the field ordinarily use. The expert's proponent also wants to disclose those data to the jury. Which is best under Rule 703?
options: Reliance may be allowed, but disclosure requires the separate Rule 703 balancing.
All reasonably relied-on data automatically become substantive evidence.
Experts may never consider any inadmissible information.
A proponent may evade hearsay by merely calling a witness an expert.
questions.translation: 专家可合理依赖的不可采资料，是否自动可以向陪审团披露？
questions.rule: 703区分依赖和披露；提出方披露原本不可采基础，须满足帮助评估意见的证明价值substantially outweigh其不利效果等要求。
explanations: 正确。依赖与披露分开。
专业依赖不自动洗成实体证据。
规则允许某些合理依赖。
头衔不能任意绕过限制。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Refresh：恢复记忆后由人作证
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A witness reviews a note while testifying and then genuinely remembers the event. Counsel asks her to testify from that refreshed memory. Under Rule 612, which is best?
options: The opposing party may never inspect a writing used on the stand.
She may testify from present refreshed memory; the note is not automatically admitted for its truth.
Only a note written by the witness may ever refresh memory.
The note automatically becomes the proponent's substantive exhibit.
questions.translation: 看笔记后真正想起来，此时的证据是什么？
questions.rule: Refreshing recollection后证据通常是恢复的当庭记忆；提示物不自动成为本方展品，对方有适用检查与询问权。
explanations: 612赋予相应检查及询问权。
正确。区分记忆与提示物。
提示物来源不一律限本人。
不自动收入展品。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Recorded recollection读入与展品
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A witness still cannot recall adequately after reviewing an accurate record she adopted while the matter was fresh. All Rule 803(5) conditions are met. The proponent offers it. Which is correct?
options: A witness must now remember everything for the exception to apply.
Any old paper qualifies regardless of accuracy.
The record may be read into evidence; the proponent ordinarily cannot make it an exhibit under this exception.
The record must always be handed to the jury as the proponent's exhibit.
questions.translation: 符合803(5)但仍想不起来，记录通常如何呈现？
questions.rule: Recorded recollection通常可读入证据；只有对方提出时才可将该记录作为展品收入。
explanations: 正因现在回忆不足才有此入口。
还须鲜明记忆时制作或采认且准确等条件。
正确。注意读入与展品之别。
本方不能仅凭803(5)当然入展品。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 宣誓deposition中的不一致陈述
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A witness now testifies and is subject to cross-examination about a prior inconsistent statement made under penalty of perjury in a lawful deposition. Which is best under Rule 801(d)(1)(A)?
options: It can never be used for its truth.
Every private unsworn conversation satisfies the same provision.
The witness must first die or become unavailable.
The prior statement may be used for its truth as well as impeachment.
questions.translation: 出庭可受交叉询问者的宣誓证言录取旧话，可作什么用途？
questions.rule: 符合801(d)(1)(A)列明条件的旧不一致陈述可作实体证据；不是只能impeachment。
explanations: 不应漏掉实体用途。
普通谈话不符合此处程序要求。
该条要求现在出庭可受询问。
正确。题设给齐对应排除定义条件。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 608(b)的extrinsic evidence限制
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. On cross-examination, a witness denies lying on a job application. The examiner seeks to introduce the application solely to prove that specific lie as evidence of untruthful character. No other purpose or conviction applies. Which is best?
options: Rule 608(b) bars that extrinsic proof for the stated sole purpose.
A denial always opens the door to every extrinsic document.
All cross-examination about dishonesty is forbidden.
A job application is automatically a criminal conviction.
questions.translation: 仅为诚实品格坐实否认的旧谎言，可另提交申请表吗？
questions.rule: FRE608(b)可酌情允许相关交叉询问，但除609定罪外，禁止仅为该诚实品格用途的specific-act extrinsic evidence。
explanations: 正确。提问与外部证明有别。
不能仅因否认就规避限制。
有基础时可酌情询问。
申请表不是定罪判决。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Dishonest-act conviction与刑期长短
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A testifying witness has a recent perjury conviction whose elements required proof of a false statement. No Rule 609(c), (d), or other disqualification applies. Which is best under Rule 609(a)(2)?
options: Every arrest without conviction qualifies under the same provision.
The conviction falls within the dishonest-act or false-statement provision regardless of punishment length.
Only crimes punishable by more than one year can ever qualify.
Perjury cannot bear on truthfulness.
questions.translation: 近期伪证定罪本身要件含虚假陈述，609(a)(2)看什么？
questions.rule: 609(a)(2)针对可直接确定要件包含dishonest act或false statement的犯罪，不以刑罚超过一年为统一前提。
explanations: 逮捕不等于定罪。
正确。要件性质是关键。
漏掉(a)(2)独立入口。
伪证直接关乎诚实。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 609(b)从较晚时点算十年
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A witness was convicted fourteen years ago but released from confinement for that conviction four years ago. Considering only Rule 609(b)'s ten-year trigger, which is correct?
options: Every conviction older than five years is automatically excluded.
The release date makes the conviction automatically admissible for all purposes.
The more-than-ten-year trigger is not met because release was four years ago.
The conviction date alone always controls.
questions.translation: 十四年前定罪、四年前才因该罪服刑完毕，是否已触发609(b)？
questions.rule: 609(b)从定罪或为该罪服刑释放二者较晚时点计算；未触发旧定罪规则不等于自动可采。
explanations: 无统一五年门槛。
仍须其他609及适用条件。
正确。取二者中较晚时点。
不能漏掉release-from-confinement文字。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Prior consistent：回应新编造动机
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A witness testifies and is subject to cross-examination. The opponent claims she invented her account after receiving a payoff last week. She gave the same account a month before the payoff. If otherwise properly founded, which is best?
options: Every consistent statement is admissible before any attack.
Only statements made after the payoff can rebut the alleged motive.
A consistent statement can never have substantive use.
The earlier consistent statement may rebut the claimed new motive and qualify under Rule 801(d)(1)(B).
questions.translation: 被指收钱后编造，收钱前一致陈述有何作用？
questions.rule: 801(d)(1)(B)(i)可用发生在所指不当动机之前的一致陈述回应recent fabrication等攻击，符合条件时可作实体用途。
explanations: 不能无攻击就任意堆叠。
事后重复不消除该动机影响。
符合该排除可有实体用途。
正确。时间先于所指新动机。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Prior identification不要求当庭再次认出
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. An eyewitness identified D shortly after the crime. She now testifies and is subject to cross-examination about that identification but cannot presently recognize D. Which is best under Rule 801(d)(1)(C)?
options: The prior identification may qualify despite failure to identify D again in court.
Every prior identification requires present courtroom recognition.
The identifier must be unavailable.
Any person's rumor naming D satisfies this provision.
questions.translation: 现在不再认得，但就此前指认可受交叉询问，是否一律排除旧指认？
questions.rule: 801(d)(1)(C)允许符合条件的先前感知后指认；不要求当庭一定再次作同样指认。
explanations: 正确。关键在先前感知后指认及现在可受询问。
当庭重认不是统一条件。
本条要求现在作证可受询问。
须是陈述者感知后作出的指认。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Coconspirator：during and in furtherance
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. During an ongoing conspiracy, one member tells another where to deliver the planned stolen goods, advancing their agreed scheme. A sufficient independent foundation connects D to the conspiracy. The statement is offered against D. Which is best?
options: The speaker must first be unavailable.
It may qualify as a coconspirator statement under Rule 801(d)(2)(E).
Every statement ever made by a conspirator qualifies forever.
The statement must have been made under oath.
questions.translation: 共谋进行中为推进计划所说的话，针对已关联的共谋者提出，适用什么？
questions.rule: 801(d)(2)(E)要求during和in furtherance；被抓后向警方追述过去，不能仅凭共谋关系自动适用。
explanations: 不以不可作证为前提。
正确。题设满足期间及推进目的。
不能忽略两个条件。
此路径不统一要求宣誓。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Present sense impression的时间
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. While watching a truck enter an intersection, a bystander says, "The truck is crossing against the red light." The statement describes what she is then perceiving. Which exception most directly fits?
options: Former testimony merely because someone heard it.
No exception unless the speaker first swears an oath.
Present sense impression.
Dying declaration merely because traffic is dangerous.
questions.translation: 边看到边描述闯红灯，最直接对应什么？
questions.rule: 803(1)涵盖描述事件或状态并在感知时或紧接后作出的陈述；不是日后回忆都适用。
explanations: 不是法定先前证言。
本例外不统一要求宣誓。
正确。时间和感知描述相吻合。
没有临终相信等条件。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Excited utterance看持续压力
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Ten minutes after an explosion, a witness remains visibly shaken and under its stress when she blurts out a statement relating to it. Assuming a proper foundation, which is best?
options: Any statement after one minute is categorically excluded.
Any calm planned account qualifies merely by saying "I was excited."
The speaker must believe death imminent.
The statement may qualify as an excited utterance despite the elapsed minutes.
questions.translation: 爆炸十分钟后仍处惊吓压力下脱口而出，是否只因时间过了就排除？
questions.rule: 803(2)重点在statement relates to startling event及当时仍受压力；没有统一“必须几秒内”的机械期限。
explanations: 不存在该统一时限。
需真实基础，不是自贴标签。
临终相信属于另一例外。
正确。看当时持续压力与关联。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: State of mind不包住过去事实回忆
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A declarant says, "I remember that D struck me last year." It is offered to prove D struck the declarant. No other exception applies, and no will issue is involved. Does Rule 803(3) alone admit it?
options: No; it is a memory statement offered to prove the remembered fact.
Yes; every sentence beginning "I remember" qualifies.
Yes; all past beliefs become present-state evidence for their truth.
No hearsay question exists whenever a speaker describes a memory.
questions.translation: “我记得去年D打我”用来证明去年打人，可单靠state-of-mind吗？
questions.rule: 803(3)通常不涵盖用于证明所记忆或相信事实的memory/belief陈述；现存状态与过去事实区别。
explanations: 正确。所提用途是证明过去打人。
记忆标签不构成该例外。
会把限制本身架空。
仍是庭外断言的真实性用途。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Medical treatment：一般病因与归责细节
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. Seeking treatment for injuries, P tells a clinician, "A car struck me, and its driver's license had expired." Assume the first clause is reasonably pertinent to diagnosis but the license detail is not. Which is best under Rule 803(4)?
options: The speaker must always be talking directly to a physician.
The injury-cause clause may qualify; the irrelevant licensing detail does not qualify on that basis.
Every word said in a clinic is automatically admissible.
Past symptoms can never qualify.
questions.translation: 为治疗说被车撞和司机驾照过期，两部分是否自动同样可采？
questions.rule: 803(4)保护诊疗目的且合理相关的症状、病史、起因等；纯归责细节不因同句提及而自动进入。
explanations: 不机械限于亲自对医生说。
正确。逐部分检查诊疗相关性。
地点不替代目的和相关性。
本例外可涵盖过去症状。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Business record中的外人陈述
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A clerk routinely records deliveries. A stranger without any business duty reports an alleged theft, and the clerk enters that report into the regular log. No exception covers the stranger's statement. Offered to prove the theft, which is best?
options: A clerk's handwriting authenticates the truth of the stranger's report.
Regular filing abolishes the need for any hearsay analysis.
The log's routine status does not cure the unsupported inner hearsay.
Every statement becomes nonhearsay once typed into a business log.
questions.translation: 业务账本抄下陌生人说法，能否把内层话一起变可靠记录？
questions.rule: 803(6)业务记录基础不自动处理外人陈述；805须为每一传闻层找到独立入口。
explanations: 认证不等于内容为真或免传闻。
仍需逐层分析。
正确。外层记录与内层信息分开。
入档不改变内层用途。
