questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Public record与刑事检方限制
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. At a criminal trial, the prosecution offers a police officer's report of observations made during the investigation to prove the accused's conduct. It relies solely on Rule 803(8)(A)(ii). Which is best?
options: All police reports are automatically admissible against an accused.
Official authorship alone establishes every exception.
The public-record rule applies only to private companies.
The law-enforcement-observation limitation prevents reliance on that stated route.
questions.translation: 检方仅靠803(8)(A)(ii)提出执法调查观察记录，有什么限制？
questions.rule: 803(8)(A)(ii)对刑事案中的执法人员观察事项设有限制；官方抬头并非绝对准入。其他入口与Confrontation另查。
explanations: 不是所有警方记录都当然可采。
官方身份不替代条件。
该规则正涉及公职记录。
正确。须读该分项的刑事限制。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Against interest要求作出时不利
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. An unavailable declarant admits owing a substantial debt when a reasonable person would not make that statement unless true. It is offered against a nonparty to prove the debt, and all foundation requirements are met. Which exception most directly fits?
options: Statement against interest under Rule 804(b)(3).
Opposing-party statement automatically, although the speaker is not a party.
Present sense impression solely because the debt exists.
Every self-serving statement by an unavailable person.
questions.translation: 不可作证者当时承认重大债务，主要对应什么？
questions.rule: 804(b)(3)看陈述作出时对本人财产、金钱、民刑事责任等的不利程度；不同于由对方提出party自己的话。
explanations: 正确。不可作证及当时重大不利均已给定。
不是只要不利就变成party statement。
不符合即时感知描述的说明。
自利不等于against interest。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Multiple hearsay逐层寻找入口
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A hospital record quotes a patient quoting a neighbor about how an accident occurred. The record layer meets Rule 803(6), but neither quoted inner statement has a valid hearsay route. What is best when offered for the accident facts?
options: Authentication makes every hearsay exception unnecessary.
The business-record foundation alone is insufficient for the inner statements.
One valid outer exception automatically admits all inner levels.
Three layers become nonhearsay because they cancel each other out.
questions.translation: 医院业务记录外层合格，但多层转述未找到入口，怎么办？
questions.rule: FRE805要求combined statements各层均有可用入口；外层正式记录不能包住所有内层。
explanations: 认证与传闻是不同门槛。
正确。须逐层解决。
不能一层带全部。
层数不会互相抵消。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Testimonial陈述与未曾cross
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. In a criminal prosecution, the state offers an absent witness's formal police interrogation statement for its truth. It is testimonial; D never had an opportunity to cross-examine. Assume no forfeiture or other constitutional exception. Which is best?
options: A police signature substitutes for cross-examination.
The clause applies only to civil trials.
The Confrontation Clause ordinarily bars that use.
Any hearsay exception automatically overrides the Constitution.
questions.translation: 证言性警方讯问旧话用于指控，缺少先前cross机会，宪法关如何？
questions.rule: Crawford框架下，不出庭的testimonial控罪陈述通常需要不可作证及先前交叉询问机会；过了传闻关也未必过Confrontation关。
explanations: 官方签名不是交叉询问。
该条保护刑事被告。
正确。题设排除了相应例外。
证据规则不能自动压过宪法。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 亲历事实不因另有文书而只能交文书
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A witness personally watched a payment being handed over. She testifies to what she saw, not to the wording of a receipt. A receipt also exists. Which is best under Rule 1002?
options: The best-evidence rule always demands the single strongest possible proof.
A receipt makes all human witnesses incompetent.
All oral testimony about money is hearsay.
The receipt's existence alone does not bar her firsthand testimony.
questions.translation: 亲眼看到付款而作证，另有收据是否就必须只用收据？
questions.rule: 1002针对证明writing等内容；亲知独立事实不因也有记录就必定要求原件。
explanations: “最佳”不是证明力排名总规则。
文书存在不消灭亲知资格。
亲见事实不因涉及金钱而传闻。
正确。不是在证明收据文字内容。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Duplicate通常不以原件遗失为前提
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A properly authenticated, accurate photocopy is offered. No genuine question concerns the original's authenticity, and using the copy is not unfair. Must the proponent first prove the original was lost?
options: No; Rule 1003 generally permits the duplicate under those facts.
Yes; every copy is inadmissible until the original is lost.
No; every handwritten paraphrase is automatically a duplicate.
Yes; duplicates are allowed only in criminal cases.
questions.translation: 合格准确复本，无真实性疑问或不公平，是否须先证明原件丢了？
questions.rule: FRE1003通常允许duplicate与original同等使用；1004遗失路径不是每次使用合格复本的先决条件。
explanations: 正确。题设排除本条列明例外。
不应把1004条件套给所有复本。
手写概述不当然是准确复制意义的duplicate。
规则不只限刑事。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 无恶意遗失后的other evidence
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. All originals of a relevant agreement are accidentally destroyed without bad faith by the proponent. Proper foundation is established. Which is best under Rule 1004(a)?
options: Any witness may invent terms without a foundation.
Other evidence of the contents may be admitted, subject to the remaining rules.
The agreement's contents can never be proved by any means.
Bad-faith destruction is treated identically under this provision.
questions.translation: 全部原件非恶意意外毁损，最佳证据规则是否一定彻底禁止证明内容？
questions.rule: 1004(a)在原件遗失或毁损且非提出方恶意造成时，可允许其他内容证据；仍须过相关性、传闻等其他门槛。
explanations: 例外不免除真实性及其他证明要求。
正确。原件要求存在列明例外。
没有这种绝对禁止。
恶意毁损是重要区别。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 咨询过去犯罪的合法抗辩
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A client confidentially asks a lawyer how to defend against a completed theft. The client seeks lawful advice, not help committing or concealing an ongoing or future crime or fraud. Assuming the federal common-law privilege otherwise applies, which is best?
options: Handing a physical stolen object to counsel makes the object a confidential communication.
Only innocent clients can consult lawyers confidentially.
The subject of a past crime alone does not destroy the privilege.
Every statement mentioning a crime is unprivileged.
questions.translation: 为已经发生的犯罪寻求合法抗辩咨询，是否仅因谈犯罪就无特权？
questions.rule: Attorney-client privilege可保护为合法法律服务的保密沟通；crime-fraud例外不因谈及过去犯罪就自动成立。
explanations: 物证本身不因交律师就变成沟通。
保护不只属于最终无罪者。
正确。看是否为促进犯罪欺诈寻求帮助。
不是关键词式排除。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Adverse spousal testimony由witness spouse掌握
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. At a federal criminal trial, the defendant's currently married spouse voluntarily agrees to testify about an event she observed before marriage. No confidential-marital-communication issue exists. Under Trammel, who holds the adverse-spousal-testimony privilege?
options: Only the defendant spouse, who can always veto.
Only the prosecutor.
No spouse can ever refuse testimony for any reason.
The witness spouse.
questions.translation: 配偶愿在联邦刑事案作不利证言，该拒绝作证特权由谁掌握？
questions.rule: 联邦adverse spousal testimony privilege通常由证人配偶掌握；被告不能仅凭该项特权否决愿意作证的配偶。
explanations: Trammel不授被告概括否决权。
不是检察官的特权。
适当情形证人配偶可主张。
正确。区分证人配偶特权与秘密沟通。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 婚内秘密沟通与离婚
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. During a valid marriage, spouses privately exchange a communication intended to be confidential. They later divorce. Assume the federal confidential-marital-communications privilege applies and no exception or waiver exists. Which is best?
options: Divorce alone does not eliminate protection for that confidential marital communication.
Divorce automatically makes all past marital confidences public.
Every act a spouse ever observes is a confidential communication.
The privilege applies only to statements made after divorce.
questions.translation: 有效婚姻中的保密沟通，离婚后是否当然失去保护？
questions.rule: 秘密婚内沟通看沟通时的有效婚姻与保密性，通常可在离婚后继续保护当时沟通；不是所有观察行为都受保护。
explanations: 正确。看当时沟通性质。
不会仅因离婚当然消灭。
行为观察与沟通区分。
核心是婚内沟通。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Psychotherapist与普通医患分别判断
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. In a federal-question civil case, P has confidential treatment conversations with a licensed clinical social worker providing psychotherapy. No waiver or exception applies. Which federal common-law principle is most relevant?
options: A rule making every medical document permanently undiscoverable.
The psychotherapist-patient privilege recognized in Jaffee.
A rule that federal law never recognizes treatment privileges.
An automatic privilege for all conversations with any social worker.
questions.translation: 持照临床社工提供心理治疗的保密会谈，联邦普通法如何？
questions.rule: Jaffee承认合格心理治疗保密沟通特权，包括持照临床社工的心理治疗；不能扩成任何社交谈话或一切普通医患。
explanations: 并非覆盖所有医疗材料。
正确。人员资格及治疗目的已给定。
Jaffee正承认此项特权。
须有合格心理治疗关系。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: 刑事陪审团不被认知事实强制约束
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A federal court properly takes judicial notice of an adjudicative fact in a criminal case. Under Rule 201(f), what must the jury be told?
options: It must acquit whenever judicial notice is taken.
The court may never notice any fact in a criminal case.
It may or may not accept the noticed fact as conclusive.
It must accept the noticed fact as conclusive in every criminal case.
questions.translation: 刑事案依法认知裁判事实，陪审团必须接受为确定吗？
questions.rule: 201(f)区分民刑事：刑事陪审团可接受也可不接受认知事实，不能用司法认知强制认定犯罪事实。
explanations: 认知不自动决定无罪。
刑事也可依法认知。
正确。保留刑事陪审团相应判断。
这是误套民事的确定性指示。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Rule301通常只移production burden
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. In a federal civil claim governed by Rule 301, a rebuttable presumption applies and no statute provides otherwise. What burden ordinarily shifts to the opposing party?
options: The ultimate burden of persuasion in every case.
The criminal burden of proving guilt beyond a reasonable doubt.
No burden of any kind can ever be affected.
The burden of producing evidence to rebut the presumption.
questions.translation: 联邦民事301推定，通常转移哪种责任？
questions.rule: 301通常转移提出反驳证据的burden of production，不转移最终burden of persuasion；州法请求的302问题另论。
explanations: 301明确不自动移最终说服。
这里是民事推定。
提出反证的责任会受影响。
正确。区分提出证据与最终说服。

questions.subject: 证据法
questions.title: Rule106可越过必要补全的hearsay异议
questions.stem: Assume the Federal Rules of Evidence apply. A party introduces a misleading excerpt from a statement. Fairness requires an omitted qualifying part to be considered immediately. Under current Rule 106, which is best?
options: The adverse party may require the needed completion at that time over a hearsay objection.
The opponent must always wait until rebuttal regardless of misleading effect.
Any unrelated self-serving statement automatically becomes admissible.
Rule 106 never applies unless the entire statement is offered first.
questions.translation: 断章取义提出部分陈述，公平要求立即补充的部分遇到hearsay异议怎么办？
questions.rule: 现行106明确允许公平所需补全越过hearsay异议，并覆盖statement；不等于所有无关自利话都可加入。
explanations: 正确。限于公平所需的补全。
即时性正是防止误导的目的之一。
不能无限扩张补全范围。
提出部分时即可涉及规则。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 非自愿身体动作
questions.stem: Assume a criminal statute requires a voluntary act. A person with no prior warning of illness suffers a sudden seizure, and an involuntary movement strikes another person. No earlier culpable conduct is alleged. Which element is missing?
options: A voluntary act supporting the charge.
Proof that the victim suffered any contact.
A formal civil contract.
Proof that the accused disliked the victim.
questions.translation: 毫无预警的癫痫发作导致非自愿动作，题给犯罪要求的哪个要件缺失？
questions.rule: 刑法通常要求voluntary act；无意识抽动不能仅因造成伤害就当作自愿行为，先前有过错行为可能另论。
explanations: 正确。题干排除了更早可归责行为。
题干已有接触，问题是行为自愿性。
合同不是一般犯罪要件。
敌意不是所有犯罪都要求的要件。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 有法定义务的omission
questions.stem: A parent intentionally withholds necessary food from a young child despite having a legal duty and the ability to feed the child. The omission causes death. What most directly distinguishes this from a mere bystander's failure to help?
options: The parent dislikes cooking.
The victim is younger than the accused.
The parent has a legally recognized duty to act.
Every failure to help is criminal.
questions.translation: 父母故意不给有能力供养的幼儿食物，责任与一般路人不救助有什么关键区别？
questions.rule: Omission可成为犯罪行为基础，须有法律认可的作为义务、履行能力及相应主观状态和因果关系。
explanations: 个人喜好不能决定法定义务。
年龄差本身不是完整依据。
正确。父母关系产生相应法律义务。
没有一般“所有不救助均有罪”的规则。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 旁观者的一般规则
questions.stem: Under traditional common-law principles, Mort is a stranger who neither caused a danger nor undertook a rescue. No statute or special relationship imposes a duty. He could easily call for help but does not. Which is best?
options: Moral blame alone necessarily establishes manslaughter.
The omission alone does not establish criminal homicide without a legal duty to act.
Every eyewitness becomes an accomplice.
A duty arises merely because the victim asks politely.
questions.translation: 陌生旁观者未制造危险、未承担救助、无特别法定义务，单凭不帮忙是否成立刑事杀人？
questions.rule: 传统规则下，单纯道德上应救助不等于已有刑法上的作为义务。
explanations: 道德责难不能替代法律义务。
正确。题干排除了可能产生义务的来源。
看见犯罪不是当然的帮助教唆。
请求本身不自动创设所有路人的刑事义务。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 明知持有与实际控制
questions.stem: A statute prohibits knowingly possessing a prohibited substance. A traveler discovers that someone placed the substance in her bag, and she immediately surrenders it to police without retaining control longer than necessary. What is the most relevant issue?
options: Whether she has ever traveled before.
Whether the bag is expensive.
Whether all physical presence creates strict liability.
Whether she knowingly exercised the control required by the statute.
questions.translation: 行李被他人放入违禁物，发现后立即交警，最应审查哪个要件？
questions.rule: Possession犯罪仍须阅读法条要求的knowledge与控制；物品在身边不自动证明此前明知持有。
explanations: 旅行经历不是所给要件。
价格不决定knowledge。
题干明确要求knowingly。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Concurrence
questions.stem: A person innocently takes an identical coat believing it is his own and promptly returns it on discovering the error. Under common-law larceny, which is the strongest point?
options: The required intent to steal was absent when he took the coat.
Returning property always erases an earlier completed larceny.
Only expensive coats can be stolen.
A civil mistake can never be relevant in criminal law.
questions.translation: 误拿相同外套，发现即返还；普通法larceny的关键是什么？
questions.rule: Larceny要求取走时有相应盗窃意图；本题以诚实误认排除该意图，而非事后归还自动消灭已完成犯罪。
explanations: 正确。行为与所要求的犯意须相结合。
若起初已经完成盗窃，归还通常不自动免责。
财物价格不决定是否可能构成larceny。
事实错误可否定特定mental state。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Transferred intent
questions.stem: D intentionally shoots at A to kill A but misses and kills B instead. There is no justification. Under the traditional transferred-intent rule, which is best?
options: D necessarily lacks malice because B was not the intended victim.
The intent to kill may transfer to the unintended victim for the completed homicide.
D can be guilty only of a property offense.
Transferred intent requires a contract between A and B.
questions.translation: 意图杀A却误杀B，传统transferred intent如何处理？
questions.rule: 对同种伤害的intent可在完成的侵害中转移到意外受害人；不能因目标认错就当然消灭杀人故意。
explanations: 目标不同不当然排除相应故意。

与合同无关。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 法条明确要求知道身份
questions.stem: A statute punishes battery on an official only when the attacker knows the victim is an official. Rod intentionally shoves a man but honestly does not know his official status. If the jury believes Rod, which is best?
options: The knowledge element concerning status is not proved.
Intent to touch automatically proves knowledge of official status.
Every offense involving an official is strict liability.
The state may disregard an express statutory element.
questions.translation: 法条明定须知道被害人是官员，故意推搡但确实不知道其身份，如何判断？

explanations: 正确。仍可能有普通battery责任，但该加重罪缺少身份knowledge。
两个认识对象不同。
不能把明示knowledge改成严格责任。
法条明定要件仍须证明。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Willful neglect与合理误认
questions.stem: A statute requires a doctor's knowing, willful failure to assist a person whom the doctor recognizes as having a life-threatening injury. The doctor reasonably believes the condition is minor. Which element is most directly disputed?
options: Whether the doctor owns running shoes.
The number of people in the park.
The statute's required awareness of the life-threatening condition.
Whether all physicians are immune from crimes.
questions.translation: 法条要求明知危及生命而故意不救，医生合理相信伤势轻微；争点是什么？
questions.rule: 若题给法条以对危险的认识为要件，诚实合理事实误认可否定该认识；不是医生一律无责任。
explanations: 与犯罪要件无关。
人数不决定法定认识。
正确。题干特别规定了knowledge对象。
医生没有一般刑事豁免。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Mistake of law的一般限制
questions.stem: A valid statute prohibits a stated act without requiring knowledge that the act is illegal. D knows all relevant facts but simply has not read the statute. No recognized exception applies. Which is best?
options: Ignorance of the prohibition automatically excuses D.
The jury must rewrite the statute.
D cannot be punished unless personally mailed a copy.
The lack of legal knowledge alone does not negate the stated elements.
questions.translation: 有效法条不要求知道违法，行为人知悉事实但没读法条；一般如何处理？
questions.rule: Ignorance of law通常不是抗辩；法条另要求willful违法认识或有官方误导等特定例外时另论。
explanations: 题干排除了例外，不能自动免责。
陪审团不是任意改法条的机关。
一般不要求逐人寄送法条。
正确。区分事实认识与法律认识。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 死亡不必只有一个原因
questions.stem: Sarah intentionally poisons a seriously ill patient. The poison and the disease together cause death. Assume the poison is a factual and proximate cause. Which claim is incorrect?
options: The disease may also contribute to death.
Homicide liability is impossible unless poison is the sole cause.
Causation remains an element of the homicide.
Existing illness does not automatically excuse intentional poisoning.
questions.translation: 毒药与原有疾病共同致死，哪项说法错误？
questions.rule: 被告行为不必是sole cause；满足事实与法律因果关系即可，其他原因共同作用不自动排除责任。
explanations: 可能同时存在多个原因。
正确答案。唯一起因不是一般必要条件。
杀人仍须因果关系。
被害人原本有病不自动免责。

questions.title: 假想另一死因
questions.stem: Sarah's poisoning actually accelerates Art's death. She argues he would have died in an unrelated airplane crash had he traveled as planned. Why is this argument insufficient on the stated facts?
options: A hypothetical alternative death does not undo the actual causal contribution of the poison.
Every plane crash transfers criminal intent.
A victim must be perfectly healthy for homicide liability.
Homicide requires a written death threat.
questions.translation: 毒药实际加速死亡，被告辩称若按计划出行也会遇空难；为什么不足免责？
questions.rule: 依实际发生的因果链判断；未发生的另一死亡路径不能自动抹去被告实际致死贡献。
explanations: 正确。题干已给定实际加速死亡。
不存在这种转移规则。
既有疾病不排除杀人责任。
书面威胁不是一般要件。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 未造成死亡与completed homicide
questions.stem: Winthrop administers dangerous substances to his ill wife. Medical evidence conclusively establishes that these substances neither cause nor accelerate her death from cancer. Which is missing for completed criminal homicide?
options: A marriage certificate.
A motive to obtain money.
Causation of the death by his conduct.
Any possibility of a different criminal charge.
questions.translation: 危险给药未导致或加速死亡，completed homicide缺什么？
questions.rule: 完成的结果犯罪要求该行为造成相应结果；可能存在attempt或其他犯罪，不自动等于已完成杀人。
explanations: 婚姻证书不是该结果要件。
杀人不必以钱为动机。
正确。题干否定了实际致死联系。
缺少完成杀人不排除其他罪名。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Attempted murder的intent
questions.stem: A homeowner fires only to frighten vandals. Assume the prosecution cannot prove an intent to kill, though it can prove dangerous recklessness. Under the traditional specific-intent rule for attempted murder, which is best?
options: Recklessness alone necessarily proves attempted murder.
An intent to kill remains necessary for this attempted-murder charge.
Any firearm use proves every degree of homicide.
No other criminal offense could ever apply.
questions.translation: 只想吓人、可证明鲁莽但不能证明杀人意图，传统attempted murder如何分析？
questions.rule: 传统attempted murder通常要求intent to kill；某些既遂murder可基于recklessness，不代表未遂同样不需杀人意图。
explanations: 把既遂的某些malice路径误用于未遂。
正确。其他危险行为罪可能另论。
武器种类不能替代全部要件。
不成立这个罪不等于完全无罪。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Preparation与attempt
questions.stem: Under the traditional dangerous-proximity approach, D buys an ordinary gun and invites his boss to dinner, planning a later killing, but takes no step close to carrying it out. The jurisdiction treats these acts as mere preparation. Which is best?
options: Intent alone completes an attempt.
Buying any gun is always attempted murder.
The boss must know of the plan for any attempt to exist.
On the stated approach, the required act beyond preparation is missing.
questions.translation: 题给危险接近规则认定买枪邀约尚属准备，未遂缺哪个环节？
questions.rule: Attempt须有犯罪意图及超越mere preparation的行为；各法域危险接近或substantial-step标准不同，先按题设标准。
explanations: 意图本身不够。
买枪本身不是一律未遂。
通常不以被害人知情为要件。
正确。题干已明确适用门槛及分类。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Factual impossibility
questions.stem: Intending to steal, D reaches into V's pocket and searches it, but it is empty. Assume this conduct satisfies the jurisdiction's attempt-act requirement. Which is best?
options: Factual impossibility ordinarily does not defeat attempted larceny.
An empty pocket makes the intended theft legal.
Attempt requires successful acquisition of property.
D can be liable only if V is wealthy.
questions.translation: 以偷窃意图掏空口袋，行为已满足未遂门槛；事实不可能是否抗辩？
questions.rule: Factual impossibility通常不阻止未遂：若事实如被告所信，他将实施该犯罪。
explanations: 正确。空口袋是事实障碍。
未偷到不等于意图行为合法。
取得财物是既遂问题。
财富不是未遂要件。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 真正的legal impossibility
questions.stem: D believes that importing blue paper is criminal, but no law prohibits it. He imports blue paper intending to break that imagined law. What is the strongest reason there is no attempt to violate that nonexistent prohibition?
options: He acted too carefully.
There is no underlying criminal prohibition to attempt to violate.
All completed conduct automatically becomes an attempt.
The paper has no market value.
questions.translation: 误以为蓝纸进口违法，实际上无此禁令，为什么不成立违反该禁令的未遂？
questions.rule: 若打算实施的全部行为即使完成也不构成犯罪，不能只靠主观误以为违法创设犯罪。
explanations: 谨慎不是关键。
正确。须先有被尝试违反的犯罪。
既遂与未遂不是任意转换。
价值不决定有无法条。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Common-law attempt后的放弃
questions.stem: D completes all elements of an attempt under traditional common law and then voluntarily changes his mind. No statute recognizes renunciation. Which is best?
options: The completed attempt is automatically erased.
Only police can form a criminal intent.
Later abandonment generally does not erase an already completed common-law attempt.
Abandonment proves the act never occurred.
questions.translation: 传统普通法未遂已完成，后来真心放弃能否自动抹去责任？
questions.rule: 传统common law通常不承认已完成attempt的abandonment抗辩；现代法上的renunciation可能另设条件。
explanations: 题干排除了特别法抗辩。
意图不以警察身份为限。
正确。需区分犯罪前停止准备与完成后放弃。
心理改变不能使历史事实消失。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Solicitation何时完成
questions.stem: Under traditional solicitation rules, D intentionally asks another person to burn a rival's occupied house unlawfully. The request is communicated, but the listener refuses. Which is best?
options: No solicitation can occur without agreement.
The house must actually burn first.
Refusal creates a lawful contract.
The refusal does not by itself prevent completion of solicitation.
questions.translation: 有意请求他人纵火，消息已传达但对方拒绝，solicitation是否必然不成立？
questions.rule: Solicitation通常以意图促成犯罪并向他人提出犯罪请求为核心；不必对方同意或犯罪实际完成。
explanations: 同意是conspiracy的不同问题。
无需先发生纵火结果。
犯罪请求不因此成为合法合同。
正确。拒绝不自动否定已传达请求。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Bilateral conspiracy与假意同意
questions.stem: Kate agrees to a jewel theft with an undercover officer who only feigns agreement and never intends the theft. Assume traditional bilateral conspiracy law. Why is conspiracy not established between these two alone?
options: No genuine agreement of two persons sharing the criminal objective exists.
A planned crime must always be completed first.
Every undercover operation is unconstitutional.
All theft requires a written agreement.
questions.translation: 传统双边conspiracy下，与假意同意的卧底单独约定盗窃，缺什么？
questions.rule: Bilateral conspiracy要求至少两人真实共享犯罪协议；单边MPC路径不同，不能混用。
explanations: 正确。题干明确适用双边规则。
既遂基础犯罪不是一般必要条件。
卧底并非当然违宪。
不要求书面。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Conspiracy与overt act
questions.stem: A statute requires agreement, criminal intent, and an overt act by any conspirator. Two people agree to rob a bank, and one buys a map to advance the plan. Which is best?
options: The map purchase must itself be a crime.
The map purchase can satisfy the overt-act requirement even if buying a map is lawful.
Only the completed robbery counts as an overt act.
An agreement can never be proved without a recording.
questions.translation: 法条要求外在行为，同伙买地图推进抢劫计划是否可能满足？
questions.rule: Conspiracy的overt act门槛通常低于attempt；为推进协议作出的合法准备行为也可能满足。

正确。仍须证明协议及犯罪意图。
无需等到完成抢劫。
协议可由其他证据证明。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Pinkerton责任的范围
questions.stem: Assume a jurisdiction applies Pinkerton liability. A coconspirator commits a substantive offense, but it is entirely outside the conspiracy's scope and not reasonably foreseeable. Which is best?
options: Agreement makes every later crime by anyone automatically attributable.
Foreseeability is never relevant.
The stated limits prevent liability on that Pinkerton theory alone.
The conspiracy itself disappears retroactively.
questions.translation: 适用Pinkerton的法域中，同伙所犯罪完全超出协议且不可合理预见，如何判断？
questions.rule: Pinkerton式派生责任有协议范围、推进协议和合理可预见性等限制，不是对同伙一切行为负责。
explanations: 派生责任不是无限。
可预见性是重要限制。
正确。自身其他责任仍须另查。
不承担该实体罪不抹去既有conspiracy。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 退出不抹去已完成的协议罪
questions.stem: Two persons have already completed a conspiracy. One later effectively withdraws before future crimes occur. Under ordinary traditional principles, which is best?
options: Withdrawal automatically proves no agreement ever existed.
Withdrawal necessarily absolves every past crime.
All conspiracy requires actual theft.
Withdrawal may limit future derivative liability but does not by itself erase the completed conspiracy.
questions.translation: 协议罪已完成后有效退出，会自动消灭已完成的conspiracy吗？
questions.rule: 退出可能影响未来同伙犯罪责任和时效等问题，但通常不自动消灭此前完成的conspiracy。
explanations: 不能倒改过去事实。
没有这种一般追溯赦免。
基础犯罪不必既遂。
正确。区分既有协议责任与未来派生责任。

questions.title: 假意参与侦破
questions.stem: Xavier joins others only to expose their planned theft and alerts police. The jury believes he never intends any theft. Under common-law conspiracy, which is best?
options: He lacks the required intent to achieve the criminal objective.
Every physical act necessarily proves criminal intent.
Only a sworn officer may lack criminal intent.
Preventing a theft is itself always larceny.
questions.translation: 只为揭露盗窃而假意参与且通知警方，陪审团相信无盗窃意图；缺什么？

questions.title: 事后帮助与事前共犯
questions.stem: Only after a robbery is complete, D first learns of it and knowingly hides the robber to help him evade arrest. D gave no prior assistance or promise. Which classification best fits traditional law?

Accessory after the fact, rather than accomplice to the robbery on these facts alone.
No offense can exist after a crime ends.

questions.title: Mere presence

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 中性商品销售与促进犯罪目的
questions.stem: A clerk sells an ordinary coat at the usual price, knowing the buyer intends to wear it while engaging in illegal conduct. The clerk has no purpose to promote that crime and does nothing beyond the neutral sale. Under the purpose-based accomplice rule stated here, which is best?
options: Knowledge automatically replaces the required purpose.
Selling clothing is always a criminal partnership.
Any customer's later crime is attributed to the seller.
The required purpose to facilitate the crime has not been established.
questions.translation: 知道顾客会穿外套从事违法行为，但无促进目的，仅按通常价格中性销售；题给purpose规则如何分析？

explanations: 题设要求purpose，不能直接替代。
普通服装交易不是当然共谋。
没有无限归责规则。
正确。仅依所给事实未证明该要件。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Intent to inflict grievous bodily harm
questions.stem: D intentionally inflicts grievous bodily injury without intending death, and the victim dies. There is no justification or mitigation. Under traditional common-law murder, which is best?
options: Intent to cause grievous bodily harm can supply malice aforethought.
Only a desire for death can ever supply malice.
All unplanned deaths are necessarily accidents.
Murder always requires a financial motive.
questions.translation: 故意造成严重身体伤害致死、无正当化或减等，普通法malice是否只限杀人目的？

explanations: 正确。仍需因果关系等要件。

questions.stem: D knowingly fires repeatedly into a crowded room without targeting a particular person, displaying extreme indifference to human life. A person dies. Under traditional depraved-heart murder principles, which is best?

Extreme reckless disregard may supply the malice required for murder.
Only ordinary civil negligence matters.
The conduct is necessarily voluntary manslaughter.

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Heat of passion与充分挑衅
questions.stem: A jurisdiction recognizes voluntary manslaughter when an intentional killing follows legally adequate provocation, actual heat of passion, and no reasonable cooling time. All these facts are proved. What is the usual effect?
options: The homicide necessarily becomes lawful self-defense.
The intent to kill is legally impossible.
The homicide may be mitigated from murder to voluntary manslaughter.
Only a property fine may be imposed.
questions.translation: 合法充分挑衅、实际激情且尚无合理冷静时间均满足，通常有什么作用？
questions.rule: Adequate provocation可将原属murder的故意杀人减等为voluntary manslaughter；不等于完全正当化。
explanations: 减等不同于正当防卫。

questions.title: Cooling time
questions.stem: After an earlier quarrel, D has fully cooled down, calmly plans revenge, and intentionally kills the victim the next day. Assume adequate cooling defeats provocation mitigation. Which is best?

A delay always makes every homicide lawful.
Murder requires no mental state.
The earlier quarrel alone does not establish heat-of-passion mitigation.

questions.title: Felony murder的基础重罪
questions.stem: Assume a jurisdiction recognizes felony murder for a death proximately caused during an independent, inherently dangerous robbery. A robber unintentionally kills a victim in carrying out that robbery. Which is best?
options: The felony-murder rule may supply murder liability despite no intent to kill.
All unintended deaths are immune from criminal law.
A completed robbery erases all homicide liability.
Felony murder requires the victim's consent.

基础犯罪不消灭杀人责任。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Agency theory限制
questions.stem: A jurisdiction follows the agency theory of felony murder: the fatal act must be committed by the felon or an agent. During a robbery, a resisting victim alone shoots and kills one robber. On this theory alone, which is best?

The victim's fatal act does not satisfy the stated agency requirement.
The surviving robbers are innocent of robbery.
The agency theory abolishes all homicide law.

questions.title: Involuntary manslaughter
questions.stem: A statute defines involuntary manslaughter as causing death through gross criminal negligence without malice. D's conduct meets that definition. Which distinguishes the offense from an ordinary civil accident?

The victim must be a relative.
The required gross criminal negligence, rather than mere ordinary carelessness.
A prior written agreement to kill.

questions.title: 危险必须迫近
questions.stem: Samson knows his abusive father is presently asleep and poses no imminent threat. With no other justification, Samson waits with a knife and intentionally kills him when no attack is occurring. Under the traditional imminence requirement, which requirement for complete self-defense is missing on these facts?
options: An act by the defendant.
Knowledge of the victim’s prior abusive behavior.
A prior encounter between them.
A reasonable belief in an imminent unlawful threat requiring deadly force.
questions.translation: 父亲当前未攻击、无迫近危险，仅害怕以后受害，传统完整self-defense的哪个要件不足？

explanations: 杀人行为已发生；这不是所缺的防卫条件。
题干已有他知道先前虐待的事实，不能因此替代迫近性。
双方已有先前接触，仍不自动正当化后来杀人。
正确。题干排除了当前迫近危险；过去虐待本身不能替代该要求。

questions.title: Deadly force与普通财产保护
questions.stem: D uses deadly force solely to stop minor spray-paint damage to his empty fence, with no threat to any person. Under the ordinary rule barring deadly force solely to protect property, which is best?

Any property interest always authorizes killing.
A fence has the same legal status as an attacking person.
The trespasser's age eliminates every legal limit.

questions.stem: A jurisdiction applies the traditional M’Naghten test. Because of a qualifying mental disease, D did not understand the nature and quality of the act. Which is best?

Every unusual belief automatically proves insanity.
Legal insanity depends only on present ability to speak to a lawyer.

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Embezzlement
questions.stem: An accountant is lawfully entrusted with possession of a client's funds and later fraudulently converts them to personal use. Which traditional offense is most directly indicated?
options: Burglary merely because money is involved.
Embezzlement.
Arson.
No property offense because initial possession was lawful.
questions.translation: 合法受托占有客户资金，后来欺诈性据为己有，最贴近什么罪？
questions.rule: Embezzlement的核心是合法占有他人财产后fraudulent conversion；初始合法取得不排除后来的侵占。
explanations: 没有入室要素。
正确。符合合法possession后转换。
没有烧毁。
合法起点不使后续欺诈转换合法。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: False pretenses取得title
questions.stem: By knowingly lying about an existing material fact, D induces a buyer to transfer title to money, intending to defraud, and the buyer relies on the lie. Which traditional category fits?
options: Larceny by force without deception.
Arson.
False pretenses.
No crime whenever the victim voluntarily hands over money.
questions.translation: 欺骗现存重要事实，使受害人依赖而转移金钱title，传统分类是什么？
questions.rule: False pretenses典型地以欺诈取得title；larceny by trick通常只骗取possession。
explanations: 不是强力夺取。
与烧毁无关。
正确。题干特别明确title转移。
表面自愿可由欺诈促成犯罪。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Larceny by trick
questions.stem: D fraudulently borrows a camera, intending from the start to keep it. The owner transfers only possession for one hour, not title. Which traditional category best fits?
options: False pretenses because title definitely passed.
No crime because deception was polite.
Embezzlement based on an honest initial borrowing.
Larceny by trick.
questions.translation: 一开始就打算不还，以欺骗借相机一小时，所有人只转移possession，传统分类是什么？
questions.rule: 欺骗取得possession但非title，可构成larceny by trick；初始诚实受托后才转换另看embezzlement。
explanations: 题干明确title未转移。
礼貌不消除欺诈。
本题最初就有欺诈意图。
正确。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Robbery中的强力时间
questions.stem: Under traditional robbery rules, D uses force to overcome the victim's resistance while taking and carrying away the victim's wallet with intent to steal. Which is best?
options: The contemporaneous force supports robbery rather than mere nonforcible larceny.
Any force used years later necessarily converts a theft into robbery.
Robbery requires written deception.
A wallet cannot be the object of robbery.
questions.translation: 取走钱包时用强力克服抵抗，和无暴力盗窃如何区别？
questions.rule: Robbery是在从人身或其控制范围取财的盗窃中，结合适当时间的force或intimidation；时间联系重要。
explanations: 正确。题干已给定同时强取。
不能将任何遥远事后强力都追溯成robbery。
不以书面欺诈为要件。
钱包可属于personal property。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 临时恶作剧与assault
questions.stem: Baker stages a fake holdup using a realistic toy gun only to frighten Able, always intending to return the money immediately. Able reasonably anticipates immediate harmful contact. Under traditional assault and larceny rules, which is best?
options: A toy gun can never support assault.
Assault may be established even if the required intent permanently to deprive is absent for robbery.
Every temporary taking is necessarily armed robbery.
The victim must know the gun is fake for assault.
questions.translation: 逼真玩具枪恶作剧，始终只想暂取即还，但造成合理迫近伤害预期，可能构成什么？
questions.rule: Apprehension-type assault可由逼真威胁构成；robbery仍包含larceny所要求的财产意图，不能以恐吓自动替代。
explanations: 外观可造成合理预期。
正确。分别检查人身和财产要件。
永久剥夺意图不能忽略。
若知道无害反可能影响合理预期。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Extortion的未来威胁
questions.stem: Assume a statute defines extortion as obtaining property by a wrongful threat of future injury. D obtains money by threatening to burn the victim's shop next week. Which fact most directly fits the stated extortion definition?
options: The victim owns a shop.
The threat is written in blue ink.
The wrongful threat of future injury used to obtain money.
The absence of any spoken words.
questions.translation: 题给勒索定义为以未来伤害威胁取财，下周烧店威胁对应什么？
questions.rule: Extortion与robbery常需区分未来威胁与即时强力/恐吓；具体依题给法条，不机械套所有法域。
explanations: 仅有店面不是犯罪。
笔色无关。
正确。直接符合所给定义。
书面或口头形式通常不是本题关键。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Burglary看进入时意图
questions.stem: D lawfully enters another's dwelling for a social visit without any criminal plan, then only after entry decides to steal a vase. Under the traditional rule requiring felonious intent at entry, which is best?
options: Later intent always retroactively supplies intent at entry.
D is automatically innocent of theft as well.
Any visit becomes burglary once a vase is seen.
The later decision alone does not establish the required burglary intent at entry.
questions.translation: 进入时无犯罪计划，进屋后才决定偷花瓶，传统burglary要件如何处理？
questions.rule: 传统burglary要求在相应breaking/entry时有实施felony的意图；后生意图不自动追溯，其他罪名仍可能成立。
explanations: Concurrence不能任意倒填。
仍可能构成后来完成的larceny。
物品出现不自动产生先前意图。
正确。按题给时间要求。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: 自己的房子也可能是他人dwelling
questions.stem: Digby owns a cottage but has leased possession to Tanner. At night she opens the door with her key without Tanner's permission and enters intending arson. Assume traditional burglary rules, including constructive or actual breaking, apply. Which is best?
options: Her title alone does not defeat burglary because the dwelling is occupied by another.
A landlord always consents on the tenant's behalf.
Using a key can never constitute a breaking.
Burglary requires theft and cannot involve intended arson.
questions.translation: 房东把房屋租给房客后，夜间未经同意用钥匙进入欲纵火，所有权本身能否排除burglary？
questions.rule: 传统burglary保护他人居住占有利益；title属于进入者不当然排除dwelling of another，用钥匙非法开门也可能是breaking。
explanations: 正确。看占有而非只看产权。
不能以所有权无限替代房客同意。
非法用钥匙开门仍可满足breaking。
入内欲实施的felony不只限盗窃。

questions.subject: 刑法
questions.title: Arson须烧到结构
questions.stem: Digby maliciously sets a tenant's mattress alight intending to burn the dwelling. The tenant extinguishes it before any part of the building is charred. Under traditional arson rules requiring charring of the dwelling, which is best?
options: The mattress alone always completes common-law arson of the building.
Attempted arson may exist although completed arson of the dwelling is not established.
No attempt is possible if the fire is extinguished.
Ownership of a mattress eliminates all intent.
questions.translation: 只烧着床垫、建筑结构未被烧焦，传统arson与attempt怎么区分？
questions.rule: 传统arson通常要求dwelling结构发生charring，单纯家具损坏不必然完成；已经开始纵火仍可能达到attempt门槛。
explanations: 家具和建筑结构要区分。
正确。按题给传统完成要件判断。
结果被阻止不自动否定未遂。
财产归属不消灭放火意图。

questions.subject: 刑事诉讼法
questions.title: 纯私人搜查
questions.stem: A private roommate, acting entirely on her own and not as a police agent, opens D's bag and finds illegal drugs. She hands them to police, who do not exceed the private search. Which is best under the Fourth Amendment?
options: The Amendment automatically governs every private search.
The purely private search is not itself governmental conduct covered by that Amendment.
The roommate must be a judge.
Every later prosecution must be dismissed.
questions.translation: 室友完全自行搜包、并非警方代理，第四修正案是否直接约束该私人行为？
questions.rule: Fourth Amendment通常要求government conduct；私人行为可能违法，但不能仅因不合意就自动成为联邦宪法搜查。
explanations: 忽略政府行为门槛。
正确。还须分别判断警方后续是否超出私人搜查。
私人无需是法官才能把物品交警方。
即使有违法搜查也不自动撤销起诉。

questions.subject: 刑事诉讼法
questions.title: 权利具有个人性
questions.stem: Police unlawfully search the driver's locked suitcase. A passenger owns neither the suitcase nor its contents and has no privacy interest in it. The passenger objects solely because the evidence incriminates him. Which is best?
options: Being incriminated automatically gives a privacy interest in every container.
Any passenger owns all suitcases by law.
A defendant generally must show violation of his own Fourth Amendment rights.
No one ever has privacy in luggage.
questions.translation: 证据不利于乘客，但乘客对被搜箱子无隐私权益，能否只凭不利后果排除？
questions.rule: Fourth Amendment权利通常是personal；被搜证据牵连自己，不自动赋予对他人箱包的隐私利益。
explanations: 入罪效果不等于自身权利被侵害。
乘车不转移财产权。
正确。另有对停车扣留等自身权利的主张须分别分析。
行李可能享有隐私。

questions.subject: 刑事诉讼法
questions.title: 旅馆客房的隐私
questions.stem: A hotel guest occupies a room during a valid rental period. Police seek to search it with no warrant, exigency, or guest consent. May the hotel clerk authorize entry merely because the hotel owns the building?
options: Yes, ownership always eliminates guest privacy.
Yes, all rented rooms are public spaces.
Yes, any employee may waive every occupant's rights.
No; the hotel's ownership alone does not authorize waiver of the guest's privacy.
questions.translation: 有效入住期内，酒店前台能否仅因酒店拥有建筑就同意警方搜住客房间？
questions.rule: 住客有效占有期间可有隐私期待；酒店人员并不因此有权替住客同意刑事搜查。
explanations: 所有权与住客隐私须区分。
客房不是一律公共场所。
员工身份不等于共同权限。
正确。其他合法入内依据题干已排除。

questions.subject: 刑事诉讼法
questions.title: Overnight guest
questions.stem: D is an invited overnight guest in a friend's home and has the ordinary privacy interest recognized for such a guest. Police unlawfully search the home. Which is most accurate?
options: D may assert his own protected privacy interest despite not owning the house.
Only the deed owner can ever object.
An invitation necessarily transfers title.
Every brief commercial visitor has identical rights automatically.
questions.translation: 获邀请过夜的客人，没有房屋产权是否必然无权主张隐私？
questions.rule: Overnight guest可有受保护隐私期待；不等于所有短暂停留或纯商业访客自动相同。
explanations: 正确。隐私权不限于所有权人。
产权不是唯一来源。
邀请不转移title。
访客性质仍须区分。

questions.subject: 刑事诉讼法
questions.title: Curtilage中的侦查警犬
questions.stem: Without consent, a warrant, or another exception, police enter the protected area immediately around a home and bring a drug-detection dog to the back door to investigate. Which is best?
options: A dog can never be part of a search.
The investigative intrusion into protected curtilage may itself be a Fourth Amendment search.
Any backyard is automatically an open field.
A later discovery retroactively supplies all authority.
questions.translation: 无令状或例外，警方进入住宅受保护近旁区域带警犬侦查，是否本身可能构成搜查？
questions.rule: Jardines将为搜集证据而越过住宅curtilage许可范围的实物侵入视为search；不能概括“警犬嗅闻永不受保护”。
explanations: 要看地点、侵入及用途。
正确。不是所有地点嗅闻同一规则。
住宅近旁保护不同于open fields。
不能用事后结果倒造根据。

questions.title: 搜家与抓人的PC不同
questions.stem: Police have probable cause that D committed fraud but no facts suggesting evidence is inside a particular home. Which inference is unwarranted?
options: Probable cause is evaluated from facts.
A search warrant must identify a place.
Probable cause to arrest D automatically supplies probable cause to search every home D has visited.
A nexus to the place to be searched matters.

搜查令须有地点特定性。

Nexus是关键。

questions.subject: 刑事诉讼法
questions.title: 可靠线人和hearsay
questions.stem: A warrant affidavit describes an informant's recent firsthand purchase of illegal bets at an apartment, prior reliable tips, and corroboration. Is the affidavit invalid solely because it uses hearsay and omits the informant's name?
options: Yes; all warrant facts must be trial-admissible firsthand testimony.
Yes; anonymity always destroys probable cause.
Yes; prior reliability is irrelevant.
No; those features are assessed under the totality of circumstances.
questions.translation: 线人亲身信息、既往可靠与核实俱在，是否仅因hearsay及未披露姓名就令搜查令无效？
questions.rule: Gates总体情况分析线人可信度、知识来源及核实；令状可依可靠hearsay，不适用庭审的全面排除。
explanations: 令状基础不必逐项符合庭审传闻规则。
匿名不是自动无效。
既往可靠性可能相关。
正确。仍须总体足以建立PC。

questions.subject: 刑事诉讼法
questions.title: 令状范围与容器大小
questions.stem: A valid warrant authorizes a search for one large stolen television. Officers open a tiny pillbox that plainly cannot hold it, and no other exception applies. Which is best?
options: Opening that box exceeds the warrant's object-based scope.
A valid warrant permits every container to be opened regardless of size.
Any box must contain the television legally.
A residence loses all protection once police enter.
questions.translation: 只准找大电视的令状，能否翻装不下电视的小药盒？
questions.rule: 可搜范围依令状所找对象及可能藏匿地点；合法进入不等于无限翻找。
explanations: 正确。题干排除其他依据。
范围仍有限制。
物理大小有意义。
进入不使所有隐私消失。

questions.subject: 刑事诉讼法
questions.title: Neutral magistrate
questions.stem: An investigator issues his own search warrant while actively leading the same investigation. Which constitutional concern is most direct?
options: The warrant is not printed in color.
The issuer is not neutral and detached.
The suspect did not write the warrant.
Every warrant must be signed by all jurors.

explanations: 颜色无关。

不要求嫌疑人书写。
不由全体陪审员签发。

questions.stem: An officer has probable cause for a felony and makes an otherwise lawful arrest in a public place. No home entry is involved. Under the ordinary federal constitutional rule, which is best?

Only reasonable suspicion is ever needed for arrest.
The absence of an arrest warrant alone does not make this public felony arrest unconstitutional.
Public arrests never require any objective basis.
questions.translation: 公共场所有重罪PC的合法逮捕，是否仅因无逮捕令即违宪？

正式逮捕通常须PC。
正确。题干保留其他合法条件。

The front door has no constitutional significance.
A felony allegation eliminates the warrant rule.

questions.stem: Police have an arrest warrant for A and want to search B's home for A. B has not consented, no exigency exists, and B's own rights are at issue. Which is best?

Any warrant for any person permits searching every house.
B loses privacy because A is suspected.
A police hunch replaces all warrants.

questions.title: Terry stop的门槛
questions.stem: An officer identifies specific, articulable facts supporting reasonable suspicion that a person is committing a crime and briefly detains him to investigate. Which threshold is ordinarily relevant to this Terry stop?

Reasonable suspicion, rather than a bare unparticularized hunch.
A civil jury verdict.
No facts at all.

explanations: 这是定罪证明标准。
正确。仍有范围和持续时间限制。
不是民事裁决问题。

questions.title: 能拦不等于能拍查
questions.stem: An officer lawfully makes a brief investigative stop but has no reasonable suspicion the person is armed and dangerous. Which is best?

A stop automatically proves the person has a gun.
The stop alone does not establish the separate basis for a protective frisk.
Frisks require a completed jury trial.
questions.translation: 拦查合法，但无合理怀疑其携械且危险，能否自动frisk？
questions.rule: Stop的犯罪怀疑与frisk的armed-and-dangerous安全根据须分开。
explanations: Stop不是无限搜证权。
合法拦查不证明武器。

拍查不需先庭审，但需适当现场根据。

questions.title: Plain feel不可反复操弄

Anything felt can be removed without more.
A lawful stop eliminates all limits.
The further manipulation exceeds the protective frisk and cannot be justified by plain feel on these facts.

Stop不消除范围限制。

questions.title: 交通任务不能任意延长
questions.stem: After completing a traffic stop's ordinary tasks, officers detain the driver longer solely to wait for a drug dog. They have no independent reasonable suspicion and no consent. Which is best?

Any traffic offense permits indefinite detention.
Drug investigations never need any objective basis.
A short delay is automatically lawful regardless of purpose.

仍需适当法律依据。

questions.title: 车辆PC与容器
questions.stem: Police lawfully stop a readily mobile car and have probable cause that a packet of drugs is somewhere inside. Under the automobile exception, which place may ordinarily be searched for that packet?
options: Only the driver's visible hands.
Containers and compartments in the car that could hold the packet, within the probable-cause scope.
Every building the driver ever visited.
Every passenger's body automatically.

questions.title: 乘客身体不是车内容器
questions.stem: Officers have probable cause to search a car for drugs but no separate basis to arrest or search an innocent passenger's person. Which is best?

Vehicle ownership transfers to police.
Authority to search the car does not by itself authorize searching the passenger's body.
Every passenger is a driver by law.

搜查权不转移所有权。

questions.stem: After an otherwise lawful custodial arrest, an officer conducts an ordinary search of the arrestee's physical person incident to that arrest. No digital data search is involved. Which is best?

The rule authorizes a search of every neighbor's home.
The rule applies only after conviction.

questions.subject: 刑事诉讼法
questions.title: 自发供述
questions.stem: While riding with an officer, Edgar unexpectedly volunteers information about false tax returns. The officer asked no question and used no words or conduct reasonably likely to elicit that statement. Which is best?
options: Miranda does not suppress the statement merely because an officer heard it.
Every statement within earshot of police is interrogation.
A volunteered statement is automatically coerced.
Only statements about the officer's own specialty are admissible.
questions.translation: 警方未提问或制造等同讯问，Edgar自发说出税务犯罪，是否只因警察在场即须排除？

explanations: 正确。题干排除了讯问。
在场不等于讯问。
自发不自动等于强制。
警种专业不是决定因素。

questions.title: 卧底狱友与另行律师权
questions.stem: Before formal charges, an undercover officer posing as a fellow inmate hears D's voluntary admissions in conversation. No coercion is used. Which is best as to Miranda alone?
options: An undercover listener necessarily creates the same police-dominated pressure as overt interrogation.
Miranda is not automatically triggered by the suspect's conversation with someone he believes is a fellow inmate.
Every confession to any person requires signed warnings.
The Sixth Amendment has necessarily attached simply because D is suspected.

explanations: 缺少该种公开警方压力是关键区别。
正确。不能扩大成所有其他宪法限制都不适用。
私人交谈不一概警告。

questions.title: 明确请求律师后警方重启
questions.stem: During continuous Miranda custody, Tim clearly requests counsel. Without counsel present, Tim's initiation, or a qualifying break in custody, police immediately restart interrogation. Which is best?

A new Miranda card automatically nullifies the request.
The police-initiated questioning ordinarily violates Edwards.
Only a wealthy suspect may request counsel.

questions.title: 尊重沉默权
questions.stem: A suspect clearly invokes the right to remain silent. Which is the most accurate ordinary rule?

Silence forever prevents every future interview under all conditions.
The invocation automatically dismisses all charges.

questions.title: Waiver不只看签字
questions.stem: After proper warnings, D understands his rights and voluntarily agrees to answer. The record establishes a knowing and intelligent waiver, but D did not sign a form. Which is best?

Every waiver requires a notarized deed.
Understanding the warnings is irrelevant.
Police may presume waiver whenever a suspect is asleep.

睡着不能推出有效弃权。

questions.title: 正式程序启动与deliberate elicitation
questions.stem: D has been indicted for a robbery. Without a valid waiver, police use an agent deliberately to elicit incriminating statements about that charged robbery outside counsel's presence. Which right is most directly implicated?

The Sixth Amendment right to counsel in the charged prosecution.
A right that attaches only after all appeals end.
A rule applying solely to civil contracts.

questions.title: Photo array与counsel
questions.stem: Police show a witness a fair photographic array outside D's presence. The procedure is not impermissibly suggestive. Which is best regarding the Sixth Amendment?

No identification procedure ever raises constitutional concerns.

The witness must be arrested first.

questions.title: 笔迹样本是physical characteristic
questions.stem: Investigators lawfully require a handwriting exemplar solely to compare physical handwriting characteristics, not the content of a compelled confession. Which is best under the Fifth Amendment privilege?

The privilege automatically bars fingerprints and all samples.
An exemplar is necessarily a confession to the crime.
That physical-characteristic use is ordinarily outside the privilege against compelled testimonial self-incrimination.

提供形态样本不自动承认犯罪。

questions.title: 未警告但自愿陈述的impeachment
questions.stem: Coe voluntarily gives a statement without required Miranda warnings. It is excluded from the prosecution's case-in-chief. At trial Coe testifies inconsistently. Assuming trustworthiness and the ordinary Harris rule, which is best?
options: The statement becomes admissible for every purpose.
It may be used for the limited purpose of impeaching Coe's inconsistent testimony.
It may always impeach every defense witness regardless of circumstances.

questions.title: 真正coerced confession
questions.stem: A confession is actually involuntary and coerced under due process, not merely obtained without Miranda warnings. May the prosecutor use it to impeach the defendant?

Yes; every illegal statement is treated identically.

The mailbox rule.

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Utility patent通常期限起算
questions.stem: Assume an ordinary modern U.S. utility patent with no term adjustment, extension, or special earlier application issue. Its standard twenty-year term generally runs from which date?
options: The effective U.S. nonprovisional filing date used to calculate the term.
The date of the inventor's birth.
Twenty years after every later sale.
The date a competitor first complains.
questions.translation: 无调整、延长或特殊在先申请问题的一般utility patent，二十年通常从何日起算？
questions.rule: 35 USC154的通常期限以相关申请日计算，权利通常自授权起开始；起算与可执行权利开始不能混同。
explanations: 正确。题干排除特殊调整及关联申请。
与出生无关。
每次销售不重启期限。
竞争者投诉不决定起算。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Design patent的不同期限
questions.stem: For a U.S. design patent based on an application filed on or after May 13, 2015, which ordinary term applies?
options: Twenty years after first commercial sale.
Fifteen years from grant.
The author's life plus seventy years.
Perpetual protection without any time limit.
questions.translation: 2015年5月13日或之后提交的美国design patent，普通期限是什么？
questions.rule: 现代design patent通常为授权日起十五年；不要把utility patent的通常申请日起二十年或版权期限套用。
explanations: 不是销售日起二十年。
正确。题干已限定适用日期。
这是另一类版权期限表达。
专利不是无限期。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Maintenance fees不是annual tax
questions.stem: Assume a U.S. utility patent subject to ordinary maintenance fees. Which statement is best?
options: Personal income tax automatically maintains the patent.
All utility patents renew forever after payment.
Required periodic patent maintenance fees must be addressed; they are not simply annual personal taxes.
Selling one product eliminates all maintenance obligations.
questions.translation: 美国utility patent维持费与个人年度税有什么区别？
questions.rule: 35 USC41(b)为相应utility patent设定阶段性maintenance fees，通常约授权后3.5、7.5、11.5年缴纳；不是旧题笼统annual tax。
explanations: 个人税与专利维持费不同。
缴费不使通常期限无限延长。
正确。具体期限、宽限及恢复规则另查。
销售不自动免除维持要求。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Novelty与在先公开
questions.stem: Before the effective filing date, an unrelated inventor publicly publishes a document disclosing every element of the claimed invention. No statutory exception applies. Which requirement is most directly threatened?
options: A fixed copyright medium.
A trademark's secondary meaning.
The defendant's jury right.
Patent novelty under §102.
questions.translation: 有效申请日前他人公开文献已披露全部权利要求要素且无例外，最直接影响什么？
questions.rule: 35 USC102的novelty/anticipation需核对在先技术及完整披露；与商业成功、作者努力不同。
explanations: 这是版权问题。
这是商标问题。
与专利授权要件无关。
正确。题设给出完整披露和在先公开。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: 发明人公开的宽限期限
questions.stem: An inventor publicly discloses the invention fourteen months before the effective filing date. Assume §102 applies, the disclosure contains all claimed subject matter, and no exception other than the ordinary inventor one-year grace period is asserted. Which is best?
options: That one-year exception does not cover a fourteen-month-old disclosure.
Every inventor disclosure is exempt forever.
The first sale always restarts all novelty dates.
Novelty depends only on how much tuition the inventor paid.
questions.translation: 发明人自己公开后十四个月才有效申请，只主张普通一年例外，是否覆盖？
questions.rule: 美国法特定发明人披露可有一年宽限，但不是任何时长都豁免；仍须看具体披露、申请及法定条件。
explanations: 正确。十四个月超过题给一年。
发明人来源不等于永久免除。
销售不自动重启期限。
学费与要件无关。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Nonobviousness
questions.stem: A claim is new in the narrow sense that no single earlier reference discloses every limitation. Which further patentability inquiry still remains?
options: Whether the inventor is famous.
Whether the claimed invention would have been obvious to a person of ordinary skill in the art at the relevant time.
Whether the claim has a catchy brand name.
Whether the inventor owns a copyright in every idea.
questions.translation: 没有单一在先文献完整披露，是否就自动满足所有专利条件？
questions.rule: Novelty与nonobviousness分开；35 USC103还须从相关时间普通技术人员角度判断显而易见性。
explanations: 名气不是法定判断。
正确。新不自动等于非显而易见。
品牌不是技术进步要件。
版权不垄断idea。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Utility与违反自然规律的装置
questions.stem: A claimed machine promises perpetual energy output exceeding all energy input, but the record establishes that it cannot operate as claimed under physical laws. Which patentability problem is most direct?
options: A failure to choose an attractive trademark.
A requirement that every invention outperform every old device.
Lack of credible utility or operability on these facts.
A rule banning all less efficient inventions.
questions.translation: 声称永动输出但证明不能按宣称工作，最直接的utility问题是什么？
questions.rule: Utility要求可信的具体用途及可工作性；不要求所有新发明都比现有装置效率更高。
explanations: 与品牌无关。
不必优于所有旧技术。
正确。题干已给定不能运作。
低效率不等于一律无utility。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: 自然规律本身与专利
questions.stem: An applicant claims only a newly discovered law of nature itself, without a patent-eligible application or additional inventive concept. Under ordinary §101 doctrine, which is best?
options: Every discovery is automatically patentable.
Naming the law after the discoverer removes every limit.
Copyright is automatically a patent.
The law of nature itself is not patent-eligible merely because newly discovered.
questions.translation: 只请求保护自然规律本身，无合格应用或其他发明性概念，新发现是否当然可专利？
questions.rule: §101司法例外区分自然规律本身与符合条件的应用；发现新规律不自动获得对规律的垄断。
explanations: 发现与合格发明须区分。
命名不改变客体。
版权与专利不同。
正确。题干限定为规律本身。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Enablement
questions.stem: A patent specification merely announces an ambitious result and supplies no teaching enabling a skilled person to make and use the claimed invention without undue experimentation. Which requirement is most directly in issue?
options: Enablement under §112.
The defendant's citizenship.
Automatic trademark fame.
The rule against every experiment of any kind.
questions.translation: 说明书只喊结果，不能使技术人员无需过度试验便实施，最直接何项要求？
questions.rule: §112(a)的enablement要求足以使本领域技术人员make and use；允许合理试验，不是必须零试验。
explanations: 正确。区别于单纯想法或目标。
国籍不是此要件。
与商标知名无关。
禁止的是不当过度试验，不是一切试验。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Claims界定保护范围
questions.stem: Which part of a U.S. patent most directly defines the invention's legal boundaries for infringement analysis, interpreted in its intrinsic context?
options: The inventor's advertising slogan alone.
The patent claims.
The seller's retail price alone.
Every idea mentioned anywhere by any scientist.
questions.translation: 侵权分析中，哪个部分最直接界定专利法律边界？
questions.rule: Claims界定请求保护的发明，解释时结合specification及prosecution history等；不能只靠宣传或泛泛技术领域。
explanations: 宣传不能替代权利要求。
正确。仍须依法解释。
价格不决定技术范围。
专利不涵盖整个领域全部想法。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: 增加一项改良仍可能literal infringement
questions.stem: A valid claim uses "comprising" and requires a seat plus four fixed legs. B's chair contains every limitation exactly and adds a back. Assume no license or other defense. Which is best?
options: Adding any feature automatically avoids infringement.
The back erases the four legs legally.
The additional back does not by itself avoid literal infringement of the open-ended claim.
An improvement can never be used in commerce.
questions.translation: 开放式comprising权利要求全部要素俱在，只多一个靠背，能否仅凭改良避开字面侵权？
questions.rule: 开放式claim的all-elements分析关注每个limitation是否满足；额外要素通常不自动排除。原题半封闭措辞已改成清楚comprising。
explanations: 改良不等于自动不侵权。
增加靠背不消灭已有要素。
正确。其余抗辩题干排除。
改良可用，但仍可能需相关许可。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Missing limitation
questions.stem: A claim requires four fixed legs. The accused product has only three and does not meet that limitation literally. Assume the doctrine of equivalents does not apply and no other claim is asserted. Which is best?
options: Any similar function proves literal infringement.
The patent covers every seat regardless of wording.
The product's price supplies the missing fourth leg.
Literal infringement of that claim is not established.
questions.translation: 权利要求须四腿，产品只有三腿、无等同路径且无其他claim，字面侵权如何？
questions.rule: Literal infringement通常要求满足每个claim limitation，不能以整体相似或相同功能替代缺失要素。
explanations: 功能相似不自动满足具体限定。
保护范围看claim。
价格不补技术要素。
正确。题干排除了等同等其他路径。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Authorized sale与exhaustion
questions.stem: A patentee authorizes an unrestricted sale of a particular patented device. A buyer later resells that same device without making a new one. Which doctrine most directly limits a patent-infringement claim based solely on the resale?
options: Patent exhaustion.
Automatic renewal of the patent term.
A rule that all patent rights in all future devices disappear.
A transfer of every trademark to the buyer.
questions.translation: 授权销售后仅转售同一设备、不制造新件，最相关什么限制？
questions.rule: Authorized sale通常耗尽对该特定物品的相关专利控制，不代表专利对所有未来新产品消失。
explanations: 正确。特定已售物与制造新品区分。
销售不续期。
耗尽针对相应物品，不等于专利整体作废。
不自动转移全部商标。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Repair与making新件
questions.stem: An owner lawfully buys a patented machine and replaces an ordinary worn, unpatented component to preserve the existing machine, without reconstructing a new patented article. Which is best under the stated repair facts?
options: Every replacement is automatically a new patented invention.
Permissible repair is distinguished from infringing reconstruction.
Buying the machine transfers the entire patent.
All machine maintenance requires a new patent application.
questions.translation: 合法购机后更换普通磨损未专利零件、并未重造新专利物，如何区分？
questions.rule: Patent exhaustion相关规则容许相应repair，仍区分重建新专利产品的reconstruction；具体事实重要。
explanations: 不能把修理全部等同重造。
正确。题干已限定为维持原物。
买物不买全部专利。
维修不是一律新申请。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: 大学研究不是当然experimental-use免责
questions.stem: A university uses a patented device in ordinary institutional research furthering its educational business. It claims immunity solely because it is nonprofit. No license or statutory safe harbor applies. Under Madey v. Duke, which is best?
options: Nonprofit status automatically permits every patent use.
All universities are government patent offices.
That status alone does not establish the very narrow common-law experimental-use defense.
Only the amount of tuition determines infringement.
questions.translation: 大学日常机构研究，仅凭非营利身份、无许可或法定safe harbor，是否当然免责？
questions.rule: Madey限制普通法experimental-use抗辩；促进机构通常教育研究业务并不因非营利标签自动豁免。
explanations: 没有一般大学豁免。
学校身份不是专利机关。
正确。仍可另查法定safe harbor等，本题排除。
学费高低不是唯一判断。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Idea与expression
questions.stem: A textbook describes a useful accounting method. A reader independently writes her own explanation and practices the unpatented method without copying protected expression. Which is best as to copyright alone?
options: Copyright monopolizes every idea in the book.
Using the method automatically transfers authorship.
No reader may ever learn from a book.
Copyright does not protect the method itself merely because it is described in the book.
questions.translation: 未抄表达，自行实践书中未专利会计方法，copyright本身能否垄断方法？
questions.rule: 17 USC102(b)不保护idea、procedure、process、system、method本身；具体表达及其他权利另查。
explanations: 保护对象不是一切idea。
使用知识不自动转移作者身份。
版权不禁止学习本身。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: 买画不等于买版权
questions.stem: A collector buys the only physical canvas of a copyrighted painting, with no copyright assignment. Which is best?
options: Physical ownership of the canvas alone does not transfer the copyright.
The purchase necessarily transfers all reproduction rights.
The artist loses all rights in every other work.
Copyright and physical ownership are always legally inseparable.
questions.translation: 买下唯一画布，但无copyright转让，是否当然取得复制权？
questions.rule: 17 USC202区分copyright与承载作品的material object所有权，买物本身不等于买全部著作权。
explanations: 正确。具体展示、转售等另有规则。
复制权不当然转移。
其他作品更不会因此失权。
二者可以分别归属。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Fixation
questions.stem: An author records an original poem in a stable digital file from which it can be perceived or reproduced. Which copyright threshold is most directly illustrated?
options: A requirement that the poem win a prize.
Fixation in a tangible medium, including a qualifying digital medium.
A rule requiring paper and ink only.
Automatic patent novelty.
questions.translation: 原创诗写入可感知复制的稳定数字文件，体现什么copyright门槛？
questions.rule: Fixation不限纸张，符合条件数字介质也可；仍须originality等其他条件。
explanations: 获奖不是门槛。
正确。数字不等于未固定。
法律不只认纸墨。
专利新颖性属另一制度。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Derivative work与翻译
questions.stem: A publisher reproduces a still-protected novel as a new-language translation without permission. No exception applies. Which exclusive right is most directly implicated?
options: The right to vote in federal elections.
Ownership of every abstract plot idea.
The right to prepare derivative works based on the novel.
An automatic right of the translator to disregard the original copyright.
questions.translation: 未经许可翻译仍受保护小说且无例外，最直接涉及何项排他权？
questions.rule: 17 USC106包括准备derivative works的权利，翻译通常属于其中；翻译劳动不自动排除原作品权利。
explanations: 与选举无关。
抽象idea本身不垄断。
正确。题干排除了适用例外。
新增劳动不抹去原版权。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Public domain与新增编辑表达
questions.stem: Beethoven's original compositions are in the public domain. A modern edition contains newly original annotations. A competitor copies only the public-domain compositions, not the new annotations or other protectable additions. Which is best?
options: Any new publication revives copyright in all old compositions.
Copying public-domain music always infringes the editor's annotations.
A book cover transfers all music rights.
The editor cannot use copyright in new additions to recapture the underlying public-domain compositions.
questions.translation: 公版贝多芬作品的新版本含原创注释，只复制公版部分而不抄新增表达，如何？
questions.rule: 17 USC103(b)保护符合条件的新增内容，不延伸或复活原公版材料的权利。
explanations: 再出版不自动复活公版。
未复制注释不能仅因内容公版而称抄注释。
封面不转移所有音乐权利。
正确。区分原素材与新原创贡献。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: 普通个人作品的期限
questions.stem: Assume a modern U.S. work by one identified human author, not a work made for hire and not subject to a special rule. What is the ordinary statutory copyright term?
options: The author's life plus seventy years.
Twenty years from patent filing.
Fifteen years from design-patent grant.
Perpetual protection for every publication.
questions.translation: 现代单一具名自然人普通作品、非职务作品无特殊规则，一般copyright期限？
questions.rule: 17 USC302(a)通常为作者终身加七十年；匿名、共同作者及work for hire等另有规则。
explanations: 正确。题干限定普通个人作品。
这是常见utility patent期限方向。
这是设计专利的不同期限。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Fair use不是单因素自动结论
questions.stem: A teacher argues that any complete commercial textbook may be copied for an entire class solely because the purpose is education. Which is best under §107?
options: Educational purpose automatically resolves every factor.
Purpose is relevant, but fair use requires considering the statutory factors together.
Acknowledging the author alone always gives permission.
The amount copied and market effect are legally irrelevant.
questions.translation: 教师称教育用途就可整本复制商业教材，§107如何分析？
questions.rule: Fair use综合目的性质、作品性质、使用数量实质及市场影响；教育或署名单一因素不自动免责。
explanations: 教育是因素，不是无限许可。
正确。仍须具体事实分析。
署名不等于许可或必然fair use。
两者均为明确法定因素。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Arbitrary mark与相关商品
questions.stem: MANGO is used as a source-identifying word mark for ordinary bicycles, unrelated to mango fruit or a mango feature. Which distinctiveness category best fits?
options: Generic for bicycles.
Merely descriptive of ordinary bicycles.
Arbitrary.
A mandatory government certification label.
questions.translation: MANGO用于与芒果无关的普通自行车来源标识，最贴近哪类？
questions.rule: 日常已有词用于无关商品可属arbitrary；fanciful通常为创造词，不能只看词是否字典已有。
explanations: 自行车通用名不是mango。
题干排除了描述商品特征。
正确。已有普通词与此商品无关。
没有政府认证事实。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Generic不能靠广告变成专属名称
questions.stem: A seller seeks exclusive trademark rights in the word BICYCLE as the generic name for bicycles themselves. Which is best?
options: Enough advertising necessarily makes every generic name exclusive.
A generic product name is always fanciful.
The word is protected because it appears in a dictionary.
A generic name for the goods cannot function as an exclusive trademark for those goods merely through promotion.
questions.translation: 自行车销售者要垄断商品通用名BICYCLE，单靠广告能否取得专有商标？
questions.rule: Generic terms不承担该类商品的可独占来源标识功能；不要与可取得secondary meaning的描述性标志混同。
explanations: 宣传不能把通用名一般变成独占商标。
Generic与fanciful相反。
词典存在不是保护充分条件。
正确。须看词与具体商品关系。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Merely descriptive与acquired distinctiveness
questions.stem: A mark merely describes the goods and has not acquired source significance. The owner says that trying hard to build secondary meaning makes it inherently distinctive already. Which is best?
options: Effort toward secondary meaning is not the same as actually acquiring distinctiveness.
Every descriptive word is inherently fanciful.
All advertising creates instant exclusive rights in every word.
The goods' price is the only distinctiveness test.
questions.translation: 描述性标志尚未形成来源识别，只是努力建立secondary meaning，是否就已有inherent distinctiveness？
questions.rule: Merely descriptive通常须符合acquired-distinctiveness等路径；正在努力形成与已经形成不是同一事实，不能套旧题“in the making”自动保护。
explanations: 正确。题干明确尚未取得。
描述性与创造词不同。
广告不产生这种自动全词垄断。
价格不是唯一判断。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: 商标权不是对一个词的全面所有权
questions.stem: David owns a nonfamous MANGO mark for bicycles. A grocer uses "mango" only truthfully to name the fruit, with no source confusion, sponsorship implication, or other special issue. Which is best?
options: Trademark ownership bans every use of the word in all markets.
The bicycle mark alone does not give David a general veto over that ordinary fruit-name use.
Every bicycle registration transfers ownership of fruit.
The grocer must rename every fruit in the language.
questions.translation: 非驰名自行车MANGO商标，能否禁止无来源混淆的水果通用名称使用？
questions.rule: Trademark保护来源识别及相关利益，非某词在所有语境的全面所有权；混淆、dilution及合理使用等须依事实分别看。
explanations: 不是全语境词语垄断。
正确。题干排除了特别问题。
商标注册不转移水果产权。
没有这种一般改名义务。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Functional trade dress
questions.stem: A product feature is functional because it is essential to use or purpose or affects cost or quality. A seller seeks trade-dress protection to prevent competitors from using that functional feature. Which is best?
options: Any useful feature is protected forever as trade dress.
An expired patent automatically creates perpetual trademark exclusivity.
Functionality can bar trade-dress protection of that feature.
Only the feature's color of ink matters.
questions.translation: 产品特征具功能性，销售者想靠trade dress永久排除竞争者，如何？
questions.rule: Functionality限制商标/外观来源保护，不得用其一般替代专利的有期限技术垄断；不能把所有设计专利和商标重叠都一律判无效。
explanations: 功能性有保护限制。
专利期满不自动转成永久商标。
正确。题干直接给定功能性。
成本、质量和用途是相关因素，不只墨色。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Abandonment的intent
questions.stem: A mark's use is discontinued, and the owner has no intent to resume use. Which concept is most directly implicated under the Lanham Act?
options: A guarantee of perpetual renewal without use.
An automatic patent infringement.
The right to a jury for every dispute.
Trademark abandonment.
questions.translation: 停止商标使用且无恢复意图，最直接涉及什么？
questions.rule: 15 USC1127的abandonment包括停止使用并有不恢复意图；三年不使用可构成法定初步证据，实际条件仍需判断。
explanations: 使用与维持权利重要。
不是专利问题。
与本题商标存续要件无关。
正确。题干给出停止与不恢复意图。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Naked licensing
questions.stem: A trademark owner licenses the mark but exercises no required quality control, allowing it to cease indicating a consistent source. Which risk is most directly raised?
options: Abandonment through uncontrolled or naked licensing.
Automatic acquisition of every licensee's patent.
A rule requiring the owner to license every applicant.
An automatic extension of all copyright terms.
questions.translation: 许可商标但不作所需质量控制，使其不再具有稳定来源意义，何种风险？
questions.rule: Naked licensing可危及商标的来源保证功能并导致abandonment；不是所有许可本身都无效。
explanations: 正确。题干说明缺控制及来源功能问题。
许可不转移他人全部专利。
商标权不一般要求许可每个人。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: 拒绝许可本身
questions.stem: A trademark owner continuously uses and controls a valid mark but refuses a competitor's request for a license. No antitrust or other independent issue is presented. Which is best?
options: Refusal alone necessarily abandons the mark.
Refusal alone does not ordinarily terminate the trademark rights.
Every competitor has an unconditional compulsory license.
Refusal transfers the mark to the competitor.
questions.translation: 持续使用控制有效商标，仅拒绝给竞争者许可，无其他问题，会自动失权吗？
questions.rule: 不许可他人本身通常不等于商标abandonment；与不使用、无控制许可或丧失来源识别不同。
explanations: 拒绝不等于停止使用。
正确。题干排除其他独立限制。
无此一般无条件强制许可。
不会因此自动转移权利。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Foreign priority六个月
questions.stem: An eligible applicant first files a trademark application in a qualifying foreign country and properly claims §44(d) priority in the United States. Which ordinary filing window matters?
options: Twenty years after a competitor's first use.
Any time before the applicant retires.
Within six months of the qualifying first foreign filing, subject to the statutory conditions.
Only after the mark becomes generic.
questions.translation: 符合条件的外国首次申请后，依§44(d)主张美国优先权通常看多久？
questions.rule: 15 USC1126(d)设通常六个月申请窗口及其他条件；不是只要来自境外就自动无限期保留优先。
explanations: 不是专利二十年期限。
没有退休前任意申请规则。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Reasonable secrecy measures
questions.stem: A company keeps a valuable formula in an unrestricted public webpage but calls it a trade secret. Which missing requirement is most direct under the federal definition?
options: A patent in every country.
A minimum of one million dollars in sales.
A jury's approval before anyone learns it.
Reasonable measures to keep the information secret.

没有统一最低销售额门槛。
无需先由陪审团批准知识传播。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: 秘密性带来的经济价值
questions.stem: An internal list is not generally known or readily ascertainable by proper means, is protected by reasonable safeguards, and derives independent economic value from that secrecy. Which is best?
options: It may satisfy core trade-secret requirements even though it is not patented technology.
Only technical inventions can ever be trade secrets.
Registration at the Copyright Office is always required.
Secrecy has no role if the list is valuable.
questions.translation: 内部名单具秘密经济价值并合理保护，非专利技术是否也可能为商业秘密？
questions.rule: 商业秘密可包括商业、金融等多类信息，不只technical solution；独立经济价值须与非公知、非易合法获知联系。
explanations: 正确。满足核心条件仍须其他适用要求。
法定信息范围更广。
不以版权登记为统一条件。
价值与秘密性关系不可省。

questions.subject: 知识产权
questions.title: Reverse engineering与improper means
questions.stem: A competitor lawfully buys an openly sold product and, without breaching any duty or other restriction, independently reverse engineers it. Under the DTSA definition of improper means, which is best?
options: All reverse engineering is theft by definition.
Lawful reverse engineering is not improper means merely because it reveals useful information.
A trade secret gives a universal right to prevent independent discovery.
The competitor must secretly steal a copy first.
questions.translation: 合法购入公开商品，无违约或其他限制，独立reverse engineer，是否本身improper means？
questions.rule: 18 USC1839明确将reverse engineering、independent derivation及其他合法取得方式排除于improper means；其他独立法律限制另看。
